title: UX Designer
description:
Req ID:529694
   

  

 At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
   

  

 Could you be the full-time
 **UX Designer** 
 in
 **Hässleholm** 
 or
 **Stockholm** 
 we’re looking for?
   

  

**Your future role**
 Take on a new challenge and apply your UX design expertise within Alstom and work alongside passionate, motivated, and dedicated teammates.
   

  

 You'll collaborate with UX designers, developers, Product and Program managers. Together we will form the next generation of web-based Alstom internal applications. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with our developer team, research on user needs and behaviours and follow agile work processes.
   

  

 You’ll specifically take care ofdesigning wireframes, prototypes and design assets as well as discovering new opportunities. As we are part of a global organization, providing support to other teams and products can be part of future tasks.
   

  

 Everyday work tasks:
   

  

* Analysis of user behaviors (interview users, analyze analytics data, identify, and understand pain-points)
* Create UX designs, collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to translate user needs into intuitive digital experiences.
* Wireframing and UI prototyping by creating blueprints of the interfaces needed for the interaction.
* Learning and understanding the domain to bring innovative and technical solutions.
* Visual Communication, being knowledgeable in layout, color, typography, icons, images, and design theory.
* Build and document reusable UI components, interaction rules, and accessibility standards so product and engineering teams can build at scale.


**All About You**
 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
   

  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in interaction design (or equivalent)
* Minimum 2-3 years of work experience in UX, UI, or interaction design
* Experience in Web technologies (basic understanding of JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Frontend frameworks).
* Experience or understanding of complex software products and projects.
* Familiarity with agile software development (e.g., Scrum or Kanban).
* Knowledge in Figma is a plus.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Proficient in English and Swedish speaking/understanding.


**Things you’ll enjoy**
 Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
   

  

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines.
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects.
* Utilise our hybrid work environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning.
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).


 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

**Important to note**
 As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Product Designer (UX & AI)
description:
We're looking for a Product Designer (UX & AI) to shape how brands and partners experience the Adtraction platform, from research, all the way to production.
   

  

 Do you love understanding how people actually use a product, turning that into clear flows and designs, and working side by side with developers and designers to get it shipped? Are you excited about how AI is changing the way design becomes working software?
   

  

 Join our Tech team in Stockholm and become the bridge between UX-design and development.
   

  

**About Adtraction**
 Adtraction was founded in 2007, and built on the ambition to create the best possible partnerships between brands and partners. Today, we're a leading partner marketing platform that connects brands with creators and partners to drive traffic, content, and sales, all on a performance-based model.
   

  

 We're a team of 130 people across 12 offices in Europe, with our headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden.
   

  

 People are at the core of everything we do, and we're always looking for new talent who share our ambition to help brands and partners grow.
   

  

 At Adtraction, you can always expect more – from your partnerships, your work, and your career.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As part of our Tech team, you'll combine creativity, collaboration and ambition with a close connection to the business. You'll work closely with developers, product owners and our commercial teams, turning feedback and feature requests into solutions that make the platform better for our clients and partners. Clear communication is at the heart of the role.
   

  

 As Product Designer (UX & AI) you will own the user experience of our platform for brands and partners, on the web and in our mobile apps. You'll map complete user flows, analyse how users actually behave, and turn it all into well-structured designs in Figma, ready for development and AI implementation. Over time, you'll also take ownership of our design system.
   

  

 Our developers work with AI agents that turn well-defined tickets into production code, reviewed and merged by the team.
 **What's missing is an equally smooth path for design.** 
 A key part of your role is to build that path: structuring our Figma files, components and design tokens so that AI agents can implement design accurately, and setting up the process that takes a design from Figma to production efficiently.
   

  

**Reporting to:** 
 Tech Lead / CTO
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Design interactions and interfaces in Figma, from early sketches to production-ready designs
* Structure and evolve our design system and component library in Figma, keeping it consistent and easy to build from
* Build and own the process for taking design from Figma to production with AI agents
* Analyse user behaviour in Microsoft Clarity (heatmaps, session recordings) and turn findings into concrete improvements
* Map complete user flows and information architecture across our web platform and mobile apps
* Handle feedback and feature requests from our sales and customer success teams and translate them into well-designed solutions
* Work closely with developers and product owners, from framing the problem to reviewing what's shipped


 What you bring
   

  

* Several years of experience as a UX, product or interaction designer, or as a design-focused engineer, working on digital products
* Expert Figma skills, including well-structured files, components, variants and design tokens
* Experience using behavioural data (e.g. Clarity, Hotjar) to find UX problems and turn insights into design decisions
* Experience designing for mobile apps as well as the web
* Excellent communication skills: you explain your design decisions clearly and enjoy working closely with developers, product owners and commercial teams
* Hands-on experience using AI tools to take design into code, e.g. Claude Code, Figma MCP or similar
* Fluency in Swedish and English


**Your Profile Will Be Extra Interesting If You Have**
* Experience with React and how design systems are implemented in code, e.g. Storybook
* Experience designing data-heavy B2B interfaces with tables, filtering and visualisation
* Experience from affiliate marketing, partner marketing or e-commerce


 We hire based on experience, knowledge and personality, but also potential. If you're passionate and eager to learn, we'd love to hear from you, also if you don't meet every requirement.
   

  

 We're looking for
   

  

 Someone who is curious about users, structured in how they work and generous in sharing what they learn. You take ownership of the user experience, love turning complex problems into simple flows, and enjoy close collaboration in a fast-paced, ever-changing industry.
   

  

 We're a social company that enjoys spending time together, and we can't wait for you to be part of our vibrant and fun culture!
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 At Adtraction, we believe great people create great results. That's why we focus on creating a workplace where you can thrive, both professionally and personally.
   

  

**At Adtraction You Can Expect This (and More)**
* A central role with real influence over how our platform looks, works and gets built
* Regular social events and a yearly conference where we all meet, work and celebrate
* Opportunities to grow and develop your skills
* A vibrant office-first culture, with the option to work from home two days a week
* Breakfast everyday, weekly after works and events in office
* An international company with colleagues from 12 offices in Europe
* Working at a company listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market
* A competitive compensation package
* A culture where we embrace relations, create long-term value and always improve
* A company with engaged employees (employee net promoter score of 45)


 Application
   

  

 Please include a link to your portfolio. We'd especially like to see a case where you went from insight to shipped design.
   

  

 We review applications continuously and hire as soon as we find the right fit, so don't wait, send us your CV and application today!

title: Digital Designer
description:
Acne Studios is a progressive luxury house and through collaboration and curiosity, we set high aspirations and strive for excellence. We value everyone’s contribution and embrace feedback to develop ourselves and others. We aim to minimise our environmental impact across all our operations and to address societal challenges in the way we conduct our business.
   

  

 As Digital Designer at our Stockholm HQ, you will help shape the digital expression of Acne Studios across e-commerce and customer-facing digital channels. Working at the intersection of design, fashion, and technology, you will create engaging digital experiences that bring our brand, collections, campaigns, and collaborations to life online.
   

  

 CULTURE OF COLLABORATION
   

  

 We firmly believe that when you feel supported, included, and trusted, it enables you to enjoy your work and thrive in it. You will be a part of a team of colleagues with diverse roles and backgrounds, each with their unique skills and experiences.
   

  

 WHAT YOU WILL DO
   

  

 As Digital Designer, your main contribution will be to create and evolve digital experiences that strengthen the Acne Studios brand and support our e-commerce ambitions. You will report to the Head of Digital Studio. You will play a vital role in delivering engaging, brand-aligned digital experiences across key customer touchpoints by:
   

  

* Deliver design updates and improvements for acnestudios.com, including site layouts, and for newsletters
* Create digital design solutions for campaigns, launches, collaborations and new functionality
* Translate creative direction into strong and consistent digital experiences
* Collaborate closely with art directors, developers, e-commerce and marketing teams
* Ensure a high level of quality and consistency across digital touch points
* Stay up to date with developments in digital design, fashion and technology


 WHO YOU ARE
   

  

 You have high aspirations and focus on details that create substantial impact. You enjoy working as a team and you embrace feedback to develop yourself and others. You are curious and thrive in a dynamic environment. Cooperation, respect, and clear communication are important, along with your ambition to learn and grow. If these qualities speak to you, we would love to have you on our team.
   

  

 Specific personal qualities for this role:
   

  

* Passionate about digital design with strong attention to detail
* Hands-on and comfortable managing day-to-day design needs in a fast-paced environment
* Curious and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively with different stakeholders
* Able to propose creative solutions while maintaining a strong understanding of the brand’s creative direction
* Organised and able to meet tight deadlines while maintaining a high level of quality


 Specific experience and knowledge for this role:
   

  

* 3-5 years' experience in digital or web design
* Advanced proficiency in Figma
* Strong understanding of UX and responsive design
* Experience designing for e-commerce
* Portfolio showcasing relevant digital work
* Fluent in English, written and spoken


 What matters most to us is not whether you master all the listed knowledge and skills. We are dedicated to recognising the potential in each individual. We embrace diversity of people as well as ideas and viewpoints and encourage everyone's individual expression of their own identity.

title: Director of Product Design
description:
**Mission**
 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
   

  

 In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
   

  

 The Design Challenge
   

  

 Neko's product is not a screen. It is a member journey that runs from booking through a full-body scan to a clinical conversation and everything that follows. Digital, clinical and physical, held together as one experience.
   

  

 The hardest and most interesting part is the data. A Neko scan produces more information about a person's health than most people will see in a lifetime, and it lands with someone who is not a clinician. Making that intuitive, trustworthy and genuinely actionable is the central design problem here, and nobody has solved it yet.
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 As Product Design Director, you will lead the Product Design Group. The job has two halves and both matter. Effective operator, and design leader. You will build a team capable of producing category-defining member experiences, set the standard for what good looks like within it and hold that team responsible for designing products people will love: remarkable, distinct, and unmistakably Neko. Product strategy and roadmap sit with Product. The product design vision, and the craft behind it, are yours.
   

  

 You own the team, the quality bar and the design output.
   

  

 You'll report to the Head of Creative and work closely with Product, Engineering and the other creative disciplines across Architecture and Brand Creative.
   

  

 What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months
   

  

* Continue to build the team's design leadership layer.
* Define what exceptional product design looks like at Neko, establish the principles and review


 mechanisms that uphold it, and materially raise the quality bar.
   

  

* Establish a way of working with Product and Engineering where design sits inside the build, not


 upstream of it.
   

  

* Develop the team's strongest designers into its next leaders.
* Ship experiences that set Neko apart. Design quality that is visibly distinct, and unmistakably ours.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Built products from scratch. You have taken products from 0 to 1 at consumer-facing companies, and your record is not mainly incremental improvement of something established.
* Exceptional taste and craft, and a real love for the work itself. You still design. You have a clear point of view on what good looks like and can articulate it well enough that a team holds itself to it. This is a role for someone who lives in the design tools, not in documents about design.
* A proven team-builder. You have hired, developed and retained specialist design talent at every level, including senior domain leadership, and people have done their best work under you.
* A credible peer to Product and Engineering. You hold your own with both, and you work in the


 overlap where design and engineering blur, thinking in prototypes and built things rather than specifications and handovers.
   

  

* A strong operator. You build the team and the conditions for it to do its best work, and you clear the path in front of it.


 Why Neko
   

  

* Work on a mission that matters. Preventive health has the potential to fundamentally change how long and how well people live.
* A senior role in Creative. Build in close partnership with the Head of Creative and senior leadership from day one.
* Build something new. This is a greenfield opportunity for the team you'll lead.
* Exceptional colleagues. We hire people who are rigorous, curious, and deeply committed to doing things right.
* Competitive compensation and equity.


**About Titles At Neko**
 We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so internal titles may differ from market-facing role titles. Scope, impact and level of the role are fully aligned and will be clearly discussed throughout the process.
   

  

 Hiring Process
   

  

 Candidates progress from application and structured screening through thoughtfully designed interviews
   

  

 culminating in a formal offer and final pre-employment checks before joining the team.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity & Inclusion Statement
   

  

 Neko Health is committed to inclusive hiring and member-first care. We welcome candidates from all

title: Staff / Principal Design Engineer, Web
description:
TL;DR - We're seeking an exceptional Design Engineer who combines strong frontend engineering fundamentals with a sharp eye for craft to execute on our website. You’ll work closely with design and marketing to build world-class web content helping empower the next generation of creators and builders.
   

  

 Why Lovable?
   

  

 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

 What we’re looking for
   

  

* 10+ years of years experience, shipping websites and landing pages users genuinely love
* Portfolio demonstrating landing pages and advanced web interactions (if you don’t have a portfolio of landing pages - check out our other roles)
* Ability to make smart trade-offs between speed and polish, knowing when to ship and when to refine
* Strong fundamental understanding of modern frontend systems - React architecture, state management, performance, accessibility, and scalable UI patterns
* Experience translating scrappy explorations into production-ready experiences
* Strong design sense with an eye for detail, accessibility, and usability
* Ideally - you push the boundaries of the web with technologies like WebGL


 What you’ll do
   

  

 In one sentence: Own and elevate landing pages and web experiences that help share Lovable with the world.
   

  

* Build landing pages that delight, also designing interactions or pairing closely with designers
* Implement web interactions in React/TypeScript with obsessive attention to performance, responsiveness, and cross-browser consistency
* Drive front-end execution - pioneering new interaction patterns, micro-animations, and delightful details that elevate the entire experience
* Collaborate with marketing, helping share Lovable with the world
* Explore and iterate on visual designs with designers, translating explorations into scalable, web-native implementations
* Build and maintain reusable components that enhance consistency while enabling creativity across both product and marketing
* Reinvent how teams build for the web


 Our tech stack
   

  

 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:
   

  

* Frontend: React, Tailwind
* Backend: Golang and Rust
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers
* DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, , infra-as-code (Terraform)


 And always on the lookout for what's next!
   

  

 How we hire
   

  

* Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with recruiter.
* Show us some of your work you’re really proud of.
* Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews, including a technical screening where we evaluate frontend engineering fundamentals at the same level we expect from Product Engineers.
* In some cases, we may opt to do paid, trial work.


**About Your Application**
* Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal
* For this role, we're prioritising candidates based in New York

title: Product Experience Specialist (Full Time)
description:
**TL;DR**
 This role is a great fit for a
 **recent bachelor’s or master’s graduate** 
 who wants to start their career close to product, users, and AI and take on real responsibility from day one. You will be on the front lines of a fast-growing product, solving real user problems and feeding insights directly into product development. You will also take ownership of how we build, document, and improve support at scale. This role is for someone who has recently completed a bachelor's or master's degree, is user- and product-obsessed, cares deeply about helping others succeed, and is ready to grow into real responsibility fast.
   

  

 This is a full-time position based in Lund or Stockholm. We start with a 3-month contract with a potential 12-month extension and expanded responsibilities.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* Recently graduated: You have completed a bachelor's or master's degree and are looking for a role where you can hit the ground running and grow fast.
* A driver, not a passenger: You spot problems before they're pointed out, come up with improvements on your own initiative, and follow through.
* Analytical problem solver: You break down complex situations systematically and move fast to get users unblocked even if it is something we haven’t seen before. You see opportunities where others see obstacles.
* Curious: You test ideas, try new approaches, and aren't afraid to get it wrong the first time. You're naturally drawn to AI tools and see the potential to get things done more efficiently.
* Crystal-clear communicator: Whether it's a user reply, a bug report, or an internal process doc, you communicate warmly and precisely.
* Bonus: Experience in B2C SaaS support using tools like Intercom.
* Bonus: Hands-on experience with Lovable, Claude and similar AI tools.


**What You'll Do**
* Own user problems end to end: Become a Lovable expert to solve a wide range of issues with speed and clarity, and escalate effectively to engineering when needed.
* Improve our support stack: Keep our internal knowledge base up to date, design smarter workflows, and find ways to make the whole team operate better.
* Be the voice of the customer: Continuously feed product feedback into the team so that what you see on the front lines actually improves the product.
* Grow your scope: As you build trust and ownership, the role expands. Internally at Lovable and externally in how we engage with users and the community, there is real room to develop.


**The tech stack:**
 We run one of the most AI-native support operations anywhere, and we build much of it ourselves, on Lovable.
   

  

* AI-first ticketing: Intercom as system of record, with our AI agent (built on Parahelp) resolving the first line: it answers, troubleshoots, takes actions, e.g. executes refunds and credit grants with human approval. You handle what genuinely needs a human and you train and improve the AI as part of the job.
* Internal tools built on Lovable: our admin console (user, workspace, billing, domain, and credit operations), live metrics dashboards, and QA tooling are all Lovable apps, built and iterated by the team that uses them. You’ll ship improvements to your own tools and build new ones.
* An AI copilot that lives everywhere: Our investigation agent with access to our codebase, logs and relevant data troubleshoots issues and helps our team draft high quality replies. It lives in Slack, in Intercom & in your browser.
* Real engineering surfaces, you go deep when tickets demand it: Grafana, Temporal, Stripe, Supabase, Cloudflare, and DNS tooling.


**About Your Application**
 We welcome candidates from all backgrounds. What matters to us is mindset, drive, and curiosity. Please apply through our application system in English as it is our company language.

title: Product Owner – Buying & Data/AI (Fixed-Term)
description:
Tradera is a purpose-driven company with a belief that consumption has a large impact on our planet. We're determined to use what we control (our business, our voice, our creativity and our platform) to do something about it. At Tradera, we're on a mission to "Drive the Transition to Sustainable Shopping" by shifting the way people consume and resell preloved goods.
 



  





 We're now looking for a Product Owner to lead two of our teams: Buying, which shapes the buying journey across tradera.com and our iOS and Android apps, and Data/AI, which builds Tradera's own AI models.
 



  





 This is a fixed-term employment contract (Sw. särskild visstidsanställning) running from February 2027 to January 2028. We work with a hybrid policy and we'd like you to be at our Stockholm office at least 2-3 days a week.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Buying team's mission is to make buying second-hand as seamless and enjoyable as buying new. The Data/AI team builds AI that makes a difference wherever it can, for our users and internally. Today that includes search, recommendations and making it easier to list items on Tradera. The team works closely with Buying and the rest of the product organization.
 



  





 As Product Owner, you'll work closely with our CPO and have a central role in the organization, collaborating with stakeholders across the company.
 



  





 We care a lot about getting things done. In this role, success is about what the team ships together and the difference it makes for our users.
 



  





 You'll be team lead and people manager for 7 people across both teams. You'll help them grow, build good collaboration and keep the teams focused on what matters most. Priorities can change quickly here, so you're comfortable adapting and helping the team keep its focus.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Shape features and improvements that make second-hand shopping as simple and enjoyable as buying new.
* Set direction for the Data/AI team across every area where AI can make a difference, both for our users and internally at Tradera.
* Prioritize the backlogs for both teams, balancing user feedback, bug fixes, AI initiatives and new features.
* Plan and ship updates across web, apps and our AI/data platform together with the teams.
* Work closely with developers, UX/design, analysts, marketing and other product teams.
* Support and develop the people in your teams through feedback, coaching and regular 1:1s.



  





**Who Are You?** 




 You like getting things done and get your energy from seeing a team succeed together. You're curious about what AI can do for a product.
 



 We think you have:
 


* Experience leading a team, as a people manager or in another leading role.
* Experience prioritizing work based on user needs and business impact.
* Experience working with developers and other teams.
* Fluency in both Swedish and English.



  





 Experience with data, ML or AI products is a plus, but not a requirement.
 



  





 Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about how you work and what you can bring to the team than about matching a list.
 



  





**Why Join Tradera?** 




 At Tradera, you'll work on meaningful projects that contribute to sustainable shopping, together with a talented team. You'll play a key role in making second-hand the easy and enjoyable choice, and in shaping how AI helps people find, buy and sell preloved goods.
 



  





 Come and join us. Don't be square, get circular!

title: Senior Fullstack/Webb-utvecklare
description:
**Om företaget** 




 Vi är Delorean, en prisbelönt digital byrå som hjälper företag och organisationer att utveckla innovativa strategier, digitala tjänster och kreativa kommunikationslösningar. Vi är stolt vinnare av Årets Digitala Byrå 2024 och har ett härligt gäng medarbetare som brinner för att skapa digital framgång. Vi har en stark teamkänsla där du får vara med och påverka både din egen arbetssituation och företaget. Vi tror på att lära oss tillsammans och utvecklas med nya tekniker som kommer. Vi jobbar bland annat med kunder som 7-Eleven, Pressbyrån, Vogue Scandinavia, Nationalmuseum och Statens Konstråd.
 



  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Vi söker nu efter senior fullstack-utvecklare med stor erfarenhet av att driva webb- & app projekt. 
 



  





 Arbetsuppgifterna varierar mycket. Vi jobbar med flera lite större utvecklingsprojekt som ofta har en digital affär. Men vi skapar även kundspecifika verktyg, andra CMS-baserade lösningar, datadrivna prestandaförbättringar med mer.
 



 Vi värdesätter en glad personlighet och ett stort intresse för webbutveckling. Ägnar du dessutom en del av din fritid till att förbättra din kompetens och undersöka nya ramverk och tekniker har vi mycket gemensamt.
 



 Vår teknikfilosofi är att använda rätt verktyg till det utmaningen kräver. Därför är vi inte rädda att både testa och utvärdera nya tekniker, samt att implementera dessa i skarpa projekt. Vi undviker att välja verktyg enbart på popularitet eller gammal vana.
 



 De flesta av våra projekt är headless i React där det finns en eller flera backends i Node, PHP eller .Net
 



 Det som är viktigt för oss är inte att du är fullärd, utan att du har en positiv attityd och ett intresse för att lära dig nya saker.
 



  





 Extra plus om du har erfarenhet av testautomatisering, systemutveckling samt arbete med integrationer och systemkopplingar.
 



  





**Din roll i teamet** 



* Programmera front- och backend.
* Ansvara för och driva olika webbprojekt.
* Ta fram tekniska strategier och koncept med vårt team av utvecklare, UX:are och projektledare.
* Ha kundkontakt och svara på frågor relaterade till projekten.
* Ha code reviews med utvecklingsteamet.
* Pratar och skriver svenska flytande, då detta ett krav från våra kunder.



  





**Vi ser att du har erfarenhet av** 



* Cloudhantering (Google Cloud Platform)
* Erfarenhet utav integrationer och infrastruktur.
* Backend-programmering, tex något av: .NET, Node.js, PHP, Python, Ruby, Go, C#.
* HTML, CSS och JavaScript.
* Versionshantering i GIT.
* JavaScript-frameworks så som React, Angular, Vue
* Att utveckla integrationer och kopplingar till andra system via API:er.



  





**Extra meriterande** 



* Apputveckling
* Jobbat med stora, komplexa organisationer och projekt
* CMS (tex) Umbraco, Episerver / Optimizely
* Bra koll på Devops-relaterade verktyg och processer, Nginx, Docker, CI-lösningar osv.
* Erfarenhet av GraphQL
* SASS/LESS eller liknande-CSS preprocessors.
* Erfarenhet av Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, DataStudio, Optimize.



  





**Varför ska du jobba på Delorean?** 




 När du jobbar hos oss kan vi bland annat erbjuda följande:
 


* Vi är kollektivanslutna: För dig innebär det att du garanteras bra villkor och att saker som betald föräldraledighet, semester, tjänstepension, rätt till löneförhöjning och mycket mer är självklarheter.
* Du får tjänstepension: En vacker dag går du i pension. Som kollektivanslutet företag betalar vi in till din tjänstepension från att du fyllt 25 år.
* Du får friskvårdsbidrag: Alla som jobbar hos oss ska få de bästa förutsättningarna för att hålla sig friska och krya. Vi erbjuder bidrag på 5000 kr per år som du kan använda till din personliga träning.
* Kompetensutveckling och delaktighet: Vi har regelbundna medarbetarsamtal samt tar fram individuella utvecklingsplaner. Och vi vill att våra medarbetare är med och påverkar både arbetsplats och hur vi arbetar.



  





 Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan!

title: Principal Product Manager - Format Foundations
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening and watching feel effortless, personal, and joyful for hundreds of millions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
   

  

 We’re seeking a Principal Product Manager to help lead the consumer experience across Spotify’s formats, including books, podcasts, and music. Format Foundations partners with the business teams behind each format to lead innovation in how users discover, engage with, and build lasting relationships with content on Spotify. You’ll set the product vision and strategy for your area and shape feature portfolios across formats. This role sits within Format Foundations in Core Experience, partnering closely with these teams to grow their businesses through product innovation.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Lead product vision and strategy across Spotify’s formats, shaping how books, podcasts, and music become more engaging, lovable, and valuable for users, creators, and the business.
* Define and evolve the user experience across the content journey—from discovery and evaluation through engagement, library management, and retention.
* Partner closely with business leaders across books, podcasts, and music to translate business strategy into product innovation that drives growth.
* Drive innovation across multimodal and cross-format experiences, such as the intersection of listening and reading, and build capabilities that can scale from one format to others.
* Work closely with engineering, design, data, and cross-functional partners to deliver high-quality experiences.
* Use data, experimentation, and user insights to inform decisions and continuously improve the experience.
* Align senior stakeholders across Core Experience, the business teams, and Personalization to create a cohesive consumer experience.
* Lead multiple cross-functional initiatives end to end, owning scope and alignment and partnering with engineering on delivery.
* Mentor product managers and raise the bar for product craft across the team.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have 10+ years of experience in product management and have led product work across several consumer media products at scale in large technology companies.
* You have deep knowledge of the consumer media landscape across areas such as books, podcasts, or music, including competitive dynamics, creator and publisher ecosystems, and user behavior.
* You have experience building for mobile platforms such as iOS and Android, including complex user interfaces.
* You understand how to build scalable systems and experiences that enable teams to move faster.
* You’re able to balance user experience, technical constraints, and business impact.
* You care deeply about creating intuitive, high-quality consumer experiences.
* You’ve worked closely with engineering, design, and data partners to bring products to life.
* You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing clarity across teams and organizations.
* You’ve influenced senior leaders and stakeholders across functions and levels to drive alignment and outcomes.
* You actively use AI tools in your product development workflow, from research and analysis to iteration and prototyping.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in Stockholm or London
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Product Marketing Manager, Growth
description:
**TL;DR -** 
 Lovable's product-led growth motion has been core to its success, and messaging is one of the biggest levers we have to move users from signup to activation to expansion. This role owns that lever: the messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey.
   

  

 You'll own how we talk to self serve users at every stage, from the words in an onboarding email to the framing of an upgrade prompt. You'll partner closely with the Growth PM, who owns the growth roadmap and the product/experimentation strategy behind it, and with our Lifecycle team, who execute lifecycle campaigns day to day. Your job is to bring the messaging point of view: what story we should be telling at each stage, which positioning will land best with which segment, and what new content or messaging should be created to support the roadmap the Growth PM has set.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* A clear, sharp writer, able to explain a complex feature in an email subject line or an in app tooltip.
* Strong at positioning: you can look at a user segment and a product moment and know what story will resonate.
* Comfortable partnering closely with a Growth PM and a Lifecycle team without needing to own their roadmap or tooling.
* Able to build cross functional trust and alignment without formal authority.
* Curious about data and results, even if you're not the one running the experiments; you want to know what messaging is working and why.
* Biased toward shipping and iterating on messaging quickly over lengthy planning cycles.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 10+ years of experience in product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or content/messaging roles.
* Experience at a high tech company.
* Direct experience writing messaging and positioning for a PLG or self serve product, ideally across the signup to paid to expansion journey.
* A track record of writing customer facing content, campaigns, or messaging that you can speak to in detail, and that you can point to measurable outcomes for.
* Experience partnering with product, growth, or lifecycle teams to bring messaging into their workflows, without owning the underlying roadmap or systems.


**Preferred:**
* Experience working alongside lifecycle or CRM tools such as Braze, Iterable, or Customer.io, even if you weren't the one operating them.
* Familiarity with growth metrics and experimentation frameworks (PQLs, activation rate, feature adoption) enough to speak the same language as a Growth PM.
* Experience working with developer, startup, or solo builder audiences.
* Experience building messaging frameworks or toolkits that scaled across multiple teams.


**What You’ll Do**
* Own messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey, from signup through activation and expansion.
* Partner with the Growth PM to translate their roadmap and experimentation priorities into strong, on-brand messaging, bringing your own point of view on framing and positioning rather than just executing briefs.
* Work hand in hand with the Lifecycle team on new content and messaging for email, in-app surfaces, and push notifications, ensuring everything reflects our positioning and voice.
* Develop clear point of view documents and messaging guidance for different self serve segments (solo founders, indie hackers, small teams) that inform both lifecycle content and broader growth campaigns.
* Write and refine copy for high leverage touchpoints: onboarding flows, activation nudges, upgrade prompts, and in-app messaging.
* Review and sharpen messaging coming out of experiments and campaigns, helping the team understand not just whether something worked, but why, from a messaging and positioning lens.
* Build a shared messaging toolkit (voice, tone, positioning by segment, proof points) that Lifecycle and Growth can both draw from.
* Represent the messaging and positioning perspective in growth planning, as a thought partner to the Growth PM rather than an owner of the roadmap itself.


**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**  

As a key member of our team, you'll design, develop, and maintain backend solutions for our Stores. Working in an agile environment, you'll collaborate with product managers, business and frontend engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable software, driving initiatives from problem definition through rollout. The ideal candidate is passionate about backend development, has a track record of driving technical initiatives and making the team around them better, proficient in C# and .Net

 **WHAT YOU’LL DO**

In addition to the above, your role will involve:

* Technical Leadership & Ownership: Taking end-to-end ownership of key initiatives — from architecture and design through delivery — setting technical directions and making the trade-off calls that keep the team moving.
* Mentorship & Force Multiplication: Actively raising the technical level of the team through code reviews, pairing, and design discussions; unblocking colleagues and making the people around you more effective, not just shipping your own code.
* API Design: Shaping the design and implementation of APIs that facilitate seamless communication between the Mobile Application and backend, ensuring an efficient flow of data in the headless ecommerce environment.
* Azure Cloud: Leveraging your expertise in Azure Cloud services to enhance the scalability, reliability, and performance of our backend systems, ensuring a seamless integration with our headless ecommerce applications.

 **WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**


At Store Lens, we work closely with Portfolio Brands and H&M Brand to design and provide technical solutions. We contribute to product development at every stage, from setting requirements to rollout and testing. From day one, we focus on improving by listening, building, and refining as we go. Even as we define requirements, we are already thinking ahead, using early designs, first developments, and new learnings to continuously make the product better.


We are curious, active listeners and hands-on doers.


Beyond your work with Store Lens, you will also be part of our Engineering/QA community, where you will have access to a network of experts, resources, and opportunities to grow.

 **WHO YOU ARE**

We are looking for people with…


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience), and at least 5-8 years of experience as a Software Engineer with backend focus, including demonstrated experience leading technical initiatives, mentoring engineers, or acting as a technical lead on a team.
* Proficiency in C# and .NET.
* Proficiency in Azure concepts and native development using Azure functions.
* Experience in concept as Always up and message queuing.
* Experience of CI/ CD pipelines using Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.
* Experience of containerization technologies like Kubernetes and Docker.
* Experience in Database (e.g. Cosmos Db).
* Experience in POS, Payment and Checkout area is a plus.
* Experience in SignalR is a plus.


 And people who have:

* Continuous learning mindset to stay updated on emerging trends and technologies.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail A track record of conducting code reviews, identifying areas of improvement, and providing constructive feedback to maintain code quality and consistency across a team, not just their own work.
* Familiarity in backend testing with a focus on ensuring the reliability and performance of backend systems.
* Familiarity with Agile development.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity — able to take a loosely defined problem and shape it into a concrete technical plan.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

 **WHO WE ARE**

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.


We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.  



**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**  

  

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, which is usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.


In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

  

JOIN US


Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.


Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.


* We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

title: Software Engineer III
description:
**ABOUT SINCH**  

Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 150,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email. Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.
  

At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!
  

**Description**  

The Account & Access team sits at the very heart of Sinch's central platform. We own the customer account model and the high-performance access control engine powering the Sinch Build portfolio of products.
  

Our mission is critical: we design the systems that shape how both external customers and internal product teams securely interact with our platform. Every piece of code you write here directly impacts the customer experience, platform security, and developer velocity.
  

As our new Software Engineer III, you will take end-to-end ownership in a collaborative, "you build it, you run it" environment. Specifically, you will:
  

* Architect & Build: Design, test, and operate highly available, distributed services for customer accounts and secure access control (APIs, customer-facing UIs, and internal admin panels).
* Own Platform Security: Drive the development of the core engine making security and authorization decisions across our API gateway and web interfaces.
* Empower Internal Developers: Create intuitive tools, robust documentation, and developer-friendly capabilities that simplify how other Sinch product teams build on our platform.
* Drive the Full Lifecycle: Own features from initial ideation to production. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize services, resolving complex latency, security, and connectivity challenges.
* Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Product, Design, and sister engineering teams to align platform solutions with wider organizational goals.

**Requirements**  

You are a product-minded engineer who is passionate about building robust, scalable, and secure solutions. You have a strong sense of ownership and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where your work has a big impact.
  

Your experience:
  

* 4+ years of professional experience building and operating critical production-grade services.
* Full-Stack capability: Solid experience in both backend and frontend development.
* Strong programming skills in languages like Java, Kotlin, Typescript, Spring, React.
* Hands-on experience in technologies like MySQL, Postgres, Redis and Kafka.
* Practical knowledge in containerization and building Cloud-native solutions – e.g. AWS, Docker, Kubernetes.
* Experience leveraging observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Datadog) to proactively monitor and debug distributed systems.
**Nice to have:**  

* Background working at a strong product-focused company, with an understanding of how engineering contributes to building great customer experiences.
* Solid grasp of modern identity and authorization paradigms like OAuth2 and OpenID Connect (OIDC), RBAC and ABAC.
* Experience with performance, load, and reliability testing for distributed systems.
**Salary** : The monthly salary for this position is between 50,370 and 65,000 SEK. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications.  



  

**OUR HIRING PROCESS**  

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel. We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey.
  

If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

title: Hårdvarukonstruktör
description:
För kunds räkning söker vi nu en Hårdvarukonstruktör som vill arbeta med utveckling, verifiering och integration av operatörsutrustning till ett avancerat luftburet övervakningssystem. Rollen passar dig som vill kombinera tekniskt analysarbete med praktiskt arbete i labbmiljö och som trivs i en verksamhet där kvalitet, tillförlitlighet och långsiktighet står i fokus.

##### **Om tjänsten**


Som Hårdvarukonstruktör arbetar du med den utrustning som operatörer använder för att visa, hantera och analysera information från avancerade radarsystem. Det kan exempelvis handla om bildskärmar, tangentbord, möss, nätverksutrustning och andra hårdvarukomponenter som ingår i operatörsplatserna.


Varje kundlösning är unik, vilket innebär att du får arbeta med varierande tekniska krav och anpassningar. Du ansvarar för att analysera krav, ta fram tekniska specifikationer och samarbeta med inköp, leverantörer och tekniska specialister för att identifiera och utvärdera lämpliga produkter och lösningar. När befintliga produkter inte uppfyller ställda krav driver du utvecklingen av nya eller modifierade lösningar tillsammans med berörda parter. Arbetet omfattar hela kedjan från kravanalys och prototypframtagning till verifiering och produktionsklar lösning.

  

Rollen innehåller både dokumentation och praktiskt arbete i labbmiljö. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter är:

* Ta fram och underhålla tekniska specifikationer
* Utvärdera och verifiera hårdvaruprodukter från leverantörer
* Genomföra ankomstkontroller och funktionstester
* Bygga upp och testa utrustning i leverans- och testmiljöer
* Felsöka och verifiera att system och produkter uppfyller ställda krav
* Samordna utvecklings- och verifieringsaktiviteter
* Samarbeta med inköp, leverantörer och specialister inom exempelvis miljöprovning


Du blir en del av en verksamhet där utvecklingscyklerna är långsiktiga och där produkterna används i miljöer med mycket höga krav på kvalitet, robusthet och tillförlitlighet.

##### **Din kompetens**

* Eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, data, nätverksteknik eller motsvarande erfarenhet
* Erfarenhet av tekniskt arbete, felsökning eller systemnära verksamhet
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


Meriterande är erfarenhet av hårdvarunära utveckling, systemintegration, verifiering eller arbete i test- och labbmiljö. Även erfarenhet av kravhantering, teknisk dokumentation och samarbete med externa leverantörer ses som positivt.


För att trivas i rollen är du analytisk, strukturerad och har ett stort tekniskt intresse. Du har förmågan att omsätta komplexa krav till praktiska lösningar och trivs i en roll med många kontaktytor. Vidare uppskattar du samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och att arbeta tillsammans med andra för att hitta de bästa lösningarna.

Procruitment är Sveriges enda karriärbyrå inom IT, tech och engineering som genom proaktiv rekrytering förenar attraktiva arbetsgivare med människor som delar samma mål och ambitioner. title: Data Engineer - SCD
description:
**Company Description**  

Together we work constantly to improve the IKEA home furnishing offer and make it more accessible for the many people. You will be part of IKEA Supply and the Supply Chain Development organisation. IKEA Supply is responsible for securing that the product offer is produced and delivered to our customers. We lead the supply agenda across many functions and work together with all business areas, different business units, but also retail markets to secure customer availability in all markets and sales channels at lowest total cost.


We create a workplace where everyone feels free to be themselves – to experiment, try new ways, and dare to ask, “What if…?” We believe in everyday personal growth and offer the opportunity to develop your career globally. At IKEA we have a vibrant culture where ideas are heard, where there is opportunity to learn new skills and where the goal always is "to create a better everyday life for the many people". We give down-to-earth, straightforward people the possibility to grow, both as individuals and in their professional roles. We offer this position in a fast paced, truly global environment with an endless supply of challenges and development opportunities.

**Is This Role for Me?**

* Do you share IKEA’s values?
* Do you have at least 5 years' experience as a Data Engineer or equivalent?
* Are you Databricks or Fabric certified?
* Do you have deep operational knowledge of Python, SQL and PySpark?


If your answer is yes to at least three of the four statements above, then come and join us at IKEA!

 **Job Description**  

Supply Data & Analytics has the assignment to create value and enable business growth by bringing data from across IKEA together to gather actionable insights. Data & Analytics is passionate about making data, analytics and insights easily findable and explainable for the many to enable better and faster decision-making.


We work closely with our business stakeholders and form product teams that deliver cutting edge data driven solutions for our coworkers.


We work in a modern multi cloud-based environment, and you will be a part of the engineering team continuously developing and operating data products and analytical capabilities. You will be regularly involved in workshops with coworkers to harness modern data infrastructure efficiently and provide long term solutions.


Supporting a complex organisation to realise the benefits that modern data engineering can bring is at the heart of the role.


As a Data Engineer at IKEA, you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining our data infrastructure to support business needs, and decision-making processes.


Your responsibilities will include:

* Design, develop, and maintain data models (including dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, Data Vault, and Medallion architecture) to support business needs of analytics and self-service reporting across Core Business Supply.
* Design, implement, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines that integrate diverse internal and external data sources (databases, APIs, real-time streams) into IKEAs data platforms.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, architects, analysts, data product leaders, and data scientists to translate complex supply chain and business requirements into scalable, performant, and well-governed data models and solutions.
* Establish, promote, and enforce data engineering best practices, including data modelling standards, data quality, version control, testing, monitoring, documentation, and metadata management.
* Optimise data models and pipelines for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency across batch and real-time processing.
* Ensure data is stored, processed, and accessed securely, with full adherence to data governance, privacy, and compliance standards.
* Contribute to the development and adoption of reusable frameworks, components, and semantic layers that accelerate data product delivery and increase consistency across the organisation.
* Stay current with emerging data engineering technologies and practices, applying them where they create clear business value.
* Promote a culture of data sharing, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement while guiding and developing less experienced coworkers through mentoring, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.


In this role you will report to our Data Engineering Manager within Data & Technology at IKEA Supply.


The role is office based, with flexibility to work from home where required.

 **Qualifications**  

We are on the journey to transform our digital capabilities, bringing core business processes, people & data & technology together - an enabler for IKEA to become an even better home furnishing company in the future. A journey that needs passionate people who embrace change, dare to question, and want to make a difference. If that sounds like you, come and join us. Together we can do great things.


We believe that our new colleague in Data Engineering should have at least 5 years' experience in designing, building, implementing and operating data pipelines that collect, manage, and convert raw data into usable information, with a high industry standard as well as excellent knowledge of SQL, Python and PySpark.


In addition, excellent working knowledge of Databricks, with Associate Data Engineer or Professional Data Engineer certification is crucial. It would also be beneficial to have knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, ideally with DP-600 or DP-700 certification.


The ideal applicant has good communication and collaboration skills and will be a team player who takes ownership, builds cross-functional relationships with coworkers, and loves sharing knowledge. You are a curious problem solver who wants to keep learning in a dynamic global environment. The role is office based so meeting face to face and working collaboratively to solve problems should be something you enjoy.


The IKEA culture and values are crucial for our business and day to day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more regarding our values and life at IKEA here.


If you are passionate about data engineering, thrive in a collaborative environment, and want to contribute to the success of a global furniture retailer, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Join us as we continue to innovate and shape the future of our industry.

 **Additional Information** **We look forward to receiving your application in English.** Please note that we will be interviewing continuously, which means that we may close the application process earlier than stated if we find the right candidate. **This position will be based in** **Älmhult, Sweden.****We regret that we are unable to handle applications made by e-mail.** We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, but no later than **22 Oct. 2026**.


For more information about the position, please contact **Hiring Manager Håkan Almblad, Data Engineering Manager** at hakan.almblad@inter.ikea.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact **People & Culture Specialist Katie Pettersson at** katie.pettersson2@inter.ikea.com.


At IKEA we believe that we’re better when we’re physically together for collaboration, dialogues and conversations. We believe in the power of human interactions; the informal chats, the energy, belonging and creativity generated by people being in the same place. Our approach is that we spend majority of our time in the IKEA workplace and with flexibility to work from home when relevant.

title: AWS Cloud Engineer
description:
**About the role**
------------------


At 0TO9 (Zero to Nine) you’ll build the cloud foundation behind the licensed financial companies we start & scale. Every new venture lands on this platform, in a regulated market where resilience, security and evidence matter as much as speed. It’s a chance to shape that foundation while it’s still young enough to shape.


The role covers three areas:

* **The organisation layer.** Design and run our AWS landing zone with AWS Control Tower and AWS Organizations: guardrails, service control policies, and preventive and detective controls enforced from the top and applied the same way to every account.
* **The venture layer.** Create new accounts for new ventures and roll out our infrastructure blueprint in each one, so every venture goes from an empty account to production-grade hosting the same way, every time.
* **Resilience and compliance.** Define recovery objectives (RTO and RPO) for every critical service, build disaster recovery that meets them, and prove it with recurring tests. Keep the platform compliant with DORA, and be the person who walks auditors and supervisors through our controls and the evidence behind them.


You’ll work closely with our CTO and CISO on a daily basis.


Day to day you will:

* Build and evolve our infrastructure as code in AWS CDK (TypeScript), reviewed and deployed through pipelines, never by hand.
* Run containerised .NET microservices on ECS Fargate, with RDS (SQL Server and PostgreSQL), S3 and DynamoDB behind them.
* Own identity and access: Okta as our identity provider, federated into IAM Identity Center for SSO, with least-privilege roles and no long-lived keys.
* Run the security baseline across every account: centralised logging, threat detection, configuration compliance, WAF at the edge, KMS encryption everywhere.
* Run recurring disaster recovery and restore tests against our recovery objectives, and turn the results into evidence an auditor can follow.
* Run recurring compliance checks, so we know we’re still compliant between audits rather than finding out during one.
* Keep cost visible: budgets, anomaly detection and tagging, so a surprise on the bill shows up as an alert rather than at month-end.
* Work with security, compliance and risk to turn regulatory requirements, DORA included, into controls that are built, tested and documented.

**How we build**
----------------


Agentic coding is our default, not an experiment. Across the group, we run a Claude-Code-native workspace:

* Engineering standards loaded as a skill, so agents apply them automatically.
* A git-backed knowledge base that agents read and extend.
* Agent workflows that take a change from branch to reviewed PR, infrastructure included.
* An automated reviewer in CI that counts as an approving review on a pull request.


We’re looking for someone who already works this way and makes agents a normal part of how they build, including against live cloud accounts, with the judgement to know when a change needs a human eye first.

**About you**
-------------


We think you’ll be a great fit if you:

* Have hands-on experience designing and running production workloads on AWS, ideally across many accounts.
* Have built or operated an AWS landing zone with Control Tower or Organizations, SCPs, account vending and centralised security accounts.
* Write infrastructure as code by default. CDK is preferred; Terraform or CloudFormation is welcome.
* Take ownership, challenge unclear requirements, and put reliability and security ahead of shortcuts.
* Can explain a control to an engineer and to an auditor, and know the difference between configuring a control and evidencing it.
* Already lean on LLMs and agentic tools daily, and see them as leverage, not a shortcut.

**Technical Requirements**
--------------------------


We build on AWS, with .NET and SQL on the backend. This role lives in the platform, and AWS is a requirement.

### **Cloud & Infrastructure**

* AWS-native: Organizations, Control Tower, ECS/Fargate, RDS, S3, least-privilege IAM.
* Infrastructure as code: CDK in TypeScript, with stacks you can diff, review and roll back.
* Multi-account by design: environments separated by account, not by naming convention.
* EU data residency: you know why region matters, and how to enforce it rather than hope for it.

### **Security & Compliance**

* Security by default: WAF, encryption at rest and in transit, customer-managed KMS keys where it matters.
* Zero hardcoded secrets: Secrets Manager with rotation, always.
* Detection that leads somewhere: GuardDuty, Security Hub and Config, with every finding routed to an owner.
* Audit-ready: organisation CloudTrail, log retention by design, and every change traceable to a reviewed PR.

### **Resilience & Operations**

* Disaster recovery: RTO and RPO defined per service, DR designs that meet them, and tests on a schedule that prove it.
* Backup and restore: AWS Backup, cross-region copies, and restores rehearsed rather than assumed.
* Observability: CloudWatch and Datadog, with alarms that reach a human.
* Cost control: budgets, anomaly detection and cost allocation tags.

### **Delivery & Quality**

* CI/CD fluency: GitHub Actions and CDK Pipelines, or equivalent.
* Reviewable PRs: small diffs, no self-merges, no console changes in production.
* Tested infrastructure: unit-tested constructs and synthesised templates.
* Supply-chain hygiene: dependency and image scanning before ship.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Knowledge of DORA and how it works in practice: ICT risk management, resilience testing, third-party risk and incident reporting.
* Previous fintech or banking industry experience. You’ll ramp faster in a regulated market.
* AWS certifications, for example Solutions Architect Professional or Security Specialty.
* Experience with event-driven platforms (ideally NATS), or with hosting AI workloads on Amazon Bedrock.

description:

Vi arbetar tvärfunktionellt och genom hela produktens livscykel – från kravhantering och design till leverans och förvaltning.
