 SAP Finance & Project Management Consultant
 



**Location:** 
 Sweden / Hybrid
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full-Time / Contract
 



**Experience:** 
 8–12+ Years (Preferred)
 


 About the Role
 
 We are looking for an experienced
 **SAP Finance & Project Management Consultant** 
 with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance, SAP FICO, project delivery, and stakeholder management.
 



 The ideal candidate will combine SAP functional knowledge with project management capabilities to successfully deliver SAP implementations, migrations, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**SAP Finance & Functional Expertise** 



* Lead SAP Finance implementation, configuration, and optimization activities.
* Work with SAP FI/CO modules, including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), and Controlling (CO).
* Support SAP S/4HANA Finance implementation and migration projects.
* Manage financial integration with SAP MM, SD, and other business modules.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP functional solutions.
* Support financial reporting, reconciliation, testing, and month-end/year-end closing processes.



**Project Management & Delivery** 



* Manage end-to-end SAP projects, including planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery.
* Coordinate project timelines, budgets, resources, risks, and dependencies.
* Lead SAP implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation initiatives.
* Apply SAP Activate methodology and Agile/Waterfall project management approaches.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, technical teams, and external vendors.
* Manage UAT, cutover planning, go-live readiness, and hypercare support.
* Ensure project deliverables meet business objectives, quality standards, and agreed timelines.



**Stakeholder & Business Management** 



* Act as the primary point of contact between business teams and SAP delivery teams.
* Conduct workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, and solution discussions.
* Provide regular project status reports to senior management.
* Identify process improvements and opportunities for automation.


 Required Skills
 * Strong hands-on experience with SAP FI/CO and SAP S/4HANA Finance.
* Proven experience managing SAP implementation or transformation projects.
* Understanding of financial processes, accounting principles, and SAP integrations.
* Experience with SAP Activate, Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall methodologies.
* Knowledge of SAP data migration, testing, cutover, and deployment activities.
* Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams and cross-functional teams.


 Preferred Qualifications
 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, IT, Business Administration, or a related field.
* SAP S/4HANA Finance certification.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification.
* Experience in international or large-scale SAP transformation programs.
* Experience with SAP Fiori, SAP Analytics, and financial reporting solutions.


 Expected Deliverables
 * Successful delivery of SAP Finance projects within agreed scope, timelines, and budget.
* Stable and optimized SAP financial processes.
* Effective stakeholder coordination and project governance.
* High-quality documentation, testing, and deployment readiness.
* Continuous improvement of SAP Finance operations and business processes.

title: Vice President of Software Engineering
description:
Sinch’s vision is to connect every business with every customer, everywhere in the world. More than 200,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.
 



 Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.
 



 At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!
 



  





**DESCRIPTION** 




 Sinch's APIs move billions of messages, calls, and emails for developers around the world. We're looking for a VP of Platform Engineering to own the platform they all live in and to make Sinch the easiest place for the next wave of AI agents to integrate with. This is a critical leadership role reporting directly to our Chief Product Officer (CPO).
 



 You will lead a ~30-person organization responsible for the Sinch Build Platform, the horizontal foundation for our Voice, Messaging, Email, and Applications products. This is a unique opportunity to solve complex technical challenges, unify the developer and agentic experience across our entire portfolio, and provide the senior technical leadership needed to mentor the team. Your success will be pivotal in driving our AI-first transformation and shaping the future of global customer communication.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead AI-First Innovation: Champion AI-first engineering practices and workflows, actively exploring the adoption of AI-assisted development tools to accelerate team productivity.
* Define & Own the Technical Strategy: Establish the technical vision and roadmap for the entire portfolio. Agentic and developer experience, Sinch Build Platform, covering identity, customer/account models, developer tooling, documentation, and API connectivity.
* Cultivate Engineering Excellence: Lead, grow, and nurture a distributed engineering organization of ~30 people with 3 direct reports (Engineering Managers), building a high-performing culture with strong technical guidance.
* Deliver Coherent Experiences: Create one coherent, world-class experience for developers and AI agents across all Sinch products, simplifying a complex, inherited, and fragmented platform landscape.
* Establish Effective Governance: Define the operating model for how your Platform team partners with key stakeholders across our various global Product Areas, driving adoption and platform reuse through trust and collaboration.
* Partner for Product Impact: Work closely with Product leadership to translate platform investment into measurable business outcomes like faster onboarding and reduced integration friction.



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 



* Proven Engineering Leadership: A senior engineering executive who has successfully built and led multi-team engineering organizations (with managers reporting to you), managing budgets, hiring, and strategic resourcing.
* Developer Platform Expertise: Deep experience working with developer-facing products like APIs, SDKs, and developer portals. You measure success by outcome, active adoption, and developer satisfaction rather than just delivery milestones.
* Hands-on Tech & AI Credibility: Solid understanding of modern platform technologies, IAM systems, and API connectivity. Experience with or a strong strategic interest in agentic AI (such as MCP servers, tool-calling design, and agentic integrations) is highly valued.
* Collaborative Change Agent: A humble, highly collaborative leader capable of navigating a complex stakeholder environment and driving technical transformation through influence and credibility.
* Location & Presence: This role is based in Stockholm, Sweden on a hybrid model. Candidates must be local or willing to relocate to Stockholm to collaborate closely with the core team.
* Language Proficiency: Our corporate language is English; please submit your application in English.



  





**OUR HIRING PROCESS** 




 We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.
 



 We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!
 



 Salary:
 



  





 The monthly gross salary for this position is between SEK 125,000 to SEK 170,000 monthly. This position is also eligible for an annual performance-based bonus.
 



 Factors which may affect pay within this range may include skills, education, experience, and other qualifications. The overall budget remains flexible for an exceptional, SVP-level candidate.

title: Field Engineering Manager, Specialist Solutions Architects - Nordics
description:
(FEQ327R582)
   

  

 The Specialist Solutions Architect Manager will lead a team of Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA’s) responsible for key elements of the technical sales cycle. You will grow and develop a dynamic team with expertise in areas including enterprise software, data engineering, and data science/machine learning, who will continue to deepen their knowledge of Databricks as the platform expands. You will guide and get involved to enhance your team's effectiveness; be an expert at communicating complex, business value-focused solutions; support complex sales cycles and customer architectures; and build relationships with key stakeholders in large corporations.
   

  

 The SSA Team is engaged in our most important and complex customer engagements, providing deep technical expertise to both new and existing customers. Your team provides specialist expertise to the Solution Architect (SA) and Sales teams, which are responsible for developing and overseeing the overall technical account strategy.
   

  

 Reporting to Director, Field Engineering.
   

  

**The Impact You Will Have**
* You will hire, train, and grow a diverse team of Specialist Solutions Architects for Databricks, a company in hyper-growth mode
* Exceed your region's consumption targets - by working with your cross-functional counterparts to determine where to deploy your team of technical experts to drive the most critical use cases forward
* Make your customers extremely successful with Databricks and provide outsized value to their businesses
* Establish relationships across the business to make your customers and team successful
* Grow Databricks Platform usage and prevent churn in strategic accounts by overseeing and retiring a regional growth quota
* Create positive morale for the team and help foster a working relationship between Field Engineering, Sales, and other important internal partners
* Help resolve customer questions and concerns on accounts and opportunities deemed strategic by Sales and Pre-sales field leadership
* Act in a supportive manager capacity, including handling escalations, mentoring team members, building a career path for the assigned team members, etc.


**What We Look For**
* 5+ years of experience leading Data & AI Engineering teams, technical pre-sales and/or post-sales teams, with a proven track record in the management of elite technical individual contributors.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in developing data solutions with highly technical platforms (e.g., distributed computing, cloud data warehousing, MLOps, Generative AI infrastructure).
* Strong skillset in technical discovery, architecture design validation, structured proof-of-concept (POC/MVP) management, and value-selling frameworks.
* Trusted advisor to technical executives who guide strategic data infrastructure decisions
* Team player, but able to challenge and define priorities.
* Self-starter, challenger, strategic planner & analytical thinker.
* Experience hiring qualified candidates, ramping them up to be successful, and promoting into larger roles.
* Experience working with other teams such as Sales, Product Management, and Forward Deployed Engineering teams.


 Note: Preferred location to hire is in Stockholm (Sweden) given the current team distribution. We can consider candidates based in the Nordics region (Sweden, Denmark & Finland) on the basis that they are flexible for a higher level of travel required in the role.

 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Head of Data
description:
Ready for your next challenge?
   

  

 Bannerflow's vision is to become the leading Creative Intelligence Platform, helping enterprise brands predict, create and optimize advertising across every channel. What turns that vision into a powerful product is data. Every campaign, creative and impression on our platform generates a signal, and our data platform is how we turn that signal into intelligence our customers can act on. That same data foundation powers the next generation of our product: AI and agentic capabilities that predict performance, recommend the next move and optimize campaigns automatically. We are now increasing our investments in the data function that sits at the centre of this, and we are looking for a Head of Data to lead it.
   

  

 At Bannerflow, we build empowered and autonomous teams based on trust. We bring the energy of a fast-moving company together with the stability of a proven product and a strong enterprise customer base. You will join a team where ambitions are high, while we make sure to have plenty of fun along the way. We challenge ourselves, learn together, and celebrate what we achieve as a team.
   

  

 Are you + Bannerflow = true?
   

  

 We are looking for a Head of Data to lead and develop our Data function, spanning Data Platform, Product Data, Data Science and Analytics & BI. Today the Data team is small and recently established, around 3-4 specialists, who have built a production data platform and shipped our first Creative Intelligence capabilities. Your mandate is to build on that foundation and scale it.
   

  

 You will set the strategic and technical direction, ensuring we have the people, architecture and capabilities needed to turn data into better products, customer and commercial value, and better internal decision-making. You will stay close to the work, guiding architecture, data modeling and complex data decisions while building the capabilities and ways of working that enable the team and our data solutions to mature and scale.
   

  

 You will have full staff responsibility for the Data team, including team and capacity planning, hiring, performance and competence development. Reporting directly to our VP of Technology, you will be part of the Tech Leadership Team alongside our Chief Architect, Engineering Managers and Head of Delivery, helping shape the direction, priorities and development of Technology.
   

  

**You Will**
* Lead and grow the Data team, creating an environment of trust, autonomy and accountability through coaching, recruitment, career development and clear ways of working.
* Own Bannerflow’s data strategy and priorities, translating company, product and commercial objectives into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes.
* Enable Product and the business through data, acting as a Data counterpart for Product Managers, Tech and business stakeholders, and coordinating data planning and priorities across domains.
* Ensure we have the right data architecture, setting technical direction and guiding architecture, data modeling and design together with specialists across Data and Tech.
* Build our Data Science and AI capabilities, enabling valuable use cases to move from exploration into product experiences, customer intelligence and measurable business impact.
* Drive analytics and data adoption, ensuring trusted and accessible data for BI, company KPIs, analytics and self-service decision-making across Bannerflow, while improving data literacy and adoption across the organization.
* Own data governance and technology direction, ensuring appropriate quality, ownership, security and responsible use of data and AI, while guiding tooling, investments, vendors and build-vs-buy decisions.
* Contribute to Technology’s strategic direction as part of the Tech Leadership Team, taking shared ownership of organizational development and cross-functional initiatives.


 So, what are we looking for?
   

  

* Proven experience leading and developing people within Data or a related area, with the ability to build high-performing teams and enable specialists to perform at their best.
* A substantial hands-on data background, with enough technical depth in data modeling and architecture, with a broad understanding of Data Science and BI/Analytics, to effectively facilitate design discussions, guide specialists and challenge solutions.
* The ability to set direction and priorities, navigate ambiguity and drive long-term initiatives while balancing strategic needs with practical execution.
* A clear, informed point of view on how AI is changing data work itself, with a genuine interest in applying AI best practices to raise the productivity, quality and speed of the Data team, not just treating AI as a future product capability.
* A product and business mindset, with experience using data in product development, translating customer and organizational needs into data capabilities and connecting those initiatives to measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to act as a trusted data advisor, build alignment and enthusiasm across Product, Tech and the wider business, and make complex topics understandable.
* Fluent in English and Swedish, and eligible to work full-time in Stockholm without restrictions.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, data science or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.


 Not sure you check all the boxes? Apply anyway!
   

  

 Why join us?
   

  

 Our product vision depends on data, and the function behind it is still taking shape. You get the mandate to build on what is already in place: a small team, real influence, and a seat in the Tech Leadership Team from day one.
   

  

 We live our values of passion, collaboration and challenge in everything we do. We offer a hybrid work setup, competitive compensation including ITP1 pension, health allowance, parental leave top-up and private health care insurance.
   

  

 We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, welcoming applicants from all backgrounds, experiences and abilities.
   

  

 If you are ready to lead and shape how data creates value at Bannerflow, we would love to hear from you.

 Build your career at the company shaping the Nordic SAP market.
   

  

 Pearl is the Nordic pure-play SAP leader, with 16 offices across 9 countries. Banks, retailers, industrial groups and public sector organisations choose Pearl when SAP must be done right. The market is moving into the cloud, data and AI era. Pearl leads this shift and through Pearl Accelerate, you join it.
   

  

 Through Pearl Accelerate, we are shaping the SAP application consultants of the future. You start with a shared SAP foundation course, together with Accelerates across our countries. Then you specialize in the track that fits you. You learn inside real client work, at a company whose customers stay for years.
   

  

 Pearl Sverige has offices in Stockholm, Göteborg and Malmö. You join the office closest to you and work with colleagues in your own business area and with clients across Sweden. Expect travel outside Sweden when assignments or events require it. You need fluent Swedish and English, written and spoken.
   

  

****What You Get****
* End-to-end involvement: At Pearl, you are a part of the entire project journey, making a tangible impact.
* An inspiring team: Work with passionate colleagues in a fun, success-driven environment
* Development and innovation: Pearl invests in you through training, certifications, and conferences, ensuring you stay ahead of the curve.
* International fellowship: Experience shared kickoffs and activity trips.

 SAP Finance

* Minimum two years in finance, for example as controller, project controller or functional accountant
* Solid understanding of accounting, closing processes, cash management and invoice handling. Accounting skills are required.
* Experience with accounting systems and process improvement. You understand how systems work.
* Hands-on experience analyzing financial data, for example in budgeting, forecasting or reporting, using Excel or similar tools.
* Interested in data analysis. You enjoy finding patterns, questioning numbers and turning them into insight.
* Interested in AI tools and hands-on use of them, for example in your work, studies or projects.
* Industry experience for example Retail (incl. grocery), Wholesale and distribution, Consumer products and manufacturing (incl. food), or Pharma/Life sciences


 Additional merits: ERP system experience or superuser role. SAP knowledge.
   

  

 SAP Logistics
   

  

 Education: Bachelor's degree in logistics, sales, service, supply chain, business management or a related field.
   

  

**Skills And Experience:**
* Minimum two years in SCM/supply chain, sales or within procurement of indirect and/or direct materials, replenishment solutions, contract management or similar.
* SCM/supply chain: Familiarity with logistics or supply chain systems and processes, with a solid grasp of system setup and coordination
* Sales Experience: Background in product management, business development or inside sales, including workshops, product demos and delivery follow-up.
* Procurement experience: Knowledge of masterdata, especially products and suppliers.
* Industry experience for example Retail (incl. grocery), Wholesale and distribution, Consumer products and manufacturing (incl. food), or Pharma/Life sciences
* Interested in AI tools and hands-on use of them, for example in your work, studies or projects.


 Additional merits: Experience with logistics systems (SAP, Visma, Microsoft, etc.). System configuration or superuser experience is meritorious. SAP Knowledge.
   

  

 SAP Technology
   

  

 Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or related field. Vocational education combined with relevant experience is also considered.
   

  

**Skills And Experience:**
* Hands-on experience building with AI, for example using AI agents, copilots or LLM APIs to design, generate and test code in your work, studies or projects. AI experience is required.
* A solid programming foundation in at least one modern language, for example Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or C#.
* Experience building or integrating applications, for example APIs, web front-ends, databases or cloud services.
* Familiarity with modern development practices such as Git, CI/CD and automated testing.
* Interested in problem solving. You enjoy letting AI do the heavy lifting while you design the solution, question the output and make sure it’s right.
* Interested in how technology creates business value for clients.


 Additional merits: End-to-end integrations, EDI integrations, cloud platforms (e.g. SAP BTP, Azure or AWS), automation scripting. SAP knowledge.

* Enthusiastic
* Proactive
* Solution oriented

title: Head of Product and Technology
description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Ventures and New Business at Scania have a key role in contributing to this vision. We drive the industry transformation: At Ventures and New Business we develop complementing solutions to our core and build new growth through ventures and investments. Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 Scania is taking autonomous transport from pilots to commercial deployment, and we do it together with autonomy partners rather than by building the full technology stack ourselves. Scania owns the customer relationship and the definition of what the solution must be, and partners bring the driving technology.
   

  

 As Head of Product & Technology you own what the autonomous solution must be. The role is externally focused by design, built around customers and autonomy partners rather than internal engineering. You own the product definition, the requirements that partners must meet, and the acceptance bar that says a solution is good enough to deploy. In practice you act as the bridge between customer reality and the partner stacks that build against it.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

  

* Develop a deep understanding of customer operations, use cases, and customer TCO and TOE to define where the autonomous solution creates value.
* Own the autonomous product definition and the solution requirements baseline, covering functional, performance, safety, and scalability requirements, written as the specification partners must meet rather than an internal build list.
* Own the technical partner integration strategy and decide which partners can technically deliver the solution and how their stacks integrate.
* Own the acceptance and maturity bar, including the definition of demo-ready versus production-ready.
* Own the customer-facing solution roadmap.
* Define deployment-ready reference architectures and lead technical readiness reviews for customer deployments.
* Own end-to-end traceability from requirements to validation evidence, and hand that evidence to Safety for the safety case.
* Secure scalability across multiple autonomy partners and operational design domains (ODDs).
* Line-manage the Safety Manager while preserving safety independence, so that a safety no-go can be raised to the Managing Director without passing through this role.
* Maintain the technical interface to TRATON Group Product Management and Group R&D.


 Who You Are
   

  

 We believe you are externally oriented and comfortable working in the space between customer reality and partner technology, and you can hold a firm technical line without owning the engineering yourself. You likely bring:
   

  

  

* 10+ years in product management, systems engineering, autonomous systems, or technical leadership in complex environments.
* Proven experience translating customer, market, and stakeholder needs into clear, traceable solution requirements.
* Strong understanding of autonomous systems, connected services, or industrial digital solutions.
* Experience selecting and managing third-party technology partners and integrating their stacks.
* Ability to define a value proposition tied to solution functionality and feature maturity.
* Strong experience with verification and validation governance.
* Experience from live operational deployment environments.
* Understanding of functional safety principles (ISO 26262, SOTIF) and cybersecurity requirements.
* Master's degree in Engineering.


 We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.
   

  

 This Is Us
   

  

 Autonomous Solutions enables Scania customers to succeed in an autonomous world. We are a small team with a large mandate, which means every person carries real ownership and works directly with customers, autonomy partners, and colleagues across Scania and TRATON. Decisions are close, the problems are concrete, and what we define here becomes the standard for how Scania deploys autonomous solutions with partners.
   

  

 Scania Offers
   

  

 We offer you the chance to be part of an organization that is focused on reaching Scania’s targets and to truly drive the industry transformation. People who work here have the motivation and desire to constantly make things better.
   

  

 We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.
   

  

 With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
   

  

 Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families.
   

  

 Application
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
   

  

 Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-09-08. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
   

  

 If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Jonas Hernlund, Head of Autonomous & Supply Chain, jonas.hernlund@scania.com or 0734 27 98 80
   

  

 We look forward to your application!

**Din nya utmaning**
 Hos oss kommer du att driva komplexa och betydelsefulla integrationsprojekt – ofta på uppdrag av FMV eller andra kunder inom försvarsindustrin och myndigheter. Projekten kan omfatta design, konstruktion, produktion, installation och driftsättning av IT-system på Försvarsmaktens plattformar såsom fartyg, båtar, fordon eller containrar. Din förmåga att navigera i försvarsrelaterade processer och regelverk blir en central framgångsfaktor.
   

  

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
* Leda och samordna projekt från koncept till implementering, inklusive planering, genomförande och uppföljning.
* Projektleda större projekt med flera delprojekt.
* Coacha och agera som mentor för yngre projektledare.
* Arbeta nära kunder och intressenter för att säkerställa att projektleveranser uppfyller krav och förväntningar.
* Stötta i befintliga projekt.
* Hantera resurser, budgetar och tidsramar för att optimera projektets framdrift.
* Identifiera och hantera risker samt utveckla strategier för att minimera påverkan på projektet.


**Vi söker dig med**
* Relevant utbildning inom teknik, projektledning eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
* Flerårig (7+år) erfarenhet av projektledning, inom försvarssektorn.
* God förståelse för försvarsrelaterade processer och regelverk.
* Utmärkta ledarskaps- och kommunikationsfärdigheter.
* Erfarenhet av att mentorera och coacha kollegor.
* Förmåga att arbeta under press och hantera komplexa situationer.


 Resor i tjänsten förekommer. Körkort för personbil är ett krav. Du talar och skriver flytande på svenska och engelska.
   

  

**Lär känna oss**
 På MilDef blir du en del av ett företag som värdesätter praktiskt engagemang, gemenskap och utveckling av ledande försvarsteknik. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla nya färdigheter, bidra i tvärfunktionella projekt och göra en konkret skillnad för vår fortsatta framgång. Vi uppmuntrar kontinuerligt lärande, samarbete, och erbjuder goda möjligheter till karriärutveckling. Vi är stolta över att aktivt främja hälsa och balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Det gör vi bland annat genom att erbjuda attraktiva förmåner samt hälsofrämjande initiativ.
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om MilDef, våra produkter och vår kultur? Läs mer här MilDef.com
   

  

 För mer information om rollen, vänligen kontakta Olise Andersson, Talent Acquisition Specialist.
   

  

**Viktig information**
 Vi genomför drogtester på alla våra framtida kollegor innan anställning.
   

  

 På grund av verksamhetens karaktär kan anställning, oavsett befattning, förutsätta bakgrunds- och säkerhetsrelaterade kontroller.
   

  

***MilDef - WE ARMOR IT.***
*MilDef is a global systems integrator and full-spectrum provider specializing in rugged IT for military, government and critical infrastructure sectors. MilDef provides hardware, software, and services that shield and protect critical information streams and systems, when and where the stakes are the highest. MilDef’s products are sold to more than 200 customers through companies in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, the United States and Australia, and through partner networks in more than 40 countries. MilDef was founded in 1997 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2021.*

title: IT-supporttekniker till kommun i Stockholm
description:
Vill du arbeta i en viktig supportfunktion där du hjälper medarbetare att få sin digitala vardag att fungera? Nu söker vi på uppdrag av en kommun i Stockholmsområdet en serviceinriktad och lösningsorienterad IT-supporttekniker för ett uppdrag med omgående start.
   

  

 I rollen blir du en del av kommunens interna servicedesk och arbetar nära användarna med support och felsökning i deras dagliga IT-miljö.
   

  

 Om uppdraget
   

  

 Som IT-supporttekniker ansvarar du för att ge stöd till kommunens medarbetare via telefon, ärendehanteringssystem, fjärrsupport och personliga besök. Du hanterar en bred variation av ärenden kopplade till användarnas digitala arbetsverktyg och bidrar till en effektiv och välfungerande IT-miljö.
   

  

 Exempel på arbetsuppgifter
   

  

* Daglig support till användare inom kommunens verksamheter.
* Hantera inkommande ärenden via telefon, servicedesk och fysiska besök.
* Felsökning och support av klientdatorer.
* Installation, konfigurering och underhåll av datorer och kringutrustning.
* Support inom Microsoft 365, skrivare, mobiltelefoner och mötesutrustning.
* Dokumentation av utförda insatser och lösningar.
* Support på plats hos användare samt via fjärrverktyg.


 Vi söker dig som har
   

  

* Akademisk utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet inom IT.
* Minst två års erfarenhet som PC-tekniker eller supporttekniker.
* Goda kunskaper inom IT-hårdvara, mjukvara och klienthantering.
* Erfarenhet av Windows och Microsoft Office/Microsoft 365.
* Kunskaper inom nätverk och datakommunikation, exempelvis TCP/IP.
* Erfarenhet av skrivarhantering och annan perifer utrustning.
* God förståelse för drift- och förvaltningsverktyg, exempelvis SCCM/Configuration Manager.
* Erfarenhet av Active Directory och Group Policies eller motsvarande infrastrukturlösningar.


 Det är meriterande om du har arbetat inom kommunal verksamhet eller annan offentlig organisation.
   

  

 Personliga egenskaper
   

  

 För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är:
   

  

* Serviceinriktad och pedagogisk.
* Lösningsorienterad och strukturerad.
* Ansvarstagande och självgående.
* Kommunikativ med förmåga att skapa förtroende hos användare.
* Van att hantera flera ärenden parallellt i ett högt tempo.


 Om uppdraget
   

  

* Omfattning: Heltid 100%
* Start: Omgående
* Uppdragslängd: Till och med januari, eventuellt längre.
* Arbetstid: Måndag till torsdag kl. 08.00-17.00, fredag kl. 08.00-16.00
* Distansarbete: Begränsade möjligheter då uppdraget kräver närvaro på plats


 Ansökan
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Technical sales specialist
description:
Vill du vara en del av landslaget i informationsteknologi?
 



  





 Våra kunders investeringar i nätverk, server- och lagringslösningar är verksamhetskritiska – och kräver supportavtal i världsklass. Nu söker vi på Atea en specialistsäljare inom Technical Services som vill arbeta med att sälja, förvalta och utveckla befintliga supportavtal. Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm (Haga Norra)
 



  





 Se mer om kontoret i Solna här: https://www.atea.se/om-atea/vara-kontor/stockholm/
 



 Hos oss blir du en del av ett team som brinner för att bygga Sverige med IT, tar personligt ansvar och alltid sätter laget före jaget. Vi kallar oss stolt Landslaget i informationsteknologi.
 



  





**Din roll** 




 Som specialistsäljare inom Technical Services arbetar du främst med förvaltning och vidareutveckling av befintliga supportavtal, men även med viss nykundsförsäljning. I rollen har du ett tydligt Contract Manager-ansvar gentemot dina kunder, med kontinuerlig uppföljning och nära dialog.
 



  





 Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med:
 


* uppföljning och utveckling av supportavtal
* kostnadskalkylering och analyser
* upphandlingar och avtalsförhandlingar
* rådgivning och proaktiv dialog med kund



  





 Rollen kombinerar affärsmannaskap, struktur och detaljfokus med en rådgivande och relationsbyggande approach.
 



 Läs mer om serviceavtal och supporttjänster på hemsidan här: https://www.atea.se/mjukvara/serviceavtal/
 



  





**Vem är du?** 




 För att trivas hos oss behöver du gilla struktur, ha koll på detaljer och samtidigt drivas av att göra affärer. Du är lyhörd, relationsskapande och trygg i dialogen med kund. Har du dessutom ett intresse för siffror och analys – och gillar Excel och Power BI – är det ett stort plus.
 



  





 Du förstår värdet av att sälja helhet och effekt – inte bara enskilda produkter – och trivs i en roll där du får kombinera affärsmannaskap med långsiktigt kundvärde. Du gillar uppföljning och struktur, och är bekväm med att föra dialoger kring risk, SLA:er, kostnader och verksamhetens behov. Du motiveras av att agera rådgivare över tid och bygga förtroendefulla relationer, samtidigt som du är nyfiken på teknik utan att vara beroende av att vara den främsta experten.
 



  





 Vår bransch utvecklas snabbt, så vi ser gärna att du är nyfiken, orädd och vill lära nytt. Samtidigt är du aldrig ensam – vi stöttar varandra i teamet, har högt i tak och delar gärna med oss av kunskap och erfarenheter.
 



  





 Eftersom våra kunder finns över hela landet ingår resor i tjänsten.
 



  





**Vi tror att du känner igen dig i följande** 



* Du trivs i rollen som Trusted Advisor och arbetar proaktivt
* Du är lösningsorienterad och fungerar lika bra självständigt som i team
* Du är driven, noggrann och beredd att gräva djupt för att möta kundens behov
* Du skapar förtroende genom professionalitet, tydlighet och goda relationer



  





**För att lyckas i rollen som specialistsäljare tror vi att du har följande:** 



* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av B2B‑försäljning eller rådgivande roll inom IT/tech
* Teknisk förståelse inom IT‑infrastruktur och/eller IT‑tjänster (t.ex. nätverk, server, lagring, supportavtal)
* Erfarenhet av förhandling av avtal
* Vana vid kostnadskalkyler och affärsuppföljning
* Mycket god svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
* Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel



  





**Meriterande kompetens:** 



* Erfarenhet av publik sektor / LOU
* Erfarenhet av Contract Manager‑roll eller Trusted Advisor
* Power BI eller motsvarande analysverktyg



  





**Om Atea** 




 Visste du att Atea är den ledande leverantören av it-infrastruktur i Norden och Baltikum? I Sverige är vi runt 2700 medarbetare fördelade på 35 kontor runt om i hela landet. Vår styrka ligger i vår kombination av lokal närvaro, vårt omfattande och heltäckande erbjudande samt alla våra specialister. Tillsammans med våra kunder och partners bygger vi Sverige med it och förbättra vardagen för skolbarn, lärare, äldre, sjukvård och näringslivet. Hos oss får du vara en del av världens mest hållbara it-servicebolag, där vi är med och påskyndar omställningen mot en mer hållbar it-värld.
 



  





 På Atea blir du en del av en vardag och en kultur som präglas av framåtanda, laganda och humor. Vi har en vision om att vara "The Place to Be" – en plats där alla växer och trivs, med kollegor som bryr sig om dig, om kunderna och om samhället.
 



  





**Kontakt & mer information** 




 Välkommen med din ansökan! Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Carina Wildling, försäljningschef, via carina.wildling@atea.se. Vi hanterar ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.
 



  





 Atea vill vara The Place To Be och därför värdesätter vi de kvalitéer som en jämn ålders- och könsfördelning samt etnisk och kulturell mångfald tillför verksamheten.
 



*Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!* 




  





*Atea har samlat it-branschens största hjärtan och snabbaste hjärnor. Vi finns över hela Sverige och har över 2500 kompetenta medarbetare inom alla områden. Specialister som vet vad som krävs för att skapa konkurrenskraft inom exportindustrin, specialister som vet hur it kan bidra med bättre lärande i skolan, specialister som vet hur lokala företag kan växa med it, specialister som vill vara med och skapa vård och omsorg i världsklass.* 




**Följ oss i sociala medier**

title: Product Manager
description:
**Xensam: Join the Future of SAM**
 Xensam is the leader in AI-powered, cloud-based Software Asset Management. Our technology brings clarity to complex IT environments, helping users make smart, data-driven decisions and maximize software ROI.
   

  

 Recognized with the Highest Growth Award and ranked #3 Overall Champion at the Main Software 50 Awards Nordics, we’re scaling fast and looking for people who want to join the journey. At Xensam, you play a key role in a team built on energy, focus, and positivity. We value experience, but even more, the person behind it.
   

  

 Together, we build the future of SAM.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As our Product Manager at Xensam, you’ll own the delivery and evolution of our product. You’ll drive execution, ensure roadmap delivery, and align product, engineering, and business teams.
   

  

 You’re both strategic and hands-on, balancing long-term vision with daily execution. You turn customer and business needs into actionable plans, deliver quality releases, and continuously improve how we work as a team and your role evolve.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who thrives in an evolving and growing team, enjoys building structure, and takes pride in turning complex challenges into clear, impactful outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 You will drive quality, structure, and efficiency across teams. You will play a key role in ensuring smooth collaboration between engineering, QA, and operations. Furthermore, you will also own and prioritize the product backlog, defining clear motivation and acceptance criteria.
   

  

**Other Responsibilities That You Will Have**
* Ensure roadmap delivery on time and to quality, managing dependencies and cross-team coordination.
* Drive team priorities and workflow, maintaining execution efficiency and visibility in tooling.
* Oversee the entire product lifecycle - from ideation and definition to release validation and post-deployment quality.
* Collaborate with QA and Support to triage issues and balance roadmap progress, technical debt, and bug fixes.
* Gather and integrate customer and business feedback into actionable roadmap decisions.
* Partner with leadership to define and refine the roadmap for your sub-products.
* Validate delivered features to ensure alignment with product goals and user expectations.
* Contribute to cross-product collaboration, ensuring alignment with the broader platform architecture and vision.
* Act as a key bridge between business, engineering, and operations to maintain alignment and momentum.
* Help define future ways of working across product and engineering teams.
* Support hiring, onboarding, and organizational scaling as Xensam continues to grow.


**Qualifications**
* 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with proven success in B2B SaaS.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of agile delivery and end-to-end product ownership.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills across technical and non-technical teams.
* Data-driven mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and delivery predictability.
* Ability to prioritize, organize, and execute in a dynamic, fast-growing environment.


**Bonus points if you**
* Have experience in SAM/ITAM.
* Experience with AI enablement as a meaningful product feature
* Experience with Data centric platforms


**What You Get**
* A generous work culture with free drinks and snacks, office massages, and more.
* Three days in-office (with remote work on Mondays and Fridays).
* An opportunity to shape your career growth while contributing to the company’s success.
* A dynamic position embracing "freedom under responsibility".
* If sales targets are met, all employees enjoy an annual destination trip.
* Other location-specific benefits.


**Our values at Xensam**
**Rebellious**
 We challenge the norm and act with initiative – always with responsibility.
   

  

**Humane**
 We foster a caring, inclusive environment that values diversity and respects individuality.
   

  

**Harmony**
 We value balance and create a supportive workplace where people thrive.
   

  

 As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on final candidates to fulfill our commitments to customers and ensure a safe work environment.
   

  

 Xensam is the leading provider of AI-powered Software Asset Management technology. Designed to provide SAM Managers and IT Leaders with valuable data, our platform offers a wealth of features to simplify SAM workloads with built-in automation and advanced functionality. We prioritize ease of use and industry-leading security for both On-premise and Cloud software, putting organizations in total control of their hybrid IT environments.

title: Brand System & Tool Manager – Creative Studio
description:
Are you passionate about turning brand knowledge, technology and AI into simple, smart solutions that make it easier for people to create great communication?
   

  

 Do you enjoy connecting the bigger picture, seeing how systems, tools and workflows can work together – while also moving quickly from idea to implementation?
   

  

 Creative Studio is looking for a Brand System & Tool Manager who will play a key role in our transformation from a traditional in-house production team into a Brand System Team.
   

  

 You will help us build a connected ecosystem where brand knowledge, technology, AI, tools and workflows work together – enabling people across If to create high-quality, consistent and on-brand content, efficiently and at scale.
   

  

 Our ambition is simple: make it easy to do the right thing – on brand.
   

  

**About If Creative Studio**
 Creative Studio is If’s Nordic in-house creative production team. We are now taking the next step, evolving into a Brand System Team that makes it easier for the whole organisation to create consistent, high-quality communication.
   

  

 Our ambition is simple: make it easy to do the right thing – on brand.
   

  

 To get there, we are building a connected Brand System where brand knowledge, technology, AI, tools and workflows work together. Instead of relying on people to remember every brand guideline, we want to build more of that knowledge directly into the tools and experiences they use every day.
   

  

 As AI changes how content is created, our role is changing too. Creative Studio will increasingly turn brand knowledge into practical tools, intelligent assistants, templates, automated workflows and self-service solutions that help both people and technology work consistently with our brand.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Brand System & Tool Manager, you will join Creative Studio’s Production & Efficiency team and play an important part in shaping our future If Brand System.
   

  

 You will help connect our technology, tools and workflows into an ecosystem that makes content creation simpler, smarter and more consistent across If.
   

  

 This is both a strategic and hands-on role. You will look at the bigger picture, identify opportunities and help set direction, while also getting involved in implementation, testing, problem-solving and continuous improvement.
   

  

 You will work closely with Creative Studio, IT, colleagues across the business and external technology partners.
   

  

**You Will**
**What you will do**
* drive the development and continuous improvement of Creative Studio’s systems, tools and self-service solutions
* help build and maintain our If Brand System, including brand knowledge, AI-powered assistants, asset ecosystems, templates and brand governance capabilities
* identify where AI, automation and templates can make content production simpler and more effective
* act as Product Owner for selected Creative Studio platforms and tools
* work closely with IT and other teams on integrations, development and implementation
* develop solutions within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, particularly SharePoint and connected tools
* manage relationships with external technology partners and vendors, from requirements and delivery to quality and follow-up
* lead projects and improvements from idea and analysis through to implementation and adoption
* explore new technologies and turn promising opportunities into practical solutions
* monitor performance, adoption and business value, using what you learn to continuously improve our solutions
* make new tools intuitive, relevant and easy for people to use help build brand governance, quality assurance and brand knowledge into tools and workflows
* contribute to how AI agents, automation and intelligent workflows can be introduced responsibly across our If Brand System


**Who are you?**
 We are looking for someone who combines strategic and analytical thinking with curiosity and a strong ability to turn ideas into action.
   

  

 You enjoy working where technology, AI, brand and user experience meet. You are comfortable when needs and technology evolve quickly, and you can move naturally between long-term thinking and hands-on problem-solving.
   

  

 You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters is that you are curious, comfortable learning and motivated by finding better ways to make technology useful for people.
   

  

**We believe you have**
* experience in system, product or platform management
* strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 and SharePoint
* experience working with external vendors and technology partners
* experience leading projects, implementations or digital transformation initiatives
* a strong interest in AI, automation and emerging technologies, and how they can create real business value
* the ability to understand business needs and translate them into scalable technical solutions
* strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* experience working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* fluent communication skills in Swedish or Norwegian and English
* Experience with template management, brand platforms or content production systems is an advantage.


**We Would Also Value Experience With Areas Such As**
* AI-enabled products, copilots or agents
* knowledge management
* digital asset management (DAM) platforms
* workflow automation
* content ecosystems
* governance, data structures and metadata


**To succeed in this role**
 We think you will enjoy this role if you are:
   

  

*Forward-looking* 
 – you are curious about what we can improve next
   

  

*Comfortable with change* 
 – you enjoy exploring new approaches and helping turn them into better ways of working
   

  

*Action-oriented* 
 – you can move from ideas and decisions to action while keeping quality and the bigger picture in mind
   

  

*Analytical* 
 – you understand dependencies, consider alternatives and make informed decisions
   

  

*Hands-on* 
 – you enjoy getting involved and solving problems, not just defining what others should do
   

  

*Open and collaborative* 
 – you build trust and enjoy working with people who bring different perspectives and expertise
   

  

*Driven* 
 – you take ownership and help move things forward
   

  

*Systems-minded* 
 – you naturally see how people, processes, data, tools and technology connect
   

  

*A builder* 
 – you enjoy creating solutions and capabilities that can grow and create value beyond individual projects
   

  

**What We Offer**
 At If, we believe high expectations should go both ways. You will join an inclusive Nordic working environment with plenty of opportunities to learn, develop and make an impact.
   

  

 You will work at the intersection of creativity, technology, brand and AI, with the opportunity to help shape how Creative Studio and the wider organisation work in the future.
   

  

 Most importantly, you will have the chance to help build something new: a If Brand System that turns our knowledge and principles into useful tools and experiences, making it easier for people across If to create communication that feels unmistakably like us.
   

  

**Additional Facts And The Recruitment Process**
**Position type:** 
 This is a permanent position.
   

  

**Application deadline:** 
 Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is October 23, 2026.
   

  

**To apply for the position:** 
 Please attach your CV and fill in the questionnaires
   

  

**Work location:** 
 Bergshamra, Stockholm or Vaekero, Oslo
   

  

**Travelling:** 
 Travel within the Nordic region may occur
   

  

**Start:** 
 Upon agreement
   

  

 For more information, please contact Charlotte Strandberg, Head of Creative Studio Prouctions & Operations, mobile: +46709300105

title: Performance & Governance Lead, Stockholm
description:
atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.
   

  

 With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.
   

  

 Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
   

  

 We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.
   

  

 By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.
   

  

**Performance & Governance Lead, at atNorth**
 Are you an experienced leader with a strong background in performance management, governance, quality and operational excellence? Do you thrive in complex environments where customer commitments, operational risk and business priorities need to be translated into clear direction and measurable results?
   

  

 atNorth is looking for a Performance & Governance Lead to take ownership of performance, governance and continuous improvement across Customer Operations. In this role, you will combine strategic thinking with operational leadership, driving standards, insights and improvements across an international and fast-growing digital infrastructure organization.
   

  

 As Performance & Governance Lead, you will be responsible for establishing and developing the frameworks, standards and ways of working that enable Customer Operations to perform at its best. You will translate customer commitments, business objectives and operational risks into clear priorities, KPIs and improvement initiatives.
   

  

 You will lead the governance of performance, quality and incident management while working closely with key stakeholders across the organization. The role combines strategic responsibility with hands-on leadership and offers the opportunity to influence how atNorth measures performance, manages operational risk and continuously improves its customer operations.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Define and develop the Customer Operations performance and governance framework, standards and improvement roadmap.
* Translate customer commitments, business objectives and operational risks into clear priorities and OKRs.
* Lead the Nordic Operations Center operating model, including service standards and escalation routines.
* Own incident coordination, escalation, communication and follow-up standards.
* Define and govern KPIs, SLAs, scorecards, QBR insights and reporting standards.
* Drive quality management, audit readiness, process adherence and corrective-action governance.
* Govern SOPs, controls, data quality and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Lead and develop the NOC and Quality Managers, setting direction, goals and development priorities.
* Build strong capabilities in decision-making, incident leadership, communication and analytical thinking across the team.
* Align key functions around operational risks, decisions and improvement initiatives.
* Identify and escalate material risks, dependencies and resource constraints, recommending appropriate actions.


 You will also have the authority to set priorities and allocate work across the NOC and Quality Managers, direct incident coordination and stakeholder communication, and require corrective or preventive actions where service, quality, data or governance issues are identified.
   

  

 atNorth is an international and fast-growing company where collaboration, ownership and continuous improvement are key. You will work across functions and have significant influence on how Customer Operations develops and delivers value to customers. The role offers a broad scope, senior stakeholder exposure and the opportunity to make a tangible impact on operational performance and customer experience.
   

  

**Your profile:**
 We are looking for an experienced leader who combines strong operational understanding with a strategic and analytical mindset. You are comfortable establishing structure and governance in complex environments and have the confidence to influence stakeholders across functions.
   

  

 You have:
   

  

* 8–10+ years of experience within performance management, quality, governance, customer operations, analytics, NOC operations or operational excellence.
* Experience from data center, IT infrastructure, B2B technology or another complex operational environment.
* Proven leadership experience, ideally leading managers and/or multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong knowledge of KPI and SLA governance, quality management, reporting and operational performance.
* Experience with incident management, root cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Strong analytical skills and experience working with data, insights and reporting to support decision-making.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and organizational levels.
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Quality Management, Data Analytics, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Fluency in English; proficiency in Swedish is preferred.


 As a person, you are structured, analytical and decisive, with a strong sense of ownership. You are comfortable working in a dynamic environment with multiple priorities and are able to turn complex information into clear actions. You build trust easily, communicate with clarity and have the leadership skills to create direction while developing the people around you.
   

  

 Experience or certification in ISO 9001, Lean/Six Sigma, BI, data governance or analytics is considered an advantage.
   

  

**About The AtNorth Culture**
 We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.
   

  

 We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Vill du använda data och AI för att lösa affärskritiska utmaningar som påverkar miljontals kundmöten varje dag? Som Senior Data Scientist på ICA Sverige får du arbeta nära verksamheten och utveckla datadrivna lösningar för flera av ICAs verksamheter.
   

  

**Om rollen som Senior Data scientist**
 Som Senior Data Scientist kommer du att vara en nyckelspelare inom vårt Data Science-team. I din roll ansvarar du för att driva data science-projekt från konceptstadiet till produktion, samt säkerställa att lösningarna är tekniskt effektiva och i linje med verksamhetens krav. Du förväntas även vara en mentor för juniora kollegor och bidra till att höja den tekniska nivån inom teamet, men också se till att lösningarna inte bara fungerar tekniskt utan också levererar maximalt affärsvärde.
   

  

 Det betyder att du kommer att:
   

  

* Arbeta nära våra Data Engineers och verksamhetsexperter för att utveckla och implementera datadrivna lösningar.
* Agera teknisk expert i komplexa projekt, med fokus på skalbarhet och affärsnytta.
* Vara ansvarig för hela data science-flödet, från insamling och bearbetning av data till avancerad modellering och implementering.
* Arbeta med stora datamängder, identifiera användbara signaler och omsätta dessa i affärsstrategier.
* Aktivt delta i beslut om tekniska vägval och lösningsstrategier inom AI och data science.


**Vem är du?**
 Vi söker dig som har lång erfarenhet och djup kunskap inom data science och maskininlärning. Du har tidigare arbetat i seniora roller där du lett komplexa data science-projekt från idé till produktion och har erfarenhet av att arbeta med affärskritiska frågor.
   

  

 Vi ser gärna att du har:
   

  

* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av arbete som Data Scientist, med fokus på maskininlärning, AI och avancerad analys.
* Gedigen erfarenhet av att arbeta med Python, SQL och molnbaserade lösningar (gärna i GCP).
* Stark kompetens inom statistik, matematik eller datavetenskap, med dokumenterad erfarenhet av att omsätta teorier till praktiska affärsdrivna lösningar.
* Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt, DevOps, CI/CD, och andra moderna mjukvaruutvecklingskoncept.


 Som person är du analytisk, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad med ett starkt eget driv. Du har en förmåga att kommunicera och anpassa tekniska insikter till affärsnytta för både tekniska och icke-tekniska stakeholders samt delar med dig av din kunskap till mer juniora kollegor. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.
   

  

**Vad händer nu?**
 Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag då urval sker löpande, sista ansökningsdag 1/11.
   

  

 För frågor om tjänsten, kontakta rekryterande chef Ola Ottosson, ola.ottosson@ica.se och för frågor om processen, kontakta rekryterare Josefine Åsmyr, josefine.asmyr@ica.se.
   

  

 ICA ska spegla våra kunder och samhället, vi strävar därför efter att anställa människor med olika bakgrund, kompetenser, kunskap och erfarenheter. Om roller kräver det så behöver du genomgå tester, bakgrundskontroller och drogtestning innan anställning.

title: Business Developer
description:
Eleven of Finland's 21 wellbeing services counties use Sotender to fill open healthcare shifts with their own staff and external temp nurses instead of agency workers. We have signed our first Swedish customer and are now looking for the person who builds the Swedish market from here.
 



  





**Koivu and Sotender** 




  





 Koivu Solutions is a Finnish software company with long experience in product development and high maturity in AI. Sotender lets a care organization publish open shifts and reach the right workers directly, faster and, in documented cases, at significantly lower cost than agency staffing. More than 40,000 employees use the platform across some twenty client organizations in Finland. Eleven of the country's 21 wellbeing services counties are customers, and the deepest deployment covers more than 7,000 employees.
 



  





 The same product also sells to Finnish municipalities for schools and pre-schools, and to private employers in manufacturing and shipping. The underlying problem is similar everywhere: shift work, qualified roles, and shifts that have to be filled today.
 



  





 Beyond short-notice shift filling, Sotender has grown into a solution for managing temporary and flexible workforce needs. The broader solution covers areas such as internal float-pool management, planning of longer-term staffing needs, vacation planning, reporting, automation and integrations with existing HR, roster scheduling and workforce-management systems. More information about Sotender: https://sotender.io/
 



  





 Koivu is part of PubliX Group, a Nordic software group focused on the public sector. Three of its companies are Swedish: Tidvis, digiPlant and Embrace Safety.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 You establish Koivu and Sotender in the Swedish market. There is a product in production, a team in Finland and a group behind you. You build the rest.
 



  





 You help decide which segments we go after first and in what order: regions, municipalities, private care providers, or the sectors outside healthcare where we already have paying customers. You build the pipeline yourself through the first year and run direct sales and public procurement processes all the way to a signed contract. You set Swedish pricing together with product management in Finland.
 



 The first two or three Swedish customers will decide how fast the rest goes, so they should be chosen with the next customer in mind.
 



  





 If we deliver on the plan, you will have the opportunity to build a Swedish sales team in the years ahead.
 



  





**Sweden is not Finland** 




  





 The Swedish market has 21 regions and 290 municipalities instead of 21 wellbeing services counties and procurement works differently. The staffing problem is the same, the cost of agency staffing is just as politically relevant, and Sotender already has a proven track record in Finnish public healthcare. If you want a finished market with finished sales material, this is the wrong role.
 



  





**Who we are looking for** 




  





 You have sold software or technology services to the Swedish public sector, and you have done it in health and social care. That is the hard requirement. You know how LOU works in practice, who owns the budget in a region, and why a successful pilot can still die in a procurement.
 



  





 Beyond that:
 


* You have built a pipeline from zero
* You are comfortable being the only person in the country for a while, with support but without a finished structure
* You already have a relevant network in Swedish healthcare and the public sector and know which doors to open first
* You are fluent in Swedish and English. Both are required. English is the working language with Finland; Swedish is the language of the market.
* You use AI effectively in your own work and can give concrete examples of where it makes you better or faster. We will ask how.



  





**What we offer** 




  





 A mandate that is unusually broad for a sales role. You write the Swedish go-to-market plan and you execute it, with a short path to a decision.
 



  





 You do not do it alone. The Finnish team gives you the product, delivery capability and documented customer references to lean on. PubliX Group contributes office, AI, colleagues in Sweden, security and compliance. The Swedish sister companies already hold municipal relationships you can use.
 



 Compensation is a fixed salary plus a variable component tied to new sales.
 



  





**Location** 




 Stockholm or Örebro, your choice. In Stockholm you share an office with PubliX Group's head office in the city centre, in Örebro with our sister company digiPlant. Expect regular travel to Finland and to customers across Sweden.

title: Technical Sales Advisor
description:

Rollen passar dig som vill arbeta nära kunder, återförsäljare och integrationspartners samtidigt som du hjälper dem att få ut maximalt värde av Trakas lösningar för digital nyckelhantering.  Bli en del av vårt nordiska team och upplev en samarbetskultur som ger dig möjlighet att utvecklas, påverka och bygga en karriär som du kan vara stolt över.
   

  

**Vad du kommer att göra som** 
**Teknisk Rådgivare**
 Som Teknisk Rådgivare hos Traka Nordic kommer du att kombinera försäljning, teknisk rådgivning och affärsutveckling. Du arbetar nära slutkunder, återförsäljare och integrationspartners för att hjälpa dem få maximalt värde av Trakas lösningar för digital nyckelhantering. Rollen innebär stor frihet under ansvar och ger dig möjlighet att utveckla affärer, bygga långsiktiga relationer och bidra till Trakas fortsatta tillväxt på den svenska marknaden.
   

  

 Du kommer att d elta i kundmöten, produktpresentationer, mässor och branschevent samt fungera som ett tekniskt och affärsmässigt stöd i dialogen med kunder och partners.
   

  

 Du kommer att representera Traka i tekniska och kommersiella dialoger och hjälpa kunder att förstå hur våra lösningar kan bidra till en säkrare, mer effektiv och digitaliserad verksamhet.
   

  

**Du kommer också att:**
* Utveckla affärer genom att arbeta proaktivt med både befintliga och nya kunder samt identifiera nya möjligheter hos slutkunder, återförsäljare och partners.
* Bygga och stärka samarbetet med återförsäljare, integrationspartners och systemintegratörer för att öka användningen av Trakas lösningar på den svenska marknaden.
* Presentera, demonstrera och ge rådgivning kring Trakas digitala nyckelskåp, programvara och integrationslösningar samt stötta kunder vid nyinstallationer, uppgraderingar och vidareutveckling av befintliga system.
* Guida kunder och partners i användningen av våra lösningar och bidra med enklare utbildning, support och kunskapsöverföring vid behov.
* Samarbeta nära kollegor i Norden och internationellt samt planera och driva ditt arbete självständigt för att bidra till teamets gemensamma framgång.


 Rollen innebär resor inom Sverige och i genomsnitt förekommer cirka 2-3 övernattningar per månad. Du får stor frihet att själv planera dina kundbesök och skapa en effektiv vardag.
   

  

**De färdigheter och erfarenheter du behöver**
 Vi söker någon som:
   

  

* Har 2-5 års erfarenhet av försäljning eller rådgivning kring tekniska lösningar.
* Har ett genuint intresse för teknik, digitala system, mjukvara och integrationer.
* Är bekväm med att presentera, demonstrera och diskutera tekniska lösningar med kunder och partners.
* Har erfarenhet av att bygga och utveckla långsiktiga relationer med kunder, återförsäljare eller samarbetspartners.
* Har B-körkort samt goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


 Den ideala kandidaten har erfarenhet av lösningsförsäljning där teknik, mjukvara och kundnytta står i fokus, och är van att förstå och förklara hur olika system samverkar för att skapa värde för kunden. Erfarenhet från säkerhetsbranschen, exempelvis inom passersystem, CCTV, inbrottslarm, brandlarm eller systemintegrationer, ses som ett stort plus. Även erfarenhet av att arbeta genom återförsäljare, partners eller distributionsled samt kunskap om digitala nyckelskåp eller liknande lösningar är meriterande.
   

  

 Som person är du nyfiken, självgående och lösningsorienterad. Du har lätt för att skapa förtroende, tycker om att bygga långsiktiga relationer och motiveras av att kombinera teknik, kunddialog och affärsutveckling. Vi ser gärna att du är baserad i södra eller västra Sverige, exempelvis i Malmö- eller Göteborgsområdet, men rätt person och kompetens är viktigast.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder**
 Vi erbjuder fantastiska möjligheter och förmåner, så att du kan fortsätta och utveckla en livslång karriär hos oss – här är vad vi har att erbjuda:
   

  

* Möjligheter till lärande och utveckling.
* En givande arbetsplats med stort engagemang.
* Att jobba i ett härligt team i en dynamisk miljö.
* Förmånligt kollektivavtal och tjänstebil.


**Vi granskar ansökningar regelbundet, så vänta inte**
 Vi bygger mångsidiga och inkluderande team och uppmanar ansökningar från alla som kan se sig själva arbeta med oss. Skapa bara din profil och ansök här.
   

  

 För att säkerställa att din personliga information är säker, tittar vi inte på några ansökningar som skickas via e-post eller post. Om du har några frågor om rollen eller processen, skicka ett e-postmeddelande till Khalil Kabakibi, Talent Acquisition Business Partner, på Khalil.kabakibi@assaabloy.com .
   

  

 Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen för denna roll kan en bakgrundskontroll komma att genomföras. Bakgrundskontrollen genomförs med kandidatens samtycke och i enlighet med vår integritetspolicy för arbetssökande.
   

  

 Låt oss tillsammans skapa en tryggare och mer öppen värld!

**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
 Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

description:
