Nu har du chansen att bli en del av vår säkerhetsavdelning där du kommer få bedriva ett högst meningsfullt arbete som bidrar till att säkerställa att samhällsviktiga och affärskritiska verksamheter kan fungera utan avbrott.*
**Vill du stärka vår motståndskraft och säkerställa verksamhetens kontinuitet?**
 Vi söker en engagerad och strategisk Business Continuity Manager som vill ta en central roll i att utveckla, implementera och förvalta vårt program för kontinuitetshantering. I rollen ansvarar du för att säkerställa att verksamheten är förberedd att hantera störningar, kriser och oväntade händelser samtidigt som affärskritiska processer kan upprätthållas. Du blir en nyckelperson i arbetet med att stärka organisationens resiliens och bidra till trygghet för kunder, medarbetare och samarbetspartners.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Coromatics beredskapsarbete inkluderar
 **Civilt försvar** 
 vår förmåga att upprätthålla verksamheten i händelse av höjd beredskap eller krig,
 **Krisberedskap** 
 (Crisis Management) vår förmåga att upprätthålla och leda verksamheten i kris och
 **Kontinuitetshantering** 
 (Business Continuity Management) vår förmåga att upprätthålla affärskritiska leveranser trots allvarligare incidenter.
   

  

 Inom dessa områden ansvarar Business Continuity Managern för att samordna, utveckla, följa upp och förbättra organisationens förmåga att förebygga, motstå, hantera och återhämta sig från allvarliga störningar och kriser. Som Business Continuity Manager leder och samordnar du arbetet med kontinuitetsplanering på koncernnivå. Du arbetar nära verksamheten, IT, informationssäkerhet, riskhantering och ledning för att säkerställa att relevanta processer, planer och övningar finns på plats.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
 I rollen får du ett övergripande ansvar för att utveckla och stärka arbetet med Business Continuity Management (BCM). Du utvecklar, implementerar och förvaltar ramverk, policys och processer samt genomför Business Impact Analyser (BIA) och riskanalyser.
   

  

 En viktig del av rollen är att stötta verksamheten i arbetet med kontinuitets- och återställningsplaner samt att planera, genomföra och följa upp kris- och kontinuitetsövningar. Du säkerställer att arbetet bedrivs i linje med interna och regulatoriska krav samt relevanta standarder.
   

  

 Du har även en samordnande roll vid större incidenter och störningar och bidrar till att öka kunskapen inom organisationen genom att utbilda och coacha chefer och medarbetare. Du rapporterar status, risker och utvecklingsinitiativ till ledning och styrgrupper.
   

  

 I uppdraget ingår också att kontinuerligt uppdatera registret över krigsplacerad personal och rapportera till Plikt- och Prövningsverket samt att samverka med säkerhetsskyddsfunktionen vid uppdatering av säkerhetsskyddsanalysen.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som har**
* flerårig erfarenhet av BCM, operativ resiliens eller riskhantering.
* erfarenhet av BIA, riskbedömningar och kontinuitetsplanering.
* god förståelse för kris- och incidenthantering.
* erfarenhet av ISO 22301 eller liknande ramverk.
* god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.


**Det är meriterande om du även har**
* certifieringar inom BCM, riskhantering eller informationssäkerhet.
* erfarenhet från reglerade verksamheter.
* kunskap om operativ resiliens, tredjepartsrisker eller cybersäkerhet.


 För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara analytisk och strukturerad, men också kommunikativ och bra på att skapa engagemang. Du trivs i en roll där du får kombinera strategiskt arbete med praktiskt genomförande och där du driver frågor framåt tillsammans med många olika delar av verksamheten. Du har också förmåga att driva förändring och koordinera flera intressenter.
   

  

**Det här erbjuder vi**
 Hos oss får du en strategiskt viktig roll med stort utrymme att påverka och utveckla arbetet inom kontinuitet och resiliens. Du blir en del av en organisation som präglas av
 **förtroende, samarbete och frihet under ansvar** 
 .
   

  

 Vi erbjuder en flexibel hybridarbetsplats med möjlighet att arbeta på distans upp till två dagar i veckan, tillsammans med förmåner som friskvårdsbidrag, bidrag till hemmakontor och sommararbetstid. Placeringsort Bromma.
   

  

*Anställningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass, vilket i detta fall ställer krav på svenskt medborgarskap och godkänd säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll. Säkerhetsprövningen görs i enlighet med bestämmelser i säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585)* 
**.**
*Som en del av vårt ansvar inom totalförsvaret kan tjänsten komma att krigsplaceras. Detta innebär att du vid höjd beredskap eller krig kommer att kallas in för att upprätthålla Coromatics samhällsviktiga verksamhet kopplad till din befattning. För vissa tjänster kan även bakgrundskontroll komma att genomföras som en del av rekryteringsprocessen.*
**Ansökan**
**Låter vi som rätt match för dig? Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Har du frågor om tjänsten? Kontakta gärna rekryterande chef Marcus Qvennerstedt på marcus.qvennerstedt@coromatic.se
   

  

**Bli en del av Coromatic och bidra till ett motståndskraftigt och hållbart samhälle**
*Coromatic säkerställer kontinuerlig kraftförsörjning och datakommunikation 24/7 genom att utveckla, serva och driva robusta fysiska infrastrukturlösningar för datacenter och reservkraft med hållbarhet och säkerhet som kärnan i vår leverans.*
*Sedan starten 1992, och som en del av E.ON-koncernen från 2019, har vi byggt ett starkt förtroende i marknaden. Vi säkrar driften av verksamhetskritisk infrastruktur för organisationer som håller samhället i gång och vi samarbetar med över hälften av Nordens största företag.*
*Bli en del av vårt team med över 800 kollegor på 21 regionala kontor och servicecenter i Norden – och var med på vår resa för att säkra ett motståndskraftigt och hållbart samhälle.*

title: API Manager Administrator
description:
Job Title: API Manager Administrator
 



 Location: Stockholm, Sweden (Hybrid)
 



 Employment type: contract
 



  





 Detailed job Description:
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for an experienced WSO2 API Manager Administrator to manage, configure, and maintain our API management infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in WSO2's core components, hands-on infrastructure experience across Azure Kubernetes Service and VM-based deployments, a working understanding of LLM APIs, and a strong grasp of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.
 



 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 •Administer and maintain WSO2 API Manager environments across development, staging, and production
 



 •Configure and manage core components including the Gateway, Publisher, Developer Portal, Key Manager, and Traffic Manager
 



 •Integrate and manage third-party key managers (e.g., Keycloak, Okta, Curtiy) with WSO2 API Manager
 



 •Deploy, upgrade, and troubleshoot WSO2 API Manager installations on virtual machines (Linux-based)
 



 •Manage and support WSO2 deployments running on Azure AKS, including pod scaling, ingress configuration, persistent storage, and cluster monitoring
 



 •Onboard and manage LLM-based APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic) through the API Manager — including rate limiting, token-based throttling, and usage tracking
 



 •Set up, configure, and maintain MCP servers that expose tools, resources, and prompts to LLM-based clients
 



 •Design and troubleshoot MCP client-server integrations — understanding the full lifecycle including capability negotiation, tool discovery, tool invocation, and context passing between clients and servers
 



 •Govern MCP server endpoints through the API gateway — applying authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and observability policies
 



 •Define and enforce API governance policies, lifecycle management, and security standards
 



 •Monitor API traffic, diagnose performance issues, and optimize gateway throughput
 



 •Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams on CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and deployment automation
 



 •Maintain documentation for configurations, runbooks, and operational procedures
 



 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 



 Required Qualifications
 



 •4+ years of hands-on experience administering WSO2 API Manager (versions 3.x or 4.x)
 



 •Strong understanding of WSO2 core components: Gateway, Publisher, Developer Portal, Key Manager, Traffic Manager, and Carbon-based architecture
 



 •Proven experience integrating third-party key managers and identity providers with WSO2
 



 •Experience installing, configuring, and maintaining WSO2 API Manager on virtual machines, including database setup (MySQL/PostgreSQL/MSSQL), load balancer configuration, and high-availability deployments
 



 •Working knowledge of Azure AKS — including kubectl, Helm charts, node pools, networking (VNET integration, ingress controllers), and monitoring (Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana)
 



 •Familiarity with LLM APIs — understanding of how large language model endpoints work (request/response structure, token-based billing, streaming, rate limits) and how to expose and govern them through an API gateway
 



 •Deep understanding of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) — including:
 



 o MCP architecture: client-server model, transport layers (stdio, HTTP with SSE/Streamable HTTP), and session lifecycle
 



 o MCP server development and deployment: exposing tools, resources, and prompts to AI clients
 



 o MCP client behavior: how LLM applications discover servers, negotiate capabilities, invoke tools, and manage context
 



 o Securing MCP endpoints: authentication (OAuth2, API keys), authorization scoping, input validation, and sandboxing
 



 o Troubleshooting MCP communication: debugging tool call failures, transport issues, schema mismatches, and timeout handling
 



 • Solid understanding of OAuth2, JWT, API security, and certificate management
 



 • Experience with Linux system administration
 



  





 Skills
 



 • Troubleshooting and root cause analysis in distributed API gateway environments
 



 • Strong understanding of how AI agents interact with external systems via tool-use protocols like MCP
 



 • Strong communication skills for working across development, security, AI, and infrastructure teams
 



 • Ability to document complex configurations clearly
 



 • Self-directed with a focus on reliability and uptime

title: Teknisk säljare
description:
Vi söker nu för kunds räkning en teknisk säljare som vill vara med på deras digitaliseringsresa och utveckling av försäljningsorganisation. Detta är en roll för dig som gillar att ha många kontakter, är kommunikativ och gillar att hitta rätt tekniska lösningar för deras kunder.
   

  

 Uppdrag: Start enligt överenskommelse (relativt omgående). Tjänsten inleds med en sex månaders provanställning som konsult via Randstad, med goda chanser att därefter gå över i en anställning direkt hos kunden.
   

  

 Placering: Solna Business Park, med chans till distansarbete.
   

  

 Arbetsgivare: Randstad AB.
   

  

 Som konsult hos Randstad är du anställd hos oss och jobbar ute hos någon av våra kunder. Du har samma fördelar hos Randstad som hos andra arbetsgivare med kollektivavtal och förmåner som friskvårdsbidrag, företagshälsovård, försäkringar och rabatt på träningskort. Tjänsten kan innebära många kontakter och då är det är viktigt att du har en bra samarbetsförmåga. På Randstad strävar vi efter att erbjuda dig karriärmöjligheter, så att du kan utveckla din kompetens och få ett välfyllt CV. Söker du en arbetsgivare som erbjuder varierande uppdrag och nya kontaktnät kommer du att trivas hos oss.
   

  

 Rekrytering kommer att ske löpande och tjänsterna kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Ifall denna tjänst passar dig som handen i handsken, sök redan idag!
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
**Vi Söker Dig Som Har**
* Minst 2–3 års erfarenhet av uppsökande och relationsbyggande B2B försäljning, gärna inom teknik, industri, energi eller liknande branscher.
* Erfarenhet av att självständigt driva hela säljprocessen, från prospektering till avslut och uppföljning.
* Grundläggande teknisk förståelse framför allt kopplat till tekniska termer i tal och skrift
* Kan uttrycka sig väl på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
* Ett framåtdriv och initiativtagande, du är inte en person som väntar på att saker ska komma till dig.


**Meriterande**
* Utbildning inom relevant område
* B-körkort


**Ansvarsområde**
 I Den Här Rollen Har Du Ett Brett Ansvar För Din Kundportfölj Och Äger Hela Kedjan Från Första Kontakt Till Ett Långsiktigt Samarbete. Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Inkluderar
   

  

* Kundbearbetning: Boka och genomföra kundmöten, både fysiskt och digitalt.
* Relationsbygge: Proaktivt skapa och utveckla förtroendefulla relationer med beslutsfattare.
* Rådgivning: Ge löpande kundstöd och vägleda kunder mot rätt tekniska lösningar.
* Affärsmässighet: Driva avtalsprocesser, följa upp affärer och ansvara för onboarding av nya kunder.
* Strategi: Delta i mässor och vara med och forma teamets försäljningsmål och KPI:er.


 Som person är du initiativtagande, kommunikativ och har en naturlig förmåga att förklara komplexa lösningar på ett pedagogiskt sätt. Som Teknisk Säljare blir du den avgörande länken mellan kundernas tekniska utmaningar och kunds innovativa lösningar. Du kliver in i en dynamisk arbetsmiljö där fokus ligger på att skapa genuint kundvärde och långsiktiga relationer. Rollen passar dig som är affärsdriven, pedagogisk och som trivs med att verka i ett område som har en direkt påverkan på samhällsutvecklingen. Du kommer få jobba i en branch som ständigt utvecklas och vi ser gärna att du vill följa med på den resan. Du förväntas hela tiden jobba med framtiden i åtanke och komma med egna förslag till förbättringar inom bolaget och för deras kundupplevelse.Resor kan förekomma i rollen.

title: Master Thesis -  Global peering and anycast
description:
****Background****
**Netnod is a small high-tech firm based in Sweden which provides services at the core of the Internet, such as Internet-exchange services, transmission, DNS-services, and time and frequency services. Netnod is at the forefront of secure and robust services.**
****Thesis description****
**At Netnod we mainly design security through diversity, that is by composing systems through many different nodes in many different levels so that there is no single point of failure. In terms of security our systems focus on providing availability and integrity, even in extreme scenarios.**
**Several of our services are dependent on anycast routing and peering on nodes across the globe for availability. Announcing and de-announcing nodes is part of our toolkit for management traffic and global availability.**
**What should be the best-practices for ensuring availability of any global service; given events such as DDoS, faulty routing, anycast and peering?**
**This thesis concerns digging into this issue, and if possible, suggest solutions. This thesis concerns both implementation and evaluation of implementations.**
**Qualifications**
**This thesis project is aimed at students in computer science and engineering with an interest in networks, routing and peering.**
****Extent****
**Preferably two students, 30hp each**
****Practicalities****
**The students are expected to be partly present at the Netnod main office in Solna, Stockholm. The planned semester is spring of 2027.**
**Netnod will provide an on-site supervisor with relevant academic merits.**
**Netnod provides necessary equipment, reimbursement for travels, and a one time compensation upon completion of the thesis project.**

title: Founding Account Executive, Nordics
description:
**About Telnyx**
*Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a* 
*private, global, multi-cloud IP network* 
*, to bringing* 
*hyperlocal edge* 
*technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.*
*We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.*
*Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.*
**The Role**
 We're building local Enterprise Sales Pods across global markets — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in the Nordics. This is not a remote overlay on an existing territory. You will own a named-account list of 30–40 enterprise accounts across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland, and your job is to turn those accounts into production Telnyx customers.
   

  

 You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated FDE — not a demo resource, but a technical partner who designs architectures, builds POCs, and gets the first workload live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.
   

  

 This is a founding role. You'll help define how Telnyx sells into enterprise accounts in France and the Nordics, set the playbook, and build the references that the next wave of hires will follow.
   

  

*The Pod Model*
*Enterprise AE* 
 — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account.
   

  

*Forward Deployed Engineer* 
 — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.
   

  

 We sell the
 *workload* 
 , not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own a territory of 30–40 named enterprise accounts across France and the Nordics (Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland), narrowing to ~10 Tier 1 accounts worth $1M+ in annual potential
* Build executive relationships — get in the room with CIOs, CTOs, VP Engineering, and line-of-business owners
* Run the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, design the commercial architecture with your FDE, negotiate, and close
* Sell production outcomes, not individual products — lead with "let's deploy an AI agent that operates your SOC or NOC workflow," not "which Telnyx products do you want?"
* Agree the commercial destination before any custom work begins — no free discovery or free development
* Maintain disciplined POC management: every POC has a named executive sponsor, written success criteria, production pricing discussed, a decision date, and a signed commercial document. POCs end in production or they end
* Expand the account — one workload becomes three, one $500K customer becomes a $2M customer
* Build local references and case studies across Paris, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Oslo, and Helsinki
* Provide accurate pipeline reporting and forecasting — no surprises


**What We're Looking For**
* 5+ years of enterprise sales experience selling into French and/or Nordic markets — CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, telecom, AI/ML, or similarly technical infrastructure
* Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota ($1M+ deals)
* Experience selling to both executive and technical buyers — you can hold your own in the boardroom and in the architecture review
* Hunter mentality — you build your own pipeline and thrive on outbound, in-person selling
* Strong consultative selling skills: can build a clear, compelling ROI story for both technical and business buyers
* Familiarity with sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, etc.)
* Comfortable with modern sales tools (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, etc.)
* Excellent written and verbal communication English. You listen before you pitch.
* Willingness to be in the field — visiting customers in person is a core part of this role
* Based in Stockholm — this is a hybrid role with travel across the Nordics


*Bonus Points For*
* Fortune 500 or large enterprise new business sales experience in the Nordics
* Complex sales cycles including RFPs, POCs, and competitive bake-offs
* C-Level selling experience — you can navigate procurement, security, and legal complexity, including Nordic enterprises (Ericsson, Nokia, Telia, Telenor, AstraZeneca, Spotify, Klarna, Equinor, Novo Nordisk, Maersk)
* Understanding of SIP trunking, phone number provisioning, carrier networks, or AI/ML platforms
* Established relationships in the Nordic enterprise ecosystem — fintech, telecom, luxury/retail, aerospace/defense, healthcare, or SaaS
* Nordic language skills (Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish) for the Stockholm/Copenhagen/Oslo/Helsinki markets
* Experience selling across multiple European markets with different regulatory and procurement environments

title: Program Manager Sweden
description:
**Missions Program Manager / Senior Missions Program Manager**
* Location: Sweden or Espoo
* Department: Missions Programs
* Reports to: Program Director
* Employment type: Permanent
* Workplace model: Remote / Hybrid / Office
* Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required) - must be able to attain Swedish Security Clearance


**Why This Role Matters**
 As a mission program manager , you’ll deliver a complex Satellite Mission program end-to-end, ensuring customer success, on-time execution, and scalable delivery excellence.
   

  

 You will ensure the full lifecycle of customer missions—from contract execution through delivery—acting as the central orchestrator across engineering, product, operations, and commercial teams. Your role is to ensure programs deliver against commitments while building strong, trusted customer relationships.
   

  

 This role directly contributes to ICEYE’s ambition to become the leading provider of space-based ISR infrastructure by scaling reliable, high-impact mission delivery globally.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
   

  

 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
   

  

 ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
   

  

 Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
   

  

**Expected outcomes**
* Deliver assigned Satellite Mission programs on time, within budget, and to agreed performance standards
* Build and maintain trusted, long-term customer relationships, acting as the primary interface throughout program execution and supporting Customer Success Management activities
* Establish and drive clear program plans (scope, milestones, resources, financials) aligned with internal and customer objectives
* Identify, manage, and resolve risks, dependencies, and escalations to ensure uninterrupted program delivery
* Orchestrate cross-functional execution across engineering, product, operations, and commercial teams
* Support the implementation of scalable program management practices that improve delivery reliability and efficiency across Missions
* Establish effective reporting structure and communication channels and mechanisms to ensure timely and accurate information flow among program team members, stakeholders, and senior leadership


**What We’re Looking For**
**Must have competences:**
* Proven experience (5–10 years) managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs involving advanced technology systems (e.g., space, defence, telecom, automotive, IT, or similar)
* Strong customer-facing experience, with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and navigate complex requirements
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams
* Expertise in program planning, execution, and governance (scope, schedule, budget, risk management)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make decisions under uncertainty
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences
* Fluent Swedish (native level) and ability to obtain security clearance


**Nice To Haves**
* Experience working on satellite or similarly complex system programs
* Experience with governmental or defense customers
* Knowledge of hardware, software, or embedded systems development
* Experience in product development environments
* Master’s degree in business, engineering, or a relevant field
* PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification


**Application Process**
* Initial screening call with Talent Attraction
* Hiring Manager interview
* Case Study & Interview
* Final interview
* References


**Working at ICEYE**
 At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.
   

  

**How We Work (Our Values)**
* Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.
* Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.
* See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.
* Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.
* Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.
* Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.


**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
 We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.
   

  

 We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.
   

  

 Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at
 **iceye.com** 
 .

title: Operations Analyst
description:
**Filed is building the first AI tax preparer trusted by America’s accounting firms.**
 This industry might seem boring—but it’s a $70B backbone of the economy that’s breaking under a talent shortage no one has solved. We’re fixing it—fast.
   

  

 In just 9 months, we’ve hit strong product-market fit, are generating insanely fast-growing, ridiculously sticky revenue, and are backed by top-tier investors. We’re not a tool—we’re the missing workforce firms have been sounding the alarm for. We’re building the future by expanding our already 30-person team with those who want to say “I was there when it all started.”
   

  

 Read more → TechCrunch
   

  

 ⸻
   

  

**What we should tell you about the role:**
 We’re looking for a
 **Business Operations Analyst** 
 who thrives on building order from chaos and loves improving the way a company operates. You’re the kind of person who spots inefficiencies, designs systems to eliminate them, and has the drive to implement solutions quickly. You know that a great internal process is invisible to most people—but game-changing for the team that depends on it.
   

  

 This is a
 **part-time role designed to fit alongside your studies** 
 —you set the number of hours you work each week, as long as you deliver on the outcomes.
   

  

 Your mission:
 ***Significantly improve our internal processes through automation and structure, speeding up reporting, ensuring we’re not missing anything, and delivering on our deadlines.***
 You’ll work closely with leadership, operations, and other departments to streamline workflows, unify data sources, and ensure that we’re moving at the speed our growth demands. You won’t just make systems more efficient—you’ll create leverage that compounds over time.
   

  

 ⸻
   

  

**Here’s why this is a terrible job:**
* This is not a job for someone who likes to move slow.
* We operate week to week with ruthless speed. Sometimes we’re going in the wrong direction, but more times than not we’re going in the right direction.
* If you need a few extra days to perfect a process document, chances are there’s already a handful of team members blocked behind you.
* We implement tools and automations fast—often testing in real time.
* You’ll be operating at the intersection of operations, reporting, and cross-team coordination.
* There are no clear answers. Just judgment calls, ambiguity, and constant input from every direction.
* You’ll ask yourself, is this really the work? It is. And it’s not for everyone.


 ⸻
   

  

**Here’s why it’s the best career choice you’ll make:**
* We’re building what tax pros call impossible. A product that behaves like a teammate, not just another tool.
* You’ll be paid above market for an internship, gain experience at a rocket-ship startup, and have full autonomy to make high-impact improvements.
* You’ll own systems end-to-end, from design to deployment.
* You’ll work with leadership daily and see the direct impact of your contributions on company-wide performance.
* We’ll tell you what needs to be achieved. How you get there is on you.
* You’ll be building a foundation that allows the company to scale without breaking.


 ⸻
   

  

**The teammate we’re looking for:**
* Thrives at solving operational inefficiencies and systems challenges
* Moves seamlessly between identifying problems, implementing solutions, and iterating quickly
* Excited by the challenge of making internal operations invisible (because they just work)
* No lone wolves — we need a collaborative operator
* Big bonus if you have experience implementing automation or AI agents in a work environment


 ⸻
   

  

**What you’ll be responsible for:**
* Assist leadership in establishing a single source of truth for our business and financial metrics that updates automatically with minimal manual intervention.
* Implement operational automations that save significant time while for operations.
* Support management with various ad-hoc tasks that substantially reduce workload across the company, freeing up time for management to focus on key tasks.


 ⸻
   

  

**Your hard skillset:**
* Currently enrolled at a prestigious university preferably with strong academic performance.
* Previous experience internships, or working in a small, fast-paced, and dynamic environment.
* Proficient in workplace tools, integrations, and automations—especially AI applications or AI agents—with demonstrated hands-on experience.
* Strong professional references.


 ⸻
   

  

**Your soft skillset:**
* Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data
* Empathetic and curious — building for the team, not just for performance metrics
* Highly collaborative across departments and with leadership
* Detail-oriented but pragmatic — you know when polish matters and when to move
* You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it


 ⸻
   

  

**Growth and Levels:**
* This isn’t a comfy operations internship. It’s fast, focused, and impact-obsessed.
* You will launch improvements fast. You will learn fast. You will own what you ship.
* Opportunity to transition into a full-time role based on performance.


 ⸻
   

  

**The process:**
* Quick intro call (30 minutes)
* Practical case study (60 minutes)
* Final round with our team (60 minutes)


 In just 2.5 hours, you’ll be wanting early access—just like the rest of our team—to get into the stack and start building a generational company, even before your first day. Because you’ll see the opportunity to change your career trajectory—fast.

title: Customer Support Specialist - SWEDISH speaking
description:
**At Cision, we believe in empowering every individual to make an impact. Here, your voice is heard, your ideas are valued, and your unique perspective fuels our collective success. As part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate.**
**Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow.**
**Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you.**
**The role**
 As a Customer Support Specialist (CSS), you will help develop a culture of Customer Excellence by handling customer problems and issues promptly and thoroughly, while answering product and service questions.
   

  

 You will build relationships and trust with our clients by assisting, guiding and training them on our platforms and their different functions. You will work with customers at all levels to remove blockers and adapt our software to help them achieve their business goals.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
*The role is defined, but not limited to, the following:*
* Answer customer support requests via telephone, email or web promptly to enhance the customer experience.
* Listen patiently and attentively to customers’ queries, manage the resolution or connect them with the appropriate teams to address their needs.
* Quickly learn the functions of our support tools and systems to log and resolve customer requests.
* Resolve platform or service problems by clarifying the customer’s complaint, determining the root cause, selecting and explaining the best solution, and expediting any necessary correction or adjustment.
* Assist users with different tasks in our system, such as assisted disseminations, media database lists and quarterly reports for our listed clients.
* Work with Customer Experience management to maintain best practices for efficient customer support and communication.
* Address customer questions about new products or services.
* Collaborate with Customer Success Managers, Onboarding & Implementation Consultants and other customer-facing teams to ensure service excellence.
* Contribute to bottom-line sales by increasing customer satisfaction and reducing customer churn.
* Work cross-functionally with internal and external partners and stakeholders, including the Sales department, Finance, other distribution channels and stock exchanges.
* Perform other duties as required.


**Essential Skills And Experience**
* Highly customer-focused, with a real passion for the customer experience and customer support industry.
* Driven, self-starting and enthusiastic, with an “ownership” mentality.
* Adaptable and able to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.
* Able to handle stressful and pressured situations.
* Proven experience in a customer-facing role.
* Ability to collaborate with internal and external partners while coordinating key customer deliverables and ensuring a world-class customer experience.
* Advanced listening and verbal communication skills, with the ability to understand customers’ needs and respond clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing.
* Enthusiastic, with a strong work ethic, positive mindset and can-do attitude.
* Influencing and negotiation skills.
* A team player who appreciates working together towards a common goal.
* Experience with Freshdesk and/or Salesforce is beneficial.
* Excellent Swedish and English language skills, both written and verbal.
* Additional Nordic languages are an advantage.
* Working knowledge of MS Office Suite, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint, is required.
* An undergraduate degree is preferred.


**What We Offer**
 Upon joining Cision, you will immediately have access to a range of benefits that are fully or partially funded by the company or can be selected at your own cost and form part of your overall benefits package. These benefits include:
   

  

* Pension Plan
* Group Insurances
* Wellness allowance
* ATK days
* Gym Discount
* Glasses
* Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
* Cision Global Charitable Giving Program
* Headspace


**The standard working hours will be 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday, either early shift 07:30 to 16:00 or late shift 09.15 to 17:45 excluding one-hour unpaid lunch break per day.**
**If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you!** 
 Please note that for this role, we are only able to consider candidates who are already based in the country of employment.
   

  

 As we’re a global Talent Acquisition team, we’d really appreciate it if you could share your
 **CV in** 
**English** 
 . This will help us make sure your application can be reviewed by everyone involved in the recruitment process.
   

  

 Cision is the global leader in consumer and media intelligence, engagement, and communication solutions. We equip PR and corporate communications, marketing, and social media professionals with the tools they need to excel in today's data driven world. Our deep expertise, exclusive data partnerships, and award-winning products, including
 **CisionOne** 
 ,
 **Brandwatch** 
 , and
 **PR Newswire** 
 , enable over 75,000 companies and organizations, including 84% of the Fortune 500, to see and be seen, understand and be understood by the audiences that matter most to them.
   

  

 Cision is committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees can be their authentic selves and perform at their best. We believe diversity, equity, and inclusion is vital to driving our culture, sparking innovation and achieving long-term success. Cision is proud to have joined more than 600 companies in signing the CEO Action for Diversity & Inclusion™ pledge and named a “Top Diversity Employer” for 2021 by DiversityJobs.com.
   

  

 Cision is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or other protected statuses.
   

  

 Cision is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. In keeping with our commitment, Cision will take the steps to assure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of the position, and/or to receive all other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact hr.support@cision.com
   

  

 Cision, Inc. "the Company" only communicates with candidates and extends job offers through direct channels, not third parties.
   

  

 Please review our Global Candidate Data Privacy Statement to learn about Cision’s commitment to protecting personal data collected during the hiring process.

title: Business Analyst-Sales Air Content
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
   

  

 We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
   

  

 Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
   

  

 Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
   

  

 The role
   

  

 Are you ready to take your career to new heights? As a Senior Business Analyst in our Sales Air Content team, you will act as a commercial powerhouse driving revenue and strategic growth across our global B2B partnerships. Sitting at the intersection of business strategy, partner yield optimization, and commercial execution, you will turn complex market data into high-impact business decisions.
   

  

**Skills**
 In this role, you will be at the forefront of our efforts to optimize how we source and distribute our flight content. Your primary focus will be to commercially ensure that the team continuously improves our deliveries towards our B2B partners. Your analytical skills and actionable insights will be crucial as you:
   

  

* Optimize content & distribution by ensuring we offer the world’s best and broadest range of flight options and collaborating with internal teams to distribute the right options with our partners.
* Drive commercial growth by identifying revenue opportunities aligned with both team goals and partner strategies.
* Solve strategic problems by using commercial data (conversion, margins, partner performance) to build practical business strategies and drive solutions.
* Lead proactive initiatives by taking high-impact commercial projects from strategic diagnosis all the way to implementation and rollout.
* Align cross-functional teams by collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, as well as external B2B partners.


**Requirements**
* A minimum of 4 years of experience driving data-based business outcomes and managing stakeholder relationships.
* Proactive Drive & Ownership: High sense of urgency, strong commercial ambition, and a hands-on approach to problem-solving. You don't just identify business challenges in the data, you build the solution and execute it.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to put together and present business solutions, lead initiatives from analysis to implementation, and challenge existing processes.
* Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners.
* Strategic Communication: Ability to articulate business strategy, present logical arguments, and negotiate effectively with senior internal leaders and external B2B partners.
* Education & Experience: Degree in Business, Economics, or related field. Background in management consulting, Business Operations (BizOps), strategy, or yield management is a plus. Travel tech (GDS/NDC) or AI tool experience is highly valued.


 Why Join Us?
   

  

 You’ll work on a core product that shapes the travel experience of millions of users worldwide, within a dynamic and rapidly evolving industry. We embrace forward-thinking tech, encouraging our teams to leverage AI tools to work smarter and drive innovation. You'll be part of a passionate team dedicated to excellence, playing a vital role in executing our flight content goals, influencing partner success, and growing in a supportive environment that values innovation.
   

  

 If you're ready to elevate your career and make a real difference in the world of travel, apply now and become a vital part of our mission!
   

  

**Benefits**
 The culture at Etraveli Group embraces complexity and we like to keep the entrepreneurial spirit even as we grow into being a larger company.
   

  

**With Us You Can Enjoy**
* A flexible working environment. We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location
* Modern office in the heart of the city – A bright and central location with great access to public transport, lunch spots, and parks just around the corner.
* Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.
* Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.
* Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.


 As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.
   

  

 Welcome to Etraveli Group!
   

  

 Diversity disclaimer
   

  

*At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds.* 
*During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.*

title: LIA- praktik på Sandvik
description:
Är du redo att omsätta dina kunskaper i praktiken och få inblick i arbetslivet på en global industrikoncern? Då kan LIA på Sandvik vara nästa steg!
   

  

 Vi välkomnar LIA‑studenter från yrkeshögskoleutbildningar och Universitet till våra verksamheter i Sandviken, Gimo, Stockholm, Fagersta och Svedala. Hos oss får du möjligheten att arbeta med varierande och meningsfulla uppgifter i en modern, internationell och ständigt utvecklande miljö – perfekt för dig som vill bygga nätverk och stärka både din yrkeskompetens och personliga utveckling.
   

  

**Varför göra din LIA hos oss?**
 Under din praktik får du arbeta med verkliga uppgifter och projekt som gör skillnad. Oavsett om du studerar teknik, produktion, industriell ekonomi, IT, administration eller något annat område får du lära känna en verksamhet där utveckling sker varje dag.
   

  

 Hos oss får du:
   

  

* Praktisk erfarenhet som kompletterar din utbildning
* Möjlighet att bidra till riktiga projekt och förbättringsinitiativ
* Stöd och vägledning av engagerade handledare och kollegor
* En chans att utforska framtida karriärmöjligheter inom Sandvik


 LIA är värdefullt både för dig och för oss. Det ger dig möjlighet att utvecklas och få erfarenheter inför framtiden, samtidigt som vi får lära känna drivna studenter med nya perspektiv och idéer.
   

  

 Vi hoppas att du vill vara med och skapa framtidens lösningar tillsammans med oss.
   

  

**Vår kultur**
 På Sandvik Group är vi teknikdrivna, innovativa och entreprenöriella. Vi tror på teamwork och värdesätter mångfald, och vi strävar efter en inkluderande kultur där alla kan vara sig själva och nå sin fulla potential. Vi investerar i att stötta varandra, utvecklas tillsammans och uppskatta våra olikheter.
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om oss tipsar vi om ett besök på vår stories-hubb, LinkedIn eller Facebook. Ta också en titt på YouTube‑videon nedan för att lära dig mer om vårt syfte: Advancing the world through engineering.
   

  

**Kontaktinformation**
 För mer information och frågor angående rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta HR Services på hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com
   

  

**Ansökan**
 Skicka in din ansökan senast 18 oktober, 2026. Klicka på ansök och bifoga gärna ditt CV och en kort beskrivning av vad du studerar, vilken LIA‑period du söker och vilka områden du är intresserad av. Jobb-id: R0097508.

title: Presales Solutions Consultant - CFD Simulation
description:
**Company Overview**
 Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 As a
 **Pre-Sales Engineer** 
 , you'll work with customers across diverse industries, helping them leverage advanced computational fluid dynamics to solve complex engineering challenges. We're looking for someone who understands how
 **CFD simulation drives innovation in practice** 
 —not in theory—and can help organizations unlock the full potential of
 **Simcenter solutions** 
 . What does success look like to you when a customer moves from struggling with design optimization to confidently predicting product performance?
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead technical discussions with customers and demonstrate how Simcenter CFD solutions address their specific engineering challenges in aerodynamics, thermal management, and multiphysics applications
* Conduct technical presentations and live demonstrations of STAR-CCM+ and related CFD tools, translating complex simulation concepts into clear, compelling business value
* Build long-term relationships with technical decision-makers and engineers at customer organizations, becoming a trusted advisor for their simulation needs
* Develop customized CFD simulation solutions based on customer requirements across different industries, from automotive and aerospace to energy and marine applications
* Provide expert technical consulting on CFD analysis, multiphysics modeling, mesh generation, turbulence modeling, and simulation best practices
* Support the sales process by identifying customer needs and positioning Simcenter solutions as the right fit for their technical and business objectives


**Qualifications**
* Master's or doctoral degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field
* Significant experience with CFD simulation in a professional or academic setting, including strong knowledge of STAR-CCM+, fluid mechanics, turbulence modeling, and numerical methods
* Demonstrated expertise in CFD analysis techniques such as aerodynamics, hydrodynamics, heat transfer, multiphysics modeling, mesh generation, and post-processing
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to audiences with varying levels of engineering knowledge, and to listen carefully when customers describe their needs
* Track record of success in technical sales, customer support, or pre-sales roles in a B2B environment, with the ability to connect technical benefits to business value and ROI
* Excellent presentation skills and the ability to conduct live product demonstrations that engage and inspire customers
* Fluency in English and in a Nordic language
* Willingness to travel approximately 20% for customer visits


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience with AI and machine learning applications in engineering simulation, such as surrogate modeling or predictive analytics
* Familiarity with complementary tools such as Simcenter Amesim, MATLAB/Simulink, Ansys Fluent, CAD integration, or scripting languages for automation
* Knowledge of digital manufacturing or advanced PLM approaches


 Why Us?
   

  

 At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
   

  

 Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion
   

  

 We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.
   

  

**Compensation & Benefits**
 The primary locations for this opportunity are Sweden, Finland, and Denmark. The applicable salary ranges for these locations are:
   

  

 Min 736.600 - Max 1.399.100 SEK (Sweden)
   

  

 Min 61.100 - Max 122.200 EUR (Finland)
   

  

 Min 603.500 - Max 1.207.100 DKK (Denmark)
   

  

 This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation (variable part is already included in the saalry ranges above). The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/
   

  

**Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday**

title: Senior Projektledare – IT Transformation & Transition
description:
**Jobbeskrivning**
**Vill du leda komplexa IT-transitioner där tjänsteleveranser ska etableras, migreras och tas över i drift?**
 På Sopra Steria söker vi en senior Projektledare med gedigen erfarenhet av att leda stora och komplexa transitioner inom IT-infrastruktur och Managed Services. Du kommer att få en central roll i omfattande projekt hos våra kunder där transformation och transition av komplexa IT-miljöer står i centrum, med fokus på att etablera, migrera och utveckla verksamhetskritiska tjänster
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har gjort den här typen av resa tidigare. Du har lett etableringen av nya IT-tjänsteleveranser och är van vid att driva transitioner och migreringar inom exempelvis datacenter, cloud, private cloud och digital workplace.
   

  

 Det här är inte en traditionell projektledarroll. Du behöver förstå vad som faktiskt krävs för att ta över, etablera, migrera och kvalitetssäkra verksamhetskritiska IT-tjänster – från transition planning och knowledge transfer till teknisk migrering, acceptans och överlämning till stabil drift.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som Projektledare för Transformation och Transition får du ett övergripande ansvar för att leda och koordinera från befintlig leverans till en ny etablerad IT-tjänsteleverans.
   

  

 Du ansvarar för helheten i projektet och leder flera parallella arbetsströmmar inom IT-infrastruktur och Managed Services. Det kan exempelvis handla om etablering och migrering av datacentertjänster, cloud och private cloud, digital workplace, nätverk, identitet, säkerhet och andra infrastrukturtjänster.
   

  

 Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan teknik, projektledning och tjänsteleverans och koordinerar kund, befintliga leverantörer, nya leveransteam, tekniska specialister och andra berörda parter.
   

  

 En viktig del av rollen är att förstå beroenden mellan olika tekniska tjänster och säkerställa att de inte bara är tekniskt migrerade, utan också fullt etablerade och redo att fungera som en sammanhängande tjänsteleverans.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* Leda transition och etablering av nya IT-tjänsteleveranser end-to-end.
* Ta fram, förankra och driva den övergripande transitionsplanen.
* Leda och koordinera flera parallella tekniska arbetsströmmar.
* Driva etablering och migrering av tjänster inom exempelvis datacenter, cloud/private cloud och digital workplace.
* Säkerställa planering och genomförande av knowledge transfer från befintlig leverantör till den nya leveransorganisationen.
* Planera och följa upp aktiviteter, milstolpar, resurser, beroenden och leveranser.
* Koordinera kund, befintliga leverantörer, nya leveransteam och andra externa parter.
* Säkerställa teknisk och operationell readiness inför migrering, cutover och produktionssättning.
* Hantera risker, avvikelser och beroenden samt driva korrigerande aktiviteter.
* Säkerställa att krav, kvalitet och överenskomna acceptanskriterier uppfylls.
* Leda status- och styrningsforum och eskalera frågor som påverkar omfattning, tidplan, kvalitet eller risk.
* Säkerställa en strukturerad överlämning från transition till stabil tjänsteleverans och drift.


**Vem söker vi?**
 Vi söker dig som är en senior projekt- eller programledare med dokumenterad erfarenhet av IT Transition & Transformation, Managed Services och etablering av komplexa IT-tjänsteleveranser. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha praktisk erfarenhet av att leda etableringen och transitionen av IT-tjänster.
   

  

 Du har tidigare ansvarat för projekt där IT-tjänster har tagits över, etablerats och/eller migrerats mellan organisationer, leverantörer eller tekniska plattformar.
   

  

 Vi ser att du har erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Att leda större IT-transitioner och etablering av nya tjänsteleveranser.
* Transition och migrering inom datacenter och IT-infrastruktur.
* Cloud och private cloud, inklusive migrering av tjänster och workloads.
* Digital Workplace / End User Services och tillhörande infrastrukturtjänster.
* Managed Services och komplexa IT Operations-miljöer.
* Leverantörsbyten, outsourcing, insourcing eller övertagande av IT-tjänster.
* Teknisk migrering, cutover, readiness och överlämning till drift.
* Att leda flera parallella tekniska arbetsströmmar och hantera beroenden mellan dem.
* Att koordinera kund, incumbent supplier, ny leveransorganisation och andra leverantörer.
* Risk-, issue- och eskaleringshantering i komplexa program.
* Governance, styrgruppsarbete och kommunikation med seniora stakeholders.
* Att driva en transition hela vägen från planering och knowledge transfer till acceptans och stabil operativ leverans.


 Erfarenhet av ytterligare områden såsom nätverk, IAM/Identity, säkerhet, server, storage, backup och service management är starkt meriterande.
   

  

 Vi ser gärna att du har arbetat hos eller tillsammans med större Managed Services- eller infrastrukturtjänsteleverantörer och har förståelse för både kundens och leverantörens perspektiv i en transition.
   

  

**Som person**
 Du är en trygg och drivande ledare som skapar struktur i komplexa miljöer och får människor från olika organisationer och kompetensområden att arbeta mot samma mål.
   

  

 Du behöver inte vara den djupaste tekniska specialisten i varje arbetsström, men du har tillräckligt stark teknisk förståelse för att kunna utmana arkitekter och specialister, förstå beroenden och risker samt fatta välgrundade beslut kring migrering och transition.
   

  

 Du är van vid att ta ägarskap, driva fram beslut och agera när leveransen avviker från planen. Samtidigt har du förmågan att bygga förtroende hos både kund, leveransorganisation och externa leverantörer.
   

  

**Därför Sopra Steria**
 Sopra Steria är en av Europas ledande aktörer inom digital transformation, med över 60 000 medarbetare i mer än 30 länder globalt. Vi driver innovation och hjälper företag och organisationer att effektivisera, utvecklas och skapa långsiktigt värde genom banbrytande teknologilösningar.
   

  

 Hos oss arbetar de främsta experterna inom sina områden i en dynamisk och framtidsorienterad miljö där samarbete, nytänkande och teknisk spetskompetens står i centrum. Vi hjälper våra kunder med några av deras mest verksamhetskritiska IT-miljöer och kombinerar kompetens inom bland annat cloud, infrastruktur, digital workplace, cybersäkerhet, data och digital transformation.
   

  

 Här får du möjlighet att kombinera din erfarenhet av komplex projektledning med din förståelse för teknik och tjänsteleverans – och vara med och leda transitioner där resultatet blir en helt ny, fungerande IT-leverans.
   

  

**Låter det intressant?**
 Skicka in din ansökan eller hör av dig till oss så berättar vi mer om rollen, våra kunder och hur det är att arbeta på Sopra Steria. Vid eventuella frågor kring rollen, kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Teodor Nellvik (teodor.nellvik@soprasteria.com). På Sopra Steria ställer vi höga krav på både kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet hos våra medarbetare. Innan en eventuell anställning kommer du därför att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll, och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.
   

  

**Välkommen till Sopra Steria - där din kompetens formar framtidens digitala lösningar!**

title: Teknisk projektledare
description:
**Uppdragsbeskrivning:**
 Polismyndigheten befinner sig i ett omfattande arbete med att modernisera och vidareutveckla sina ledningscentraler. Arbetet bedrivs på kort, medellång och lång sikt och omfattar flera parallella utvecklings- och förändringsinitiativ.
   

  

 Till detta tekniskt komplexa område söker vi en projektledare som kan driva utvecklings- och förändringsarbete både i projektform och inom linjeorganisationen. Rollen innebär ett stort eget ansvar för att strukturera, driva och koordinera arbetet från behovsidentifiering och kravställning till genomförande.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter:**
 Som projektledare kommer du bland annat att:
   

  

* Leda och driva utvecklings- och förändringsinitiativ kopplade till moderniseringen av ledningscentralerna.
* Planera, strukturera och följa upp aktiviteter, leveranser, beroenden och beslut.
* Samla in, analysera, strukturera och sammanställa verksamhetens behov och krav.
* Genomföra och leda workshopar med verksamhetsföreträdare för att identifiera behov, krav och prioriteringar.
* Översätta verksamhetens behov till tydliga och hanterbara krav och underlag för vidare utveckling.
* Koordinera samarbetet mellan verksamheten och olika teknikgrupper.
* Leda möten och diskussioner i tekniskt komplexa frågeställningar och säkerställa att beslut och aktiviteter förs vidare i arbetet.
* Hantera beroenden och gränssnitt mellan olika teknikområden, projekt och intressenter.
* Säkerställa framdrift genom att identifiera hinder, initiera åtgärder och följa upp överenskomna aktiviteter.
* Kommunicera status, risker, behov av beslut och andra relevanta frågor till berörda intressenter och beslutsfattare.


**Kvalificeringskrav (Skallkrav):**
* Konsulten ska ha minst ha tio (10) års erfarenhet av arbete som projekt- eller uppdragsledare. Uppdraget/-en ska ha utförts på it-avdelning/-ar inom offentlig sektor. Erfarenheten ska ha införskaffats under de senaste tolv (12) åren.
* Konsulten ska ha minst tio (10) års erfarenhet av arbete som kravanalytiker i utvecklingsprojekt. Erfarenheten ska ha införskaffats under de senaste tolv (12) åren.
* Konsulten ska ha minst fem (5) års erfarenhet av verksamhetsutveckling inom statliga myndigheter med lösningar från externa leverantörer. Erfarenheten ska ha införskaffats under de senaste tio (10) åren.
* Konsulten ska ha god förmåga att uttrycka sig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.
* Konsulten ska ha minst fem (5) års erfarenhet av att ha arbetat med tekniska ledningssystem. Erfarenheten ska ha införskaffats under de senaste tio (10) åren.
* Konsulten ska ha minst sju (7) års erfarenhet av att koordinera teknikgrupper i tekniska projekt. Erfarenheten ska ha införskaffats under de senaste tolv (12) åren.
* Konsulten ska ha minst sex (6) års erfarenhet av att arbete i projekt rörande tetra/Rakel radiosystem. Erfarenheten ska ha införskaffats under de senaste tio (10) åren.
* Konsulten ska ha dokumenterad erfarenhet av att samla in, analysera, strukturera och sammanställa verksamhetsbehov och krav, exempelvis genom workshopar, intervjuer eller motsvarande metoder.
* Konsulten ska ha dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda workshopar och möten med både verksamhetsrepresentanter och tekniska specialister.
* Konsulten ska ha dokumenterad erfarenhet av att koordinera arbete mellan verksamhet och flera olika teknikområden eller tekniska team.
* Konsulten ska ha mycket god förmåga att uttrycka sig på svenska i tal och skrift.


**Meriterande kompetens (Börkrav):**
* Konsulten bör ha erfarenhet av att ha arbetat inom säkerhetsklassad verksamhet
* Konsulten bör ha erfarenhet av arbete inom rättsväsendet
* Konsulten bör ha erfarenhet av arbete inom den offentliga sektorn
* Konsulten bör ha erfarenhet av utveckling av fordonsmonterade it- och radiosystem
* Konsult bör ha erfarenhet av kravställning inom statligmyndighet gällande upphandlingen enligt LOU och/eller LUFS


**Erfarenhet**
* Kunskap – hög generalistkompetens eller mycket hög kompetens inom aktuellt området
* Erfarenhet – 9-12 års erfarenhet inom området. Har deltagit i stora och komplexa uppdrag och utfört dessa med mycket hög kvalitet. Är förebild för andra konsulter på lägre nivå.
* Ledning – Tar huvudansvar för ett område och kan leda en större grupp

title: Delivery Lead- PAM
description:
**At FDJ UNITED, we don't just follow the game, we reinvent it.** 




 FDJ UNITED is one of Europe’s leading betting and gaming operators, with a vast portfolio of iconic brands and a reputation for technological excellence. With more than 5,000 employees and a presence in around fifteen regulated markets, the Group offers a diversified, responsible range of games, both under exclusive rights and open to competition. We set new standards, proving that entertainment and safety can go hand in hand. Here, you’ll work alongside a team of passionate individuals dedicated to delivering the best and safest entertaining experiences for our customers every day.
 



  





 The Delivery Lead is responsible for ensuring the successful technical delivery of projects/initiatives by leading cross-functional teams, managing execution, and maintaining alignment between technical implementation and business objectives.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Manage prioritized technical initiatives end-to-end—from evaluation through delivery—ensuring continuous monitoring and tracking in partnership with the Technical business lead
* Report on progress to stakeholders to ensure clear communication and commitment to projects vision and strategy and driven with a business mind-set during execution.
* Remove blockers and manage critical path activities while implementing iterative delivery approaches to realize value early and maintain project momentum
* Manage complexity in mitigating risks and solving issues within the project on behalf of the technical owner
* Manage change along the project to ensure a smooth transition to the future state of the project.
* Be an ambassador for the FDJ values by embodying it in all your work



  





**Experience, Knowledge and Skills** 




 A strategic thinker with strong technical background with leadership skills.
 



 Must Have:
 


* Excellent social skills and the ability to build cross functional relationships
* Ability to drive and coordinate multiple projects
* Great stakeholder communication and presentation skills – able to coordinate and negotiate so all parties feel a fair division
* Excellent understanding of Tech organisational structures and ways of working including development processes and Agile methodologies
* Business mind-set always driving for value for FDJ
* Excellent attention to detail
* Ability to build a holistic view



  





**Expected Behaviours** 




 Take ownership and responsibility for driving prioritised technical projects, ensuring accuracy and on time delivery.
 



  





 Must Be:
 


* An effective communicator and networker, able to influence and explain complex topics to stakeholders
* Well organised, able to prioritise effectively
* A creative/lateral thinker able to resolve problems
* Able to challenge status quo and gain buy-in from colleagues, based on thought leadership, sound reasoning and solid arguments
* Enthusiastic and positive, living our values in our day to day
* Highly motivated and driven
