title: Salesperson
description:
**Company Description** 
 Ironmind is a software engineering consultancy that delivers AI-accelerated engineering, helping clients build applications, SaaS platforms, automation systems, and enterprise solutions in weeks instead of months. The team combines deep engineering expertise with advanced AI toolchains to shorten delivery timelines while maintaining quality, security, and long-term maintainability. Ironmind offers end-to-end services, including UI/UX design, backend development, DevOps, integration, and deployment, so clients can work with a single partner from concept to launch. The company supports a wide range of projects, from MVPs and automation to scalable SaaS products, modern web and mobile apps, and AI and data solutions. With predictable 4–8 week delivery cycles and flexible engagement models, Ironmind helps businesses reduce risk and move rapidly from vision to real-world impact.
 



**Role Description** 
 This full-time remote Salesperson role focuses on driving new business and expanding relationships with existing clients in the technology and software consulting sector. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying and qualifying leads, conducting discovery calls, and understanding client needs around AI-driven engineering, SaaS development, and automation solutions. The Salesperson will prepare and deliver tailored presentations and proposals, collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to shape solutions, and manage the sales pipeline from initial contact through contract closing. The role involves maintaining accurate CRM records, forecasting revenue, and ensuring smooth handoffs to delivery teams for a strong client experience. Ongoing activities include nurturing long-term client relationships, gathering market feedback, and contributing to sales strategies that support Ironmind’s growth.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong consultative selling skills, including prospecting, lead qualification, and closing complex B2B deals.
* Experience selling technology, software development, or AI/automation consulting services to business and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to understand and communicate software and AI concepts (e.g., SaaS platforms, MVPs, automation, data solutions) in clear business terms.
* Proficiency with CRM tools and sales pipeline management, including forecasting and reporting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong presentation and negotiation abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage priorities, and meet targets.
* Collaborative mindset and experience partnering with product, engineering, and operations teams.
* Previous success in a quota-carrying sales role; experience in consulting or professional services is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Curiosity about AI, software engineering practices, and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn quickly.

title: Teknisk arkitekt Nätverksteknik - Örebro
description:
Om Kriminalvården Kriminalvården växer – vi bygger nytt, bygger om och bygger till och söker nu fler medarbetare. Vårt viktigaste mål är att minska återfall i brott – att bryta den onda cirkeln. Lyckas vi med det blir samhället tryggare och säkrare för alla. Vi är den myndighet som ansvarar för anstalter, frivård, häkten och klienttransporter.


Vill du vara med och bidra till ett tryggare samhälle? Vår IT-avdelning genomför en stor satsning med fokus på en digital Kriminalvård. Tillsammans jobbar vi för att skapa förutsättningar och lösningar som gör skillnad i vår verksamhet. IT-avdelningen är under stark tillväxt. Vi söker dig som har ett stort IT-intresse, kunskaper och erfarenheter som kan berika vår digitaliseringsresa och som vill vara med och göra skillnad i samhället inom just din profession.

### **Arbetsbeskrivning**


Din primära arbetsuppgift är att förstå vilka förmågor som finns inom ditt tematiska område och vilka tjänster de tillför till myndigheten. Det handlar både om att förstå hur vi realiserar befintliga förmågor men också utvecklingen inom dessa. Det innefattar att sträva mot att förstå och kunna förklara vilka system/applikationer och funktioner som myndigheten behöver och har kopplat till kriminalvårdens strategiska affär. Det kommer också innefatta en hel del projekt för att bland annat möta myndighetens digitalisering och automations krav.
  

  

Utöver dessa tekniska uppgifter handlar det också om organisatorisk utveckling där rutiner, principer, spelregler och ramverk behöver arbetas med för att minska organisatorisk oordning.
  

  

Som Teknisk arkitekt inom IT infrastruktur tar du fram och underhåller teknisk design för nya behov och befintliga lösningar så de ligger i linje med IT-avdelningens målarkitektur och arkitekturplaner. Du skapar och reviderar relaterad dokumentation, t.ex. designdokumentation och drifthandledningar. Du deltar i projekt och uppdrag för att driva framtagandet av nya tekniska lösningar samt är aktivt föreslående i den tekniska utvecklingen. Du är uppdaterad gällande ny teknik inom området. Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet och kompetens inom området IT infrastruktur. Resor kan förekomma i tjänsten.

### **Kvalifikationer**


Vi söker dig som är initiativtagande och självgående, med förmåga att driva arbetet framåt och ta ansvar för dina uppgifter. Du är flexibel och trivs i en föränderlig miljö där förutsättningarna i arbetet kan skifta. Som person har du god samarbetsförmåga och bygger förtroendefulla relationer med både kollegor och verksamhet. Du är dessutom kvalitetsmedveten och noggrann, med fokus på att leverera hållbara lösningar med hög kvalite.
  

  

För att trivas och lyckas i ditt uppdrag är det viktigt att du delar Kriminalvårdens grundläggande värderingar om en human människosyn, respekt för individen och tron på att människan är utvecklingsbar. Du är även medveten om och har förståelse för hur bakgrund, kultur och grupptillhörighet påverkar dig själv och andra. Vidare förväntas du med ditt förhållningssätt bidra till att alla blir likvärdigt bemötta. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

#### **Vi söker dig som har:**

* Akademisk utbildning företrädesvis inom systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, nätverksteknik eller annan civilingenjörsutbildning, alternativt annan utbildning i kombination med erfarenhet som Kriminalvården bedömer relevant.
* Flerårig erfarenhet av arbete inom större IT infrastrukturlösningar
* Flerårig erfarenhet av att jobba med nätverksteknik
* God kunskap inom IT infrastruktur
* Mycket god kunskap inom nätverksteknik (datacenter, verksamhetsnät, brandväggar)
* Förmåga att uttrycka sig väl på svenska och engelska i så väl tal som skrift

#### **Det är även meriterande med:**

* IT infrastruktur-teknik
* Certifikat inom IT infrastruktur
* Certifikat inom nätverksteknik

***Arbetsuppgifter***
---------------------

*Vill du utforska morgondagens teknik och bidra till att forma Handelsbankens förmåga att ta den till sig? Som Teknisk Innovationsspecialist får du arbeta i gränslandet mellan ny teknik, affär och förändring.*

***Ditt team***  

*Du blir en del av Handelsbankens innovationsgrupp som arbetar med att utforska, utvärdera och skapa förutsättningar för att ny teknik ska kunna omsättas till värde för banken. Vi följer tekniska trender, analyserar nya möjligheter och driver initiativ som hjälper banken att förstå hur framtidens teknik kan påverka affären, verksamheten och den tekniska infrastrukturen.*

*Teamet består idag av fem personer med olika bakgrunder inom teknik, omvärldsbevakning, förändringsledning och verksamhetsutveckling. Tillsammans fungerar vi som en brygga mellan ny teknologi och bankens förmåga att ta den till sig. I den här rollen kommer du att bidra med den tekniska höjd som krävs för att utforska nya områden, testa hypoteser och omsätta insikter till konkreta rekommendationer och initiativ.*

***Din roll***  

*Teknisk innovation handlar sällan om att ha alla svaren från början. Tvärtom handlar det ofta om att utforska områden där få vet exakt vad som väntar runt hörnet.*

*I den här rollen kommer du att arbeta med ett brett spektrum av tekniska frågeställningar och framtidsteknologier. Ena dagen kan du fördjupa dig i distribuerade system, kryptografi eller framtida infrastrukturlösningar. Nästa dag kan fokus ligga på en helt annan teknik eller på att hjälpa verksamheten förstå vilka möjligheter och utmaningar en ny utveckling innebär.*

*Vi söker därför inte en specialist inom ett enskilt område. Vi söker dig som har en stark teknisk grund, är nyfiken av naturen och trivs med att lära dig nya saker. Du har en pragmatiskt förhållningssätt till programmeringsspråk, ramverk samt teknikval och det viktiga är att förstå vilket problem som ska lösas och vilken lösning som passar bäst i sammanhanget.*

Du kommer att formulera frågeställningar, testa antaganden, genomföra analyser och dra slutsatser som kan ligga till grund för framtida beslut och investeringar. Målet är inte alltid att hitta ett färdigt svar, utan att skapa förståelse för möjligheter, risker och förutsättningar.*

*För att lyckas behöver du också vara intresserad av bankens verksamhet. Ny teknik skapar sällan värde på egen hand. Det verkliga arbetet handlar ofta om att förstå organisationen, navigera i processer, bygga relationer och skapa förutsättningar för förändring. Därför kommer du att samarbeta med många olika delar av banken och behöva anpassa ditt budskap efter mottagare och situation.*

title: Data Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**TL;DR:** Build the data infrastructure the Lovable agent runs on: ingestion, storage and query for millions of small tenants instead of one large one. You'll join the Data Platform team, and your work decides whether the apps people build on Lovable can rely on their data.

**Why Lovable?**


Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.


We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.


Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

**What we’re looking for**

* An infrastructure engineer who has built and run data systems in production at scale, and wants the harder version of the problem: millions of tiny tenants on shared infrastructure.
* Deep experience in at least one layer (ingestion, storage formats and table layout, query execution, or orchestration), and the range to work across the others.
* Experience with multi-tenant or untrusted workloads: isolation, noisy neighbours, and keeping cost per tenant low.
* Good judgment on calls no one can check for you: the right abstraction, the tradeoff between cost and latency, whether a design holds at 10x.
* You work with AI agents end to end. Your output is the systems you build, not the code you type by hand.
* You ship, and you own what you ship in production.

**What you’ll do**

* Build ingestion that accepts events from millions of Lovable apps, treats every producer as untrusted, and keeps one tenant's bad traffic from slowing or corrupting another's data.
* Build managed analytical storage for every user, including schema management, partitioning, and compaction of a constant stream of small writes.
* Make queries fast when you can't keep compute warm for every tenant.
* Build the runtime for agent-written connectors: isolated execution, credentials, scheduling, retries and state.
* Make cost per tenant measurable, then drive it down, through metering, limits and workload isolation.
* Expose data, metadata and tools to the Lovable agent so it can build software on customers' data.
* Run what you build, including observability, freshness and recovery.

**The tech stack**


We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

* Languages: Go, Rust, Python, SQL
* Data: ClickHouse, BigQuery, Parquet on object storage
* Streaming & orchestration: Pub/Sub, Temporal
* Cloud: GCP, Cloudflare, AWS
* DevOps & tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, Terraform


And always on the lookout for what's next.

**About your application**


Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.


We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Security Engineer
description:
### **Join Telavox as a Security Engineer**

Are you a hands-on security engineer who enjoys being close to the code, the systems, and the teams building them? At Telavox, security is not a gate at the end of development. It is an embedded capability that enables us to move fast, safely, and at scale.


Telavox is a fast-growing digital telco that combines the reliability of telecom with the agility of SaaS across Europe and across the globe. As our platform grows, security becomes a force multiplier, not just protecting what we build, but actively enabling engineers to ship better and safer software every day.


We are growing our Security Engineering team and looking for a Security Engineer to join our engineering organisation. You will work side by side with our Security Engineering Lead, sharing the same mission and many of the same activities, and bringing your own depth and perspective to the team. Together you will make security a built-in property of every system we ship, by making the secure way the easy way for every engineering team.

#### **About the job**


As a Security Engineer, you are part of the engineering execution layer that makes security real across the Platform organisation. You work across product and platform teams, building paved roads, secure defaults, and standards that teams adopt as their own, instead of doing every team's security for them.


You are a close partner to the Security Engineering Lead, who sets direction and priorities for the function. You complement each other: you share the work, challenge each other's thinking, and divide focus areas based on where your strengths are deepest. You also help bridge the gap between the CISO's strategic direction and day-to-day engineering reality, turning security goals into concrete engineering outcomes.

**Your day-to-day work includes:**

* Build and evolve paved roads that make secure choices the default, such as vulnerability management workflows, secrets handling, and secure-by-default patterns in CI/CD
* Work cross-functionally with engineering teams, understanding their context and helping them adopt security improvements in a way that fits how they build
* Own and evolve vulnerability management, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, and secrets scanning across our code and services, and make sure findings actually get fixed
* Translate risks and requirements from customers, operators, audits, and the risk register into concrete, sized work for the right teams, and follow up so it lands and stays landed
* Triage and coordinate responses to emerging threats: assess severity, involve the right teams, and drive issues to resolution
* Share ownership of the security roadmap with the Security Engineering Lead, and take clear ownership of the areas where your experience is strongest


The role is based either at our new HQ in Malmö or in our Stockholm office.

#### **About you**


You are a pragmatic, hands-on security engineer who enjoys working closely with engineering teams and across team boundaries. You are comfortable moving between code, tooling, and architecture discussions, and you care about making security scalable, practical, and usable. You are just as comfortable working independently as you are in a small team where you and a colleague share responsibility for a broad area.


You believe security works best when it is distributed, automated, and embedded, not bolted on in the end. You lead through explanation and good defaults rather than gates and approvals.


You think ahead about what embedded security looks like when engineering is increasingly AI-augmented: agent credentials, MCP and tool-use boundaries, and secure-by-default workflows for code that humans and models write together.

**We are looking for someone with:**

* A hands-on background in software or platform engineering, with real comfort in the terminal, able to run scans, inspect output, and file a PR when needed
* At least 3-5 years of professional experience in software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or a closely related technical role
* Demonstrated experience with the security tooling landscape, such as vulnerability management, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, and secrets scanning, understanding trade-offs, not just installation
* Experience building shared tooling, standards, or paved roads that other engineering teams adopt
* A teaching and enabling mindset: sharing knowledge, running hands-on deep-dives, and leaving capability behind rather than creating dependency
* Strong ability to collaborate with engineers across teams, influence without formal authority, and translate security risks into practical engineering work
* A collaborative way of working with a lead and peers, including sharing context, dividing focus areas, and giving and receiving honest feedback
* Fluent English, written and spoken. Swedish is a plus

#### **Join us at Telavox**


Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.  

  

Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.  

  

We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.


Read more about our new HQ in Malmö !

### **How to apply!**


At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.  

  

We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English.  

  

For any questions, feel free to reach out to Hiring Manager Filip Ahlberg at filip.ahlberg@telavox.com

**Learn more about what we do! ️**

title: Integration Architect
description:
*Norrin is an AI integrator, enabling end-to-end Enterprise AI and data solutions that turn ambition into production and drive real productivity gains. We co-create the solutions, infrastructure, and adoption that make it stick. What brings us together is deep technical expertise, a creative engineering mindset, and a people-first culture.* *Norrin* *has strong roots in Finland while operating internationally across the Nordics, the United States, and APAC.*


We are looking for an **Integration Architect** to strengthen our Stockholm team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and developing modern integration architectures that support our customers’ business-critical needs. You will work closely with customers, architects, developers, and delivery teams to ensure that integration solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with long-term business goals.


The role combines strategic architectural thinking with hands-on technical understanding. You will play a key role in defining integration platforms, API ecosystems, and event-driven operating models while guiding integration projects throughout their entire lifecycle.

**In this role, you will**

* Design modern API-based and event-driven integration solutions in Azure environments
* Define integration architectures following Azure best practices and cloud-native architectural principles
* Make technology choices and technical design decisions in customer projects
* Guide the implementation of integrations using Azure Integration Services such as Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, and Event Hubs
* Support development teams in technical solutions and participate in hands-on design and implementation when needed
* Utilize Infrastructure as Code practices using Terraform
* Ensure secure authentication, authorization, and API security best practices
* Collaborate with customers, architects, and development teams in the design and continuous improvement of end-to-end integration solutions

**What we’re looking for**

* Strong experience in designing integration architectures in Azure environments
* Expertise in Azure Integration Services solutions (Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Event Hubs)
* Understanding of API-led and event-driven architectures
* Ability to make technical decisions and lead architecture discussions in customer projects
* Strong understanding of integration security, authentication, and API security best practices
* Experience in modern cloud development and integration delivery
* Fluent Swedish and English language skills

**Your technical toolkit includes**

* Azure Integration Services: Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, and Event Hubs
* API and event-driven architectures and integration patterns
* C# and the .NET ecosystem for integration and cloud solutions
* Infrastructure as Code practices and solutions (Terraform)
* OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API Security practices
* CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions

At Norrin, you'll join an international team of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. title: Processledare till Produktion & Service BAE Systems Hägglunds
description:
**Vill du vara med och utveckla hur vi arbetar – från idé till genomförd förbättring? Som processledare får du en central roll i att identifiera, driva och samordna förbättringar av arbetsprocesser inom och mellan sektioner. Du arbetar nära processägare, chefer och medarbetare och bidrar till att våra processer är effektiva, kvalitetssäkrade och stödjer verksamhetens mål. Rollen passar dig som trivs i en miljö där du får kombinera analys och struktur med samarbete, problemlösning och förändringsledning.**

 **Din framtida utmaning**


Som processledare är du direkt underställd sektionschef, som också är processägare. Du får en central roll i att utveckla och förbättra verksamhetens arbetssätt och processer, både inom den egna sektionen och i samverkan med andra delar av organisationen.


Du identifierar och analyserar förbättringsbehov, tar fram förslag och handlingsplaner och leder arbetet från idé till genomförd förbättring. Du bereder verksamhetsutvecklingsinitiativ inför beslut och följer upp att beslutade åtgärder ger önskad effekt. I rollen ingår även att bidra till prioritering och samordning av tvärfunktionella och tvärsektionella förbättringsinitiativ.


Du deltar även i sektionens ledningsgrupp och bidrar med ett tydligt process- och förbättringsperspektiv.


Du kommer också att stötta organisationen i metodik för processutveckling och förändringsarbete. Det kan exempelvis innebära att vägleda processägare och medarbetare i hur förbättringsbehov hanteras eller att stötta arbetet med att hålla processrelaterad dokumentation aktuell.

 **Några centrala delar av rollen är att:**

* Leda förbättringsarbete – från identifierat behov och analys till beslut, genomförande och uppföljning.
* Leda operativa processforum och löpande utvärdera att processerna är ändamålsenliga
* Ansvarig för att skriva och revidera processer
* Samordna tvärfunktionella initiativ och bidra till att organisationens förbättringsarbete hålls samman och prioriteras.
* Skapa engagemang och struktur genom att leda workshops, arbetsgrupper och processforum.
* Följa upp och rapportera status, resultat och eventuella avvikelser till processägare.

  

Du har mandat att fatta beslut om processförbättringar inom ramen för ditt uppdrag och gällande beslutsmandat. Du representerar även sektionen i tvärfunktionella sammanhang och samarbetar med bland annat processägare, linjechefer, andra processledare, IM&T, PMO och projektorganisationer.

 **Den du är**


Vi söker dig som har ett starkt intresse för verksamhetsutveckling och förbättringsarbete och som trivs med att skapa struktur, driva förändring och få människor att arbeta tillsammans mot gemensamma mål.

**Önskvärda erfarenheter och kvalifikationer:**

* Akademisk examen eller motsvarande erfarenhet
* Kunskap om metoder och principer för processutveckling och förändringsledning.
* God förståelse för verksamhetens processer, leverabler och hur olika delar av organisationen hänger ihop.
* Stark analytisk förmåga och ett lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt.
* God kommunikations- och ledarskapsförmåga och trivs med att leda grupper, workshops och möten.
* Förmåga att inspirera och engagera andra i förändrings- och förbättringsarbete.

  

Som person är du prestigelös och samarbetsorienterad. Du kan representera den egna sektionens behov samtidigt som du har förmåga att förstå och väga in andra verksamheters perspektiv. Du ser helheten, bygger goda relationer och har lätt för att skapa engagemang kring förändring.


Det är också viktigt att du är trygg i att prioritera och fatta beslut inom ditt mandat och att du har förmåga att driva frågor från identifierat förbättringsbehov till genomförd förändring och överlämning till ansvarig mottagare. I rollen kommer du att arbeta i bland annat M365, MS Project, Azure DevOps, Visio och företagets verktyg för processutveckling.

 **Vad du blir en del av**


Hos oss kommer du att ha kul på jobbet och ingen dag kommer att vara den andra lik! Du kommer att få vara med när produkten blir till från idé till dess att den rullar ut till kund. Du kommer att få jobba med framtidens teknik i ett globalt företag där du har stora möjligheter till kompetens & karriärutveckling.


BAE Systems levererar några av världens mest avancerade, teknikledande lösningar inom försvar, flyg och säkerhet. Vi har 82 500 kvalificerade medarbetare i mer än 40 länder. Genom att vi arbetar tillsammans med kunder och lokala partners, levererar vi produkter och tjänster med militär kapacitet, som skyddar människor och den nationella säkerheten samt säkrar viktig information och infrastruktur.


BAE Systems Hägglunds fokuserar på utveckling, tillverkning, integration och support av ett brett spektrum av militära fordon till kunder över hela världen. Våra främsta produkter är medeltunga stridsfordon (CV90), bepansrade terrängfordon (BvS10), stöd och support samt elhybrida drivsystem för den civila marknaden. Pålitlig, Innovativ och Djärv är ledorden för vår verksamhet.

title: AI Solution Engineer
description:
**AI Solution Engineers** shape the future of business workflows by designing, building and operating advanced AI capabilities. In Goteborg, onsite collaboration with users, product teams, architects and delivery colleagues anchors technical innovation in practical outcomes. You combine C#/.NET and Azure expertise with applied AI skills to clarify requirements, validate problems and deliver reliable, measurable results. Leveraging precise specifications and AI coding agents, you support robust delivery and continuous improvement. This role matters because it connects technical excellence to real business impact.

**Responsibilities**

* Work with business stakeholders and users to understand workflows, clarify assumptions, assess data availability, and agree measurable acceptance criteria for AI capabilities
* Turn agreed requirements into buildable specifications covering inputs, outputs, data contracts, business rules, failure paths and validation scenarios
* Design and implement AI services and integrations using C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core and Azure, making technical decisions within agreed architectural constraints
* Integrate models, enterprise data, and APIs into applications; implement retrieval-augmented generation and controlled agent workflows where appropriate, with clear human review and fallback paths
* Build focused prototypes to test feasibility and assumptions, then develop validated capabilities into maintainable production services
* Use AI coding agents against explicit specifications; review generated code, test behavior, diagnose failures and refine specifications or implementations based on evidence
* Define evaluation datasets and quality thresholds; validate output quality, security, latency and cost, and work with users to confirm the capability improves the intended workflow
* Implement CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, deployment, monitoring, and rollback; manage model and prompt versions and investigate production issues
* Address access control, sensitive data handling, prompt injection and unreliable outputs; document limitations, operating procedures and design decisions
* Explain technical trade-offs and operating costs, surface risks early and provide implementation guidance and code reviews while keeping delivery within the agreed scope

**Requirements**

* Five years of professional software engineering experience, including two years building applied AI/ML solutions
* Evidence of delivering at least one AI capability into production, with direct responsibility for implementation, deployment, evaluation and operational improvement
* Strong hands-on C#, .NET and ASP.NET Core skills, including API design, asynchronous processing, automated testing, and integration with databases and enterprise systems
* Practical Azure experience covering application hosting, identity, data access and AI services; a solid DevOps foundation in CI/CD, containers and infrastructure automation
* Working knowledge of ML and generative AI fundamentals, with hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs and retrieval-based applications and evaluating their limitations
* Experience defining evaluation criteria and representative test cases, monitoring AI behavior and balancing output quality, latency, reliability, and inference cost
* Ability to clarify ambiguous requirements, model data and workflow states and produce testable specifications; practical experience using AI coding assistants or agents with code review and verification
* Strong troubleshooting and communication skills: able to distinguish requirement gaps, data or model limitations, implementation defects and evaluation issues, and explain findings to technical and business colleagues
* Ability to work independently within an agreed scope and collaborate across product, engineering and operations
* Relevant degree or equivalent practical experience

**Nice to have**

* Experience with controlled agent workflows, tool integration, human approval mechanisms or business process automation
* Python, model adaptation or fine-tuning and established MLOps practices for custom models
* Experience with Kubernetes, reusable AI components or improving an existing enterprise codebase
* Automotive industry experience or relevant Azure, AI or cloud certifications

* Company’s pension plan
* Private healthcare insurance
* Safety & life insurance
* Gym discounts
* Wellness Grant (SEK 2000)
* Corporate Programs including Employee Referral Program with rewards

title: Business Analyst – People Domain
description:

Securitas is a world-leading safety and security solutions partner that helps make your world a safer place. By leveraging technology in partnership with our clients, we offer a broad portfolio of value-enhancing services and solutions integrated across the security value chain – from on-site services to advanced monitoring, comprehensive risk prediction and advisory services.


With around 322 000 employees in 44 markets, our innovative, holistic approach with local and global expertise makes us a trusted business partner to many of the world’s best-known companies. Benefitting from almost nine decades of deep experience and guided by our values of integrity, vigilance, and helpfulness, we create sustainable value by helping our clients optimize their operations and protect what matters most - their people and assets.

**About the role**


The Business Analyst will be part of a high-performing and international team with the goal to expand Data & Analytics solutions for our BI deliveries for all Securitas countries with the main focus in the People Domain. You will be responsible for representing and coordinating the business perspective throughout the BI delivery process. This includes obtaining, clarifying, documenting, and mapping business requirements. Continuous improvement requires a broader end-to-end perspective and close collaboration across the team. The Business Analyst will collaborate with the IT Lead BI & Analytics, other business analysts, the Data Engineer team, and the BI developer / frontend designer to align possibilities to improve the BI deliverables. Based on input from the business, the Business Analyst advises the IT Lead BI & Analytics on the capabilities required by end users and monitors the delivery process from requirement through implementation.


The Business Analyst is expected to consistently consider data privacy and security when data is accessed, transferred, or shared. The role supports the definition and implementation of appropriate data-access and security controls in alignment with Legal and relevant data-protection stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* Build, maintain, and develop relationships with stakeholders across both IT and the business, with a particular focus on the People Domain.
* Identify and document changes required in the data model to support new BI requirements.
* Coordinate the end-to-end process from initial requirement through validation and delivery.
* Engage existing communities of expertise, including country Power Users, to identify and prioritize enhancements to the BI platform.
* Maintain regular engagement with business stakeholders to anticipate upcoming changes and their potential impact on the BI platform.
* In cooperation with the IT Lead BI & Analytics manage end-user expectations and improve the engagement in our data-driven journey
* Collaborate across the team and use the agreed DevOps tooling to maintain visibility of scope, status, dependencies, decisions, and delivery progress.
* Ensure understanding and visible implementation of the company’s core values of Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness.

And any other duties as directed by the IT Lead BI & Analytics.

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills: ability to communicate, present and influence credibly at all levels, internally and externally; able to work across different cultures and countries.
* Delivery mindset: ability to manage the process from requirement to deliverable, work in a structured way, and collaborate with multiple team members to keep track of status from start to end (incl. using DevOps tooling as defined by the team).
* Data privacy & security awareness: consistently considers data privacy when moving/sharing data and supports the implementation of the security layer as agreed with the legal department.
* Strong analytical mindset with problem-solving skills, proactive approach, and solid time management and self-management.
* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, with the ability to connect reporting requirements to operational and business outcomes.

**Requirements**


Minimum Required:

* Experience in time sensitive projects / environments

title: AWS Cloud Engineer
description:
**About the role** 




 At 0TO9 (Zero to Nine) you’ll build the cloud foundation behind the licensed financial companies we start & scale. Every new venture lands on this platform, in a regulated market where resilience, security and evidence matter as much as speed. It’s a chance to shape that foundation while it’s still young enough to shape.
 



  





 The role covers three areas:
 


* **The organisation layer.** 
 Design and run our AWS landing zone with AWS Control Tower and AWS Organizations: guardrails, service control policies, and preventive and detective controls enforced from the top and applied the same way to every account.
* **The venture layer.** 
 Create new accounts for new ventures and roll out our infrastructure blueprint in each one, so every venture goes from an empty account to production-grade hosting the same way, every time.
* **Resilience and compliance.** 
 Define recovery objectives (RTO and RPO) for every critical service, build disaster recovery that meets them, and prove it with recurring tests. Keep the platform compliant with DORA, and be the person who walks auditors and supervisors through our controls and the evidence behind them.



  





 You’ll work closely with our CTO and CISO on a daily basis.
 



  





 Day to day you will:
 


* Build and evolve our infrastructure as code in AWS CDK (TypeScript), reviewed and deployed through pipelines, never by hand.
* Run containerised .NET microservices on ECS Fargate, with RDS (SQL Server and PostgreSQL), S3 and DynamoDB behind them.
* Own identity and access: Okta as our identity provider, federated into IAM Identity Center for SSO, with least-privilege roles and no long-lived keys.
* Run the security baseline across every account: centralised logging, threat detection, configuration compliance, WAF at the edge, KMS encryption everywhere.
* Run recurring disaster recovery and restore tests against our recovery objectives, and turn the results into evidence an auditor can follow.
* Run recurring compliance checks, so we know we’re still compliant between audits rather than finding out during one.
* Keep cost visible: budgets, anomaly detection and tagging, so a surprise on the bill shows up as an alert rather than at month-end.
* Work with security, compliance and risk to turn regulatory requirements, DORA included, into controls that are built, tested and documented.



  





**How we build** 




 Agentic coding is our default, not an experiment. Across the group, we run a Claude-Code-native workspace:
 


* Engineering standards loaded as a skill, so agents apply them automatically.
* A git-backed knowledge base that agents read and extend.
* Agent workflows that take a change from branch to reviewed PR, infrastructure included.
* An automated reviewer in CI that counts as an approving review on a pull request.



 We’re looking for someone who already works this way and makes agents a normal part of how they build, including against live cloud accounts, with the judgement to know when a change needs a human eye first.
 



  





**About you** 




 We think you’ll be a great fit if you:
 


* Have hands-on experience designing and running production workloads on AWS, ideally across many accounts.
* Have built or operated an AWS landing zone with Control Tower or Organizations, SCPs, account vending and centralised security accounts.
* Write infrastructure as code by default. CDK is preferred; Terraform or CloudFormation is welcome.
* Take ownership, challenge unclear requirements, and put reliability and security ahead of shortcuts.
* Can explain a control to an engineer and to an auditor, and know the difference between configuring a control and evidencing it.
* Already lean on LLMs and agentic tools daily, and see them as leverage, not a shortcut.



  





**Technical Requirements** 




 We build on AWS, with .NET and SQL on the backend. This role lives in the platform, and AWS is a requirement.
 



  





**Cloud & Infrastructure** 



* AWS-native: Organizations, Control Tower, ECS/Fargate, RDS, S3, least-privilege IAM.
* Infrastructure as code: CDK in TypeScript, with stacks you can diff, review and roll back.
* Multi-account by design: environments separated by account, not by naming convention.
* EU data residency: you know why region matters, and how to enforce it rather than hope for it.



  





**Security & Compliance** 



* Security by default: WAF, encryption at rest and in transit, customer-managed KMS keys where it matters.
* Zero hardcoded secrets: Secrets Manager with rotation, always.
* Detection that leads somewhere: GuardDuty, Security Hub and Config, with every finding routed to an owner.
* Audit-ready: organisation CloudTrail, log retention by design, and every change traceable to a reviewed PR.



  





**Resilience & Operations** 



* Disaster recovery: RTO and RPO defined per service, DR designs that meet them, and tests on a schedule that prove it.
* Backup and restore: AWS Backup, cross-region copies, and restores rehearsed rather than assumed.
* Observability: CloudWatch and Datadog, with alarms that reach a human.
* Cost control: budgets, anomaly detection and cost allocation tags.



  





**Delivery & Quality** 



* CI/CD fluency: GitHub Actions and CDK Pipelines, or equivalent.
* Reviewable PRs: small diffs, no self-merges, no console changes in production.
* Tested infrastructure: unit-tested constructs and synthesised templates.
* Supply-chain hygiene: dependency and image scanning before ship.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Knowledge of DORA and how it works in practice: ICT risk management, resilience testing, third-party risk and incident reporting.
* Previous fintech or banking industry experience. You’ll ramp faster in a regulated market.
* AWS certifications, for example Solutions Architect Professional or Security Specialty.
* Experience with event-driven platforms (ideally NATS), or with hosting AI workloads on Amazon Bedrock.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
When you join the Fountain team, you become part of the leading enterprise solution for frontline workforce management. Fountain’s automated, customizable platform provides a seamless applicant experience for workers, while ensuring organizations can scale and manage their frontline talent.
 




  






 We’ve helped hundreds of companies like UPS, CLEAR, Stitch Fix, GoPuff, Fetch, and sweetgreen to hire, onboard, and manage over 14 million workers in more than 75 countries.
 





 In 2022, we closed $185M in our Series C, led by SoftBank and B Capital.
 




  






 Join our growing team of highly collaborative, ambitious, and forward-thinking Fountaineers as we empower our hundreds of customers and millions of frontline workers around the world.
 




  






 Let’s elevate frontline work together.
   







 As a
 
****Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)****

 at Fountain, you’ll own the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of the systems that power our platform. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Security, and Product to build resilient infrastructure, improve developer experience, and raise the bar on observability and incident response.
 




  





****What you'll be doing:****




  




* Own and improve platform reliability (SLOs/SLIs), capacity planning, and production readiness
* Design, build, and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure and deployment workflows
* Operate and evolve our AWS footprint (networking, compute, storage, IAM) with a security-first mindset
* Improve our CD/GitOps practices (ArgoCD) and deployment safety (progressive delivery, rollbacks, guardrails)
* Build autoscaling strategies for services and workloads (KEDA where appropriate)
* Lead incident response: on-call, triage, mitigation, postmortems, and preventative follow-through
* Strengthen observability across services: metrics, logs, traces, and alerting (OpenTelemetry + dashboards)
* Partner with application teams to tune performance, reduce toil, and improve operational maturity
* Improve infrastructure-as-code practices and maintain Terraform modules and environments
* Contribute to evaluating and integrating AI tooling and MCP tools to accelerate operational workflows



  





****What you should bring:****




  




* 5+ years of experience in site reliability engineering
* Experience owning reliability for production systems — defining SLOs or running error budgets
* Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes/Helm on EKS in production
* Experience with Cloudflare (CDN, WAF, etc)
* Experience with CI/CD or general GitOps deployment pattern experience
* Has led or significantly contributed to incident response and postmortem processes
* Working knowledge of AWS core services (networking, IAM, compute) beyond just EKS



  

****Nice to have:****




  




* Experience evaluating or building AI-assisted ops tooling (MCP, agentic runbooks)
* OpenTelemetry / observability pipeline design
* ArgoCD, KEDA autoscaling
* Experience with Terraform




 Even if you do not meet all the requirements above, we still encourage you to apply for this position. While we try to be thorough with our prerequisites, not everything about you as a candidate can be condensed into a list of bullet points. What do you have to lose?
 




  





****Fountain offers an incredibly unique work environment.****

 We employ a diverse team all over the world. Each Fountaineer is given the freedom to do their best work from wherever they choose. We also understand the importance of in-person connections and hold in-person meetings with your team and meet annually as an organization to build our relationships and focus on the future of moving Fountain Forward. 
 




  






 The benefits we offer in the United States include competitive health plans and a retirement plan. Some Fountain-wide  perks offered to all employees across the globe include a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, monthly lunch stipends, annual allowances for ongoing education related to your profession and career advancement, along with home office, cell phone, and wellness reimbursements. Fountain is a global employer, so some benefit offerings will vary from country to country.
 




  






 Fountain is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, socioeconomic status, disability, and veteran status.
 




  





*By submitting an application, you confirm that you have read our* 
*Privacy Policy* 
*and agree that we may process and retain your personal data for the purpose of recruitment in accordance with applicable data protection laws.*

title: Senior Linux System Administrator
description:
**Vill du arbeta med avancerade Linuxmiljöer där stabil drift möter modern teknik och automation?**
 På Axians får du möjlighet att arbeta med verksamhetskritiska Linuxplattformar hos några av Sveriges mest krävande kunder. Vi söker nu en erfaren
 **Senior Linux System Administrator** 
 som vill ta ansvar för den dagliga driften, förvaltningen och vidareutvecklingen av Linuxmiljöer inom våra OS Management-tjänster.
   

  

 Här får du kombinera tekniskt djup med ett stort operativt ansvar. Du arbetar nära kunder, kollegor och tredjepartsleverantörer i komplexa driftmiljöer där säkerhet, kvalitet och tillgänglighet står i fokus. Samtidigt får du möjlighet att bidra till förbättringar, standardisering och smartare arbetssätt genom automation.
   

  

 Som en del av Axians och VINCI Energies blir du en del av ett globalt nätverk med över 200 000 medarbetare där innovation, entreprenörskap och kunskapsutveckling är en naturlig del av vardagen.
   

  

**Din roll**
 I rollen som
 **Senior Linux System Administrator** 
 arbetar du operativt med drift, administration, underhåll och vidareutveckling av Linuxbaserade servermiljöer. En stor del av vardagen består av att hantera
 **kundärenden, felsöka problem och arbeta med incidenter** 
 för att säkerställa stabila och säkra produktionsmiljöer.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med patchning och systemuppdateringar, inklusive automatiserad patchning, changehantering, övervakning och löpande underhåll av Linuxservrar. Du deltar även i säkerhetsarbete, exempelvis hardening enligt
 **CIS Benchmarks** 
 , och använder scripting och automation som stöd för att effektivisera och standardisera det dagliga arbetet.
   

  

 Rollen innebär mycket samverkan med både kunder och tredjepartsleverantörer. Du behöver därför vara trygg i att kommunicera tekniska frågor, driva ärenden framåt och samarbeta med olika parter för att hitta lösningar.
   

  

 Du förväntas kunna ta ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och bidra med din erfarenhet till teamet. Automation är en viktig del av arbetssättet, men rollen är framför allt en
 **operativ Linuxroll** 
 där den dagliga driften och kundleveransen står i centrum.
   

  

 Beredskap ingår i tjänsten och genomförs enligt gällande beredskapsschema.
   

  

**Kompetensprofil**
 Du har
 **gedigen erfarenhet av Linuxdrift i produktionsmiljö** 
 och trivs med ett operativt arbete där felsökning, incidenthantering och löpande drift är centrala delar. Du är van att ta ansvar för Linuxservrar genom hela deras livscykel och har ett strukturerat arbetssätt även när problemen är komplexa.
   

  

**Du Har Erfarenhet Av**
* Linuxadministration och drift i större produktionsmiljöer
* Debian, Red Hat Enterprise Linux och/eller Rocky Linux
* Drift, administration, underhåll och felsökning av Linuxservrar
* Patchning och systemuppdateringar, gärna även automatiserad patchning
* Incident-, change- och ärendehantering
* Security hardening enligt CIS Benchmarks
* Bash och Python
* Automation och Ansible
* Nätverk, DNS och övervakning
* Kund- och tredjepartssamverkan
* God kommunikativ förmåga i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska


**Extra intressant om du även har erfarenhet av**
* Kubernetes. Detta är ett område som vi vill utveckla framåt, men det är inte en central del av rollen från start.
* Managed Services eller outsourcingverksamhet
* Red Hat Satellite

 Om du vill arbeta med verksamhetskritiska Linuxmiljöer, bidra till en stabil och säker leverans och samtidigt vara med och förbättra våra arbetssätt, ser vi fram emot din ansökan.
   

  

**Axians erbjuder**
