title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Bannerflow is a fast-growing global SaaS company building a Creative Intelligence Platform that enables enterprise brands to predict, create, and optimize advertising across channels.
   

  

 We’re on a company-wide AI transformation journey, where AI and agentic workflows are becoming a core part of how we build and innovate, with high expectations on adoption across all teams.
   

  

 Our teams are highly autonomous, collaborative, and we are now looking for another passionate engineer to join us!
   

  

**The challenge: Scaling data for the future**
 Our Platform Serves 500+ Million Impressions Daily, With Peaks Over 1 Billion Impressions, And We’re Just Getting Started. We’re Currently Rebuilding Our Entire Data Infrastructure From The Ground Up To Adopt a Data Lakehouse Approach, Enabling
   

  

* Scalability & Flexibility: Handling billions of data points while staying cost-efficient and future-proof.
* Data-Driven Features (AI & ML): Enabling predictive models and automation based on historical data.
* Business Intelligence & Analytics: Delivering insights directly to customers in our platform.


 To make this vision a reality, we’re looking for an experienced Data Platform Engineer to join our Platform team, and take full ownership of designing and building a scalable, high-performance data platform that will power the next generation of our product.
   

  

**Are you + Bannerflow = True? 🦋**
 We believe this is an opportunity for you who want to take the technical lead and define our data platform and best practices. Your work will directly impact or product vision, customers, and drive innovation in Ad Tech as part of an autonomous tech team. You'll tackle cutting-edge challenges in large-scale data processing, ML pipelines, and advanced analytics.
   

  

 At Bannerflow, we live by our values of passion, collaboration, and challenge. You'll be part of a vibrant culture with activities like board game nights, Friday beers, and Level-up Hackathons. We offer a hybrid workplace and a competitive compensation package, including pension according to ITP1, health allowance, parental leave top-up, and health care insurance.
   

  

**Your mission**
* Design and build scalable data pipelines for analytics and AI-driven features.
* Build on our existing lakehouse foundations to shape the architecture's next stage, balancing performance, flexibility, and cost.
* Ensure high data quality and reliability, implementing best practices in data modelling, governance and observability.
* Collaborate closely with our Data Analysts, Chief Architect, Engineers, and Product teams to create data-driven features and insights.
* Evaluate and implement new technologies to ensure a modern, scalable, and future-proof data stack.


**So, what are we looking for?**
* 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer/Data Platform Engineer/Data Lead, working with large-scale data processing.
* Strong knowledge of cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure, or AWS).
* Experience working with data lake and lakehouse technologies (cloud storage solutions, Iceberg tables, Delta Lake, etc.).
* Experience working with workflow orchestration platforms such as Prefect, Dagster, or Airflow, including designing, implementing, and operating data workflows in production environments.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, including data modeling, query optimization, and building reliable data movement patterns between operational and analytical systems.
* Experience with designing scalable architectures and pipelines that support large datasets efficiently.
* Passion for AI/ML-driven data features and enabling advanced analytics.
* Problem-solver mindset, you love optimizing performance and building robust systems.
* Curiosity & ownership – you thrive in an environment where you can experiment and improve.


**Not sure if you check all the boxes? Apply anyway!**
 We believe that mindset and passion are just as important as technical skills. If you have a software engineering background, love solving complex problems, and are a data nerd at heart, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t meet every requirement. We’re looking for the right person, not just the perfect resume. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.
   

  

 Join us at Bannerflow and help us build a world-class data platform that powers the future of Ad Tech!
   

  

**A quick summer note** 
 🌞 Please apply as usual, we'd still love to hear from you! Many of us are taking time off right now, so applications will only be reviewed sporadically until we're back to our usual pace in August. Thanks for your patience.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
At Tele2, we challenge the telecom industry to create more valuable solutions for our customers. Guided by our challenger mindset, we deliver high-quality connectivity and digital services, ranging from mobile and fixed networks to TV, streaming and global IoT.
   

  

 Sustainability is an integral part of how we work. Tele2 has been recognized as a climate leader in Europe by the Financial Times and named Sweden’s most sustainable company, reflecting our long-term commitment to reducing our environmental impact and advancing circular solutions together with our customers.
   

  

 Our values – Be Brave, Take Action, Make it Simple and Act Cost-efficiently – guide our culture, how we collaborate and how we turn ideas into action.
   

  

 Ready to take technical ownership of systems that process some of Sweden’s largest data volumes and explore how AI can transform operations?
   

  

 At Tele2, Digital Capabilities & Technology (DCT) is the engine behind our mobile and fixed networks. Within Network Data, our Performance Management team builds and operates the in-house systems that collect, process and analyze performance data across all network domains.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Senior Software Engineer who wants to play a key role in evolving and modernizing our core performance systems.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You will join a highly technical team of software engineers responsible for Tele2’s Performance Management platform. We collect and process large-scale telemetry and statistics from mobile and fixed networks, transforming raw data into insights that drive operational and strategic decisions. We are currently evolving our architecture and we actively embrace modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development tools, to accelerate how we design, build, and maintain our software. This means you will have real influence over architecture, technical direction and ways of working.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is not a junior position. We are looking for someone who can:
   

  

* Take technical ownership of critical services
* Contribute to system design and architectural decisions
* Improve performance, scalability and reliability
* Mentor and elevate the engineering standards of the team


 You will work in a Linux-based, containerized environment handling high-volume data streams and backend services.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop and evolve backend services in Go and/or Java
* Improve and optimize high-throughput data processing pipelines
* Drive best practices around CI/CD, testing and engineering quality
* Operate and troubleshoot systems in production
* Collaborate with architects, analysts and network stakeholders
* Contribute to long-term system design and modernization initiatives


 Participation in on-call rotation may be part of the role.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
*We believe you have:*
* Several years of professional software development experience
* Strong hands-on experience in Go and/or Java
* Solid understanding of Linux-based systems
* Experience with Git-based CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes)
* Experience with Kafka or other event-driven architectures
* Experience in designing scalable backend systems
* Understanding of networking fundamentals


*It is a strong plus if you have experience with:*
* Ansible or infrastructure automation
* System design in high-availability environments
* Performance optimization of large-scale data processing
* Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)


**Who You Are**
 You are a curious and hands-on software engineer who thinks beyond your own code. You enjoy understanding how systems fit together, experimenting with new technology and turning ideas into reliable software.
   

  

 You communicate clearly, collaborate without prestige and take ownership of what you build.
   

  

 You make complex systems understandable to others through clear documentation, code reviews and shared technical decisions. You actively spread knowledge and build solutions that more than one person can operate and evolve.
   

  

**Why this role matters**
 Our systems are central to how Tele2 monitors and improves network performance. We are now exploring how AI and automation can transform the way NOC and other operational teams work with network data.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to:
   

  

* Shape the architecture of systems in a critical and complex domain
* Work with high-volume, real-world network data
* Build and evolve critical systems using real-world data
* Work across software engineering, data, AI and network operations
* Have visible impact across the organization


**Benefits**
 Pension and health care
   

  

 Hybrid and flexible work life balance
   

  

 Career opportunities
   

  

 Parental benefit
   

  

 Employee benefits and Tele2 discounts
   

  

 Inclusive workplace

title: Security Engineer
description:
**Join Telavox as a Security Engineer 🔐**
 Are you a hands-on security engineer who enjoys being close to the code, the systems, and the teams building them? At Telavox, security is not a gate at the end of development. It is an embedded capability that enables us to move fast, safely, and at scale.
   

  

 Telavox is a fast-growing digital telco that combines the reliability of telecom with the agility of SaaS across Europe and across the globe. As our platform grows, security becomes a force multiplier, not just protecting what we build, but actively enabling engineers to ship better and safer software every day.
   

  

 We are growing our Security Engineering team and looking for a Security Engineer to join our engineering organisation. You will work side by side with our Security Engineering Lead, sharing the same mission and many of the same activities, and bringing your own depth and perspective to the team. Together you will make security a built-in property of every system we ship, by making the secure way the easy way for every engineering team.
   

  

**About The Job**
 As a Security Engineer, you are part of the engineering execution layer that makes security real across the Platform organisation. You work across product and platform teams, building paved roads, secure defaults, and standards that teams adopt as their own, instead of doing every team's security for them.
   

  

 You are a close partner to the Security Engineering Lead, who sets direction and priorities for the function. You complement each other: you share the work, challenge each other's thinking, and divide focus areas based on where your strengths are deepest. You also help bridge the gap between the CISO's strategic direction and day-to-day engineering reality, turning security goals into concrete engineering outcomes.
   

  

**Your Day-to-day Work Includes**
* Build and evolve paved roads that make secure choices the default, such as vulnerability management workflows, secrets handling, and secure-by-default patterns in CI/CD
* Work cross-functionally with engineering teams, understanding their context and helping them adopt security improvements in a way that fits how they build
* Own and evolve vulnerability management, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, and secrets scanning across our code and services, and make sure findings actually get fixed
* Translate risks and requirements from customers, operators, audits, and the risk register into concrete, sized work for the right teams, and follow up so it lands and stays landed
* Triage and coordinate responses to emerging threats: assess severity, involve the right teams, and drive issues to resolution
* Share ownership of the security roadmap with the Security Engineering Lead, and take clear ownership of the areas where your experience is strongest


 The role is based either at our new HQ in Malmö or in our Stockholm office.
   

  

**About You**
 You are a pragmatic, hands-on security engineer who enjoys working closely with engineering teams and across team boundaries. You are comfortable moving between code, tooling, and architecture discussions, and you care about making security scalable, practical, and usable. You are just as comfortable working independently as you are in a small team where you and a colleague share responsibility for a broad area.
   

  

 You believe security works best when it is distributed, automated, and embedded, not bolted on in the end. You lead through explanation and good defaults rather than gates and approvals.
   

  

 You think ahead about what embedded security looks like when engineering is increasingly AI-augmented: agent credentials, MCP and tool-use boundaries, and secure-by-default workflows for code that humans and models write together.
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone With**
* A hands-on background in software or platform engineering, with real comfort in the terminal, able to run scans, inspect output, and file a PR when needed
* At least 3-5 years of professional experience in software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or a closely related technical role
* Demonstrated experience with the security tooling landscape, such as vulnerability management, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, and secrets scanning, understanding trade-offs, not just installation
* Experience building shared tooling, standards, or paved roads that other engineering teams adopt
* A teaching and enabling mindset: sharing knowledge, running hands-on deep-dives, and leaving capability behind rather than creating dependency
* Strong ability to collaborate with engineers across teams, influence without formal authority, and translate security risks into practical engineering work
* A collaborative way of working with a lead and peers, including sharing context, dividing focus areas, and giving and receiving honest feedback
* Fluent English, written and spoken. Swedish is a plus


****Join us at Telavox 💚****
 Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.
   

  

 Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.
   

  

 We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.
   

  

 Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!
   

  

**How to apply!**
 At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.
   

  

 We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English.
   

  

 For any questions, feel free to reach out to Hiring Manager Filip Ahlberg at filip.ahlberg@telavox.com
   

  

**Learn more about what we do! ⬇️**
 Telavox develops world-leading communications platforms with solutions for smart and efficient telephony, PBX, chat and much more. Regardless of whether it involves an entrepreneur-driven startup or a giant among giants, Telavox contributes to making companies more transparent, efficient and accessible.

title: Revenue Operations Engineer
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To make every leader better. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable insights and impactful moments.
   

  

 We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
   

  

**The role**
 We're building a Revenue Operations function where AI, automation and systems design are the core of how we scale. Not as a layer on top of how we work, but as the way we work: systems handle what can be systematised, so our reps spend their time on what only people can do, building relationships, reading a room, making the judgement call. This role sits at the centre of that.
   

  

 It is a full-stack internal product role. Your users are our Enterprise GTM reps and leaders; your job is to understand how they work, find where friction or guesswork slows them down, and solve it with tailored, proactive solutions. That means designing how our revenue stack connects, embedding AI into live revenue workflows, and shaping the role-specific surfaces our teams work from. You own how it's architected, how it's automated, and how it evolves as the business does.
   

  

 You'll sit in the RevTech & Ops team within Revenue Operations, reporting to the RevTech & Operations Director, and work day-to-day with Sales, Marketing, CS and Analytics. You treat "can this be automated?" as the first question, not the last. You care as much about whether we're solving the right problem as about how it's solved, which means understanding how a sales person actually spends their day. And you'd rather ship a working v1 this week than a perfect design next quarter.You decide how things should be built, build a lot of it yourself, and leave behind architecture someone else can read and extend.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Build internal tools. Design, build and maintain the role-specific UI our Enterprise reps and leaders work in every day. Connect it to the full revenue stack, iterate with the people using it, and keep it fast and reliable as the business changes.
* Remove manual work from GTM roles. Find the repetitive work in revenue teams and automate it with n8n, Clay, CRM automation and AI where it earns its place. Set the automation principles so what you build stays maintainable.
* Own the architecture. Keep the revenue toolstack (sales and marketing) healthy: data models, routing logic, account recycling, activity tracking, invoice objects and the automation between them. Fix what breaks, and design so it breaks less.
* Connect the systems. Build and maintain integrations across the stack via APIs so data moves cleanly and reliably.
* Guard the data. Set governance standards, ownership, definitions, structure, compliance, so reporting stays trustworthy as the stack grows.
* Shape what's next. Assess new tools and architectural changes and lead the complex ones: toolstack replacements, lifecycle redesigns, projects where the outcome is known but the path isn't.
* Work like a modern engineer / builder. Understand logic and dependencies. Use Cursor, Claude code, Vercel and GitHub to scale your own output.


**What Success Looks Like**
 The metric this role moves is
 **ARR / Cost of GTM** 
 . In practice: reps spending their time in one place instead of six, fewer hours of manual work in GTM roles, fewer break-fixes, integrations that works, and data people trust without double-checking.
   

  

**What You Bring**
* 3+ years in RevOps, Engineering, GTM systems or a similar role with real technical depth
* Hands-on experience with a CRM system (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot): architecture, automation, objects, reporting
* A good understanding of APIs, webhooks, git and system integrations
* A current grasp of what agentic AI can and can't do today, and the curiosity to keep up
* High business understanding: you can tell a real problem from a loud one and prioritise accordingly
* Systems thinking: you care about clean architecture and long-term maintainability, not just getting it working
* A strong bias toward execution: proactive, action-oriented, builder's hat on by default


**Strong candidates may also have**
* An engineering background and/or built internal tools for operational teams
* Experience in a Sales or Marketing role, so you know what the people using your work actually need
* Managed a sales tool stack and its integrations end to end
* Driven a toolstack replacement or large-scale CRM re-architecture
* Experience with context engineering, building and maintaining agentic harnesses and guardrails


**Why this role matters**
 Every revenue team at Mentimeter depends on systems that work without them thinking about it. This role is what makes that true — and increasingly, it's what our reps will open first every morning. Get it right and we grow the business without growing operational friction at the same rate.
   

  

**Compensation At Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.
   

  

 The salary range for this role is 55–64,000 SEK per month. The range reflects where you are within this stage of the role: your relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with what the role requires. As you develop and take on more, your salary and level evolve with you.
   

  

 We're committed to supporting your growth. You'll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.
   

  

 In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm
   

  

**What Mentimeter Can Offer**
 At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
   

  

 All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
   

  

**AI and Hiring at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
   

  

* AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
* There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
* Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.


 AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.
   

  

**Culture at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.
   

  

 Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.
   

  

 Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

title: Technical Platform Advisor - Stockholm
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$200M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

 This is the most senior seat on the advisory ladder and the person our largest clients trust when it matters most. In legal AI, that trust is hard-won: matters run to fixed dates, data is privileged, and clients hold Legora to the same standard of care they apply to their own work. Part technical advisor, part incident lead, part operating model owner, you hold the technical health of Legora's most complex client relationships and define the playbook the whole function runs on.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Own the relationship: Hold the technical health and escalation outcomes for our Strategic Accounts, serving as their primary point of escalation and continuity, and read usage and adoption signals to get ahead of risk.
* Lead in a crisis: Act as incident lead on Sev1 and Sev2 events, owning coordination, customer communication, and the path to resolution. Drive post-incident reviews as trust-building artifacts and product feedback loops, not just process checkboxes.
* Set the standard: Define and own the escalation criteria, account-health model, and cross-team interfaces the function runs on. Build mechanisms that make the team consistent and not dependent on individual heroics.
* Own the Technical Blueprint: Maintain the single source of truth for each account, including data setup, integrations, security and legal considerations, and workflow context. Carry technical context from implementation into the live relationship so nothing is lost in the handoff and the whole account team can rely on it.
* Drive adoption and enablement: Run technical reviews and enablement sessions that deepen product usage, unlock new value, and keep customers current on the platform.
* Partner proactively: Work with Engagement Managers (CSM function) on Quarterly Business Reviews that tie technical health to business outcomes.
* Coordinate escalations: Align the Platform Consultants and the Technical Platform Expert around a single resolution path, holding customer-facing ownership while technical root cause is driven in parallel.
* Stay close to the signal: Own the highest-stakes cases in the L2 queue for your assigned Strategic Accounts, and serve as the escalation point for Platform Consultants before an issue reaches the Technical Platform Expert, so you stay close to the ground truth of each account's technical health.


 What you bring
   

  

* You have owned strategic, high-value B2B accounts and kept clients confident when things went wrong.
* You have led incident response or major escalations under pressure, start to finish.
* You communicate with executives as clearly as with engineers: confirmed facts, explicit trade-offs, named owners, and no speculation presented as certainty.
* You build frameworks, not workarounds, and you raise the bar for everyone around you.
* A background in legal AI, legal tech, or a regulated professional-services domain is a strong plus.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

* Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across regions, on work that crosses every major legal market.
* Meaningful work: Your work shapes how the world’s leading legal teams adopt AI day to day.
* Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and the tools to do your best work.
* In-person environment: A workspace built for ambitious builders.


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Systemutvecklare .NET, Sthlm
description:
**Jobbeskrivning**
 Vill du utveckla system som bidrar till ett mer effektivt och fungerande samhälle? Hos oss arbetar du med lösningar inom bland annat vård, energi och telekom där kvalitet, stabilitet och långsiktighet är avgörande.
   

  

 Som
 **.NET-utvecklare** 
 hos oss arbetar du som konsult i långsiktiga uppdrag tillsammans med kollegor och kund. Uppdragen varierar från vidareutveckling av befintliga system till nyutveckling och modernisering. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingsprocessen och är med och fattar tekniska beslut som påverkar lösningarnas kvalitet, stabilitet och långsiktighet. Hos oss får du arbeta i agila teamleveranser tillsammans med utvecklare, arkitekter, testare och verksamhet, där samarbete och kunskapsdelning är en naturlig del av vardagen. Läs mer här.
   

  

**Det här erbjuder Sopra Steria dig**
 Hos oss kombinerar du stabiliteten i ett etablerat bolag med en kultur präglad av samarbete, kunskapsdelning och hög teknisk kompetens. Du arbetar i varierande uppdrag med möjlighet att utvecklas vidare inom både teknik och arkitektur tillsammans med erfarna kollegor.
   

  

**Några av våra förmåner**
* 5 000 kr i friskvårdsbidrag samt hälsostöd
* 30 dagars semester samt två extra lediga dagar per år
* Certifieringsbonus och kompetensutveckling
* Föräldralön, tjänstepension och försäkringar
* Bidrag till hemmakontor och arbetsutrustning


**Det här kommer du att göra**
* Utveckla och vidareutveckla .NET-lösningar i komplexa uppdrag
* Vara delaktig i tekniska beslut, design och implementation
* Arbeta nära kund och team i agila leveranser
* Bidra till kvalitet, säkerhet och hållbara lösningar
* Dela kunskap och stötta kollegor i tekniska frågor


**Teknisk miljö**
 Du arbetar genom hela stacken med backend i .NET, C#, ASP.NET Core och REST API:er samt databaser via Entity Framework Core och SQL Server. På frontend arbetar vi med TypeScript och React eller Angular. Våra leveranser bedrivs agilt med fokus på kvalitet och samarbete.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som har**
* Minst fem års erfarenhet av .NET och C#
* Erfarenhet av ASP.NET Core, API-utveckling och databaser
* Erfarenhet av moderna webbtekniker i JavaScript eller TypeScript
* Erfarenhet av att bygga eller vidareutveckla robusta system
* Trivs i eller är nyfiken på konsultrollen
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av Azure eller annan molnplattform

**Rekryteringsprocessen**
 Rollen ställer höga krav på kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet. Inför eventuell anställning genomför vi bakgrundskontroll och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.

title: Konsult / Interim IT-chef i Stockholm
description:
**Vi söker för kunds räkning, en konsult / interim IT-Chef som ska driva förändring, gärna mot AI, i Stockholm.**
 Vi söker en interim / konsult till rollen som IT-Chef som ska driva förändring och modernisering inom IT och AI i Stockholm. Uppdraget är på heltid, startar så snart som möjligt och förväntas pågå under en längre period.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder dig**
 I detta konsultuppdrag får du ta ett strategiskt och operativt ansvar, med målet att skapa tydligt affärsvärde. En roll för dig som vill påverka, leda och utveckla – i en verksamhet som har tydliga ambitioner om modernisering.
   

  

**Det här gör du hos oss**
* Strategiskt och operativt IT-ansvar: Ansvara för koncernens IT-funktion, IT-strategi, budget och roadmap samt säkerställa en stabil, säker och kostnadseffektiv IT-miljö.
* Digital transformation och AI: Driva digitalisering, automatisering och införande av AI-lösningar, exempelvis Microsoft Copilot, för att effektivisera verksamheten och skapa mätbar affärsnytta.
* IT-drift, system och infrastruktur: Säkerställa fungerande IT-infrastruktur, systemförvaltning, support och incidenthantering samt utveckla och effektivisera koncernens systemlandskap.
* IT- och cybersäkerhet: Ansvara för informationssäkerhet, riskhantering, kontinuitetsplanering och regelefterlevnad samt säkerställa ändamålsenliga IT-processer och policys.
* Ledarskap och leverantörsstyrning: Leda och utveckla IT-funktionen, säkerställa rätt kompetens och resurser samt ansvara för externa IT-leverantörer, avtal och uppföljning av IT-leveranser.


**Ditt team och arbetsplats**
 Du ansvarar för IT-avdelningen och arbetar nära ledning och verksamhet. Uppdraget är placerat i Stockholm och man kan jobba i en hybrid arbetsmodell.
   

  

**Mer om dig**
* Flerårig erfarenhet som IT-chef, Head of IT eller motsvarande ledande IT-roll, gärna från en koncern med flera verksamheter.
* Erfarenhet av att kombinera strategiskt IT-arbete med operativt ansvar för IT-drift, infrastruktur och systemförvaltning.
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att driva digital transformation, förändringsarbete och verksamhetsutveckling med stöd av IT.
* God förståelse för AI, automatisering och moderna digitala verktyg, gärna med erfarenhet av Microsoft Copilot.
* Erfarenhet av IT- och cybersäkerhet, riskhantering, GDPR och kontinuitetsplanering.
* Erfarenhet av budgetansvar, leverantörsstyrning, upphandlingar och IT-relaterade avtal.
* Erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla IT-team samt skapa tydliga strukturer, processer och prioriteringar.
* Förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i en ny organisation, identifiera förbättringsområden och omsätta strategier till konkreta resultat.
* Ett affärsorienterat, kommunikativt och prestigelöst ledarskap med förmåga att samarbeta nära verksamhet och ledning.


**Så här får vi kontakt**
 Detta är ett konsultuppdrag där du antingen blir anställd av oss på Ada Digital eller anlitas som underkonsult, beroende på vilken lösning som passar dig bäst. I tillsättningen strävar vi efter att ge dig en transparent, inkluderande och snabbrörlig rekryteringsupplevelse. Och vi vill veta mer om dig och din potential! För att ansöka behöver du inte bifoga några dokument. Skriv istället en kort motivering och bifoga din LinkedIn-profil. Urval kommer sker löpande och uppdraget kan bli tillsatt före sista ansökningsdatum. Är du nyfiken och vill veta mer innan du söker? Hör av dig till ansvarig rekryterare. Vi ser fram emot att få kontakt med dig!

title: Systemoperatör till RIX , vikariat
description:
Vill du vara med och bidra till en säker och effektiv betalningsinfrastruktur för hela Sverige? Just nu söker vi en engagerad systemoperatör. Välkommen till en spännande miljö där du med din kompetens bidrar till samhällsutvecklingen. RIX är en samhällsviktig infrastruktur i Sverige där betalningar från banker och finansiella institut avvecklas i svenska kronor.
   

  

 Riksbanken har som uppdrag att säkerställa stabilitet i det finansiella systemet och se till att betalningar kan utföras på ett säkert och effektivt sätt. Betalningar och betalningssystem utgör centrala delar av Sveriges infrastruktur och Riksbankens system omsätter dagligen cirka 550 miljarder svenska kronor. För att säkerställa att betalningar kan genomföras på ett tryggt och effektivt sätt, äger och driver Riksbanken det centrala betalningssystemet (RIX), som banker och andra aktörer kan använda för att genomföra betalningar samt det stödsystem som används för att följa upp och värdera de säkerheter som motparterna kan ställa mot kredit från Riksbanken.
   

  

**VI ERBJUDER DIG**
 På Riksbanken får du utmaning och utveckling i en händelserik miljö där den svenska betalningsmarknaden står i fokus och arbetet med att driva, förvalta och utveckla Riksbankens betalningssystem RIX är prioriterat. En betydande del av arbetet innefattar samarbeten och kontakter såväl internt som externt, både nationellt och internationellt. Här får du ett utmanande och betydelsefullt arbete där du, tillsammans med kunniga och engagerade kollegor, bidrar till att systemet drivs på ett säkert och effektivt sätt. Du är med och säkerställer god service till systemets deltagare, arbetar med operativ incident- och krishantering samt deltar i vidareutvecklingen av samhällsviktig infrastruktur.
   

  

**DET HÄR GÖR DU HOS OSS**
 Hos oss får du möjlighet att delta i en spännande förändringsresa inom svensk infrastruktur för betalningar, du kommer delta i att förvalta och utveckla Riksbankens betalningssystem. Som systemoperatör kommer du att vara med i teamet som övervakar RIX-systemet och som säkerställer att RIX deltagare, banker och finansiella institut, erhåller god service. Rollen innebär att du hanterar systemadministrativa arbetsuppgifter, säkerställa korrekt utförande av arbetsuppgifter samt hantera eventuella händelser i systemen som kräver omedelbar hantering. Tjänsten är ett heltidsvikariat från januari 2027 – september 2027.
   

  

**Dina Arbetsområden Innefattar Bland Annat**
* Bevaka och kontrollera betalningsflöden i RIX-systemet och flöden i säkerhetshanteringssystemet.
* Support till RIX deltagarna och systemadministration.
* Hantera avvikelser och operativa frågor.
* Delta i incidentorganisationen.


**DITT TEAM**
 Riksbanken består av nio avdelningar. Avdelningen för betalningar har uppdraget att tillhandahålla ett betalningssystem för avveckling av betalningar i Sverige, att försörja landet med kontanter samt arbete med betalningsanalys och innovation. RIX verksamhet är fördelad över tre enheter, enheten för RIX Operations, enheten för RIX Förvaltning och enheten för RIX Affärsutveckling, samtliga ingår i avdelningen för betalningar. Du kommer att arbeta på enheten för RIX Operations. Här kan du läsa mer om Riksbankens organisation.
   

  

 Du ingår i ett team om 12 medarbetare som består av risk- och kontinuitetsansvariga, kundansvariga, analytiker och systemoperatörer. Du har flera interna och externa kontaktytor, till exempel RIX-deltagarna, andra myndigheter och andra centralbanker. Deltagarna i RIX är kreditinstitut, värdepappersföretag, clearingorganisationer, värdepapperscentraler, centrala motparter, e-pengainstitut och betalningsinstitut samt Riksgäldskontoret.
   

  

**MER OM DIG**
 Du trivs i en roll där du får ta ansvar och lösa problem och du har ett gott omdöme. Du är bra på och har lätt för att arbeta i olika IT system. I rollen kommer du att ha många kontaktytor, både internt och externt, och det är viktigt att du kan skapa engagemang och ett positivt samarbetsklimat mellan olika funktioner och yrkesroller.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
**Krav**
* Universitets- eller högskoleutbildning inom ekonomi, systemvetenskap eller närliggande områden alternativt arbetslivserfarenhet som vi bedömer likvärdig.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med systemadministrativa arbetsuppgifter.
* Erfarenhet av och lätt för att arbeta i olika IT-system.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och söker dig som är:
   

  

* Van vid och bra på att skapa förtroenden och samarbeta med andra.
* En skicklig kommunikatör med ett lugnt och samarbetsvilligt förhållningssätt.
* Analytisk och noggrann samt resultat- och lösningsorienterad.
* Ansvarstagande och stabil med ett gott omdöme och personlig mognad.


**Meriter**
* Tidigare erfarenhet från verksamhet inom bank och finans, myndighet eller samhällskritisk infrastruktur.
* Erfarenhet av kundservice.
* Erfarenhet av incidenthantering.
* Erfarenhet av back-office och/eller operativ clearing.
* Kunskap inom värdepappers- eller betalningsområdet.


**MER OM TJÄNSTEN**
 Tillträde: januari 2027 enligt överenskommelse
   

  

 Anställningstyp: Vikariat från januari 2027 till och med september 2027
   

  

 Placering: Huvudkontoret HK Klara (Klarabergsgatan 33-35) Stockholm
   

  

 Arbetstid: Fast arbetstid enligt rullande schema, antingen mellan 06:30 – 15:00 eller 10:00 – 18:30.
   

  

 Möjlighet att jobba distans: Nej
   

  

 Förmåner: Generösa semestervillkor, löneväxling till pension, subventionerad lunch, friskvårdsbidrag, subventionerad massage och tillgång till gym och ledarledda träningspass.
   

  

 Tjänsten kan komma att placeras i säkerhetsklass och en säkerhetsprövning innefattande registerkontroll, säkerhetsprövningssamtal och särskild personutredning görs då för slutkandidaten. För vissa tjänster ställs krav på svenskt medborgarskap.
   

  

**ATT JOBBA PÅ RIKSBANKEN**
 Riksbanken är en myndighet under riksdagen som arbetar på medborgarnas uppdrag för en stark och säker ekonomi. Som landets centralbank har vi en nyckelroll för individer, hushåll och företag i Sverige och i över 350 år har vi utforskat nya vägar för att vara i framkant – från kopparplåtmynt till AI. Oavsett inom vilket område din kompetens finns – är det med stolthet vi tar oss an våra uppdrag. Tillsammans arbetar vi för en låg och stabil inflation, bidrar till ett effektivt och stabilt finansiellt system och säkerställer att betalningar fungerar smidigt, även i kriser. Vi ger också ut Sveriges sedlar och mynt. Läs mer om hur det är att arbeta på Riksbanken här .
   

  

**ANSÖK**
 Vi vill ha din ansökan med CV och personligt brev senast den 20 oktober 2026. Vi vill att du i denna rekrytering besvarar ett antal urvalsfrågor. På så vis kan du enkelt söka tjänsten och vi ges möjligheten att utvärdera kandidater på lika villkor. Logiska tester och arbetsprov kan komma att ingå som en del av rekryteringsprocessen. Vi genomför också bakgrundskontroller på slutkandidaterna, vilket innebär att vi kontrollerar examensbevis eller annat dokument som styrker din utbildning. Du kan läsa mer om hur det fungerar när du söker jobb på Riksbanken här . Vi ser fram emot att få kontakt med dig!

title: Confluent Kafka- arkitekt
description:
Vi söker en erfaren Confluent Kafka-arkitekt för att ersätta en befintlig konsult i ett pågående uppdrag hos kund i Stockholm, med start omgående.

title: Product Specialist - Elastic
description:
**Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Product Specialist in Elastic to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Detect & Disarm domain.**
**About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company**
 Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
   

  

 Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
   

  

 Today, we are around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for an Elastic Product Specialist to our Product team, who wants to make a difference in our Managed Security Services domain.
   

  

**The Role**
 Join our Product Specialist team as the Elastic Product Specialist, where you’ll take ownership of the technical landscape across our network detection and response capabilities. This hybrid role blends deep cyber security expertise with both internal and external enablement, ensuring the Elastic platform is optimally configured, continuously improved, and fully leveraged by our Security Operations teams and our customers.
   

  

**In this role, you will:**
* Act as the technical platform specialist for Elastic, including deployment strategies, use case development, detection tuning, and operational best practices.
* Monitor, assess, and communicate product updates, new capabilities, and roadmap changes from the platform to ensure our detection capabilities remain effective and relevant.
* Enable and educate – share your expertise by keeping SOC analysts and internal stakeholders up to date on Elastic developments, detection opportunities, and best practices. Translate technical changes into actionable guidance and ensure knowledge is embedded in our processes.
* Work closely with vendors, engineering teams, and internal stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, optimize deployments, and increase detection and response capabilities, representing the Product team with clarity and credibility.


**Your Potential Background**
 We are looking for someone with a passion for cybersecurity, a strong sense of product ownership, and a collaborative mindset. You thrive in a dynamic environment, are eager to stay current with the latest developments in network detection and response, and enjoy sharing your expertise with others. You have 2-5 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, ideally as a product specialist within Elastic, a technical account manager, a detection engineer, or in a similar role within a SOC or MSSP environment.
   

  

**Required Skills:**
* Deep familiarity with Elastic, including deployment strategies, detection engineering, and advanced technical capabilities.
* Experience with operationalizing the platform in enterprise, SOC, or MSSP environments.
* Strong interest in technical product ownership, with a proactive approach to learning and staying current with evolving Elastic features, detection methods, and best practices.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborative and outgoing personality; comfortable representing the team in cross-functional meetings, vendor dialogues, and technical customer discussions.
* Self-motivated, with a proven ability to work independently.


**Bonus points if you have:**
* Experience writing detection rules, configuring automated workflows, integrating APIs, or tuning detections within Elastic or similiar platforms.
* Relevant cybersecurity certifications or equivalent practical experience in network security, threat detection, or security operations.
* Previous experience working in a SOC or MSSP environment.


 Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Swedish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Swedish work permit.
   

  

**Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future**
 If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.
   

  

 So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

title: Senior Service Delivery Manager
description:
Service Manager - Annons
   

  

 Vi lever i en konstant föränderlig värld där Sveriges säkerhet får allt större fokus. Vi märker detta genom lagstiftningar och våra kunders krav på säkerhet och förberedelser. Har du erfarenhet av säkerhetsarbete och då framförallt inom IT? Söker du en varierande roll där du får kombinera teknik med administration och förbättringsarbete? Då kan rollen som
 **Service Manager** 
 till Telia – SNS vara för dig!
   

  

**Är det här din nästa möjlighet?**
 Vill du jobba i ett team där du, tillsammans med kollegor, implementerar, hanterar och anpassar tekniska lösningar för olika funktioner?
   

  

 Som
 **Service Manager** 
 är du en central del i kundteamet och arbetar tillsammans med Kea Accent Managern med att säkra att vår leverans fungerar och kan nås av våra kunder. I denna roll arbetar du de fokus på kundinterfacet, säkring av tjänsteleveransen funktion och prestanda av den totala kundlösningen samt framtida behov och möjligheter. Du behöver ha god administrativ förmåga för att kunna hålla ihop aktiviteterna Vi är ett litet team som arbetar nära tillsammans och delar kunskaper och erfarenheter med varandra, alla i teamet förväntas bidra till gruppens fortsatta utveckling.
   

  

**Vanligt förekommande arbetsuppgifter:**
* Agera kontakt gentemot kund kring aktiviteter/frågor kopplat till systemlösningen
* Arbetar med uppföljning av systemlösningens funktion och prestanda i form av SLA-rapporter, supportstatistik och liknande rapportering
* Ansvarar för koordinering med kund kring förvaltningsplanen, till exempel servicefönster och releaser.
* Arbeta proaktivt och rådgivande med förbättringsförslag för IT-infrastruktur och IT-arkitektur gentemot den tekniska förvaltningsorganisationen
* Koordinerar och säkerställer korrekt användarinformation (internt och externt) och dokumentationen är uppdaterad


 Resor kan förekomma Sverige.
   

  

**Är det här du?**
 Du är självständig och har stor initiativförmåga samtidigt som du är en lagspelare som är med och bidrar till vårt tillåtande klimat. Vi tror att du tidigare har jobbat proaktivt i gränssnittet mellan teknik och kund. Det är såklart bra om du känner till våra produkter, vår verksamhet och hur vi jobbar men hos finns det utrymme för du ska lära dig något nytt.
   

  

 Du trivs med varierande arbetsuppgifter, har en stark servicekänsla, är kommunikativ och trivs en supporterande roll gentemot kunder och kollegor. Med god struktur planerar, organiserar och prioriterar du arbetet på ett effektivt sätt tillsammans med andra. Du har hög digital kompetens och har god systemvana.
   

  

**Dina personliga kompetenser** 
 :
   

  

 Vi tror att du är en lyhörd och professionell person som kan bygga upp en goda relationer och långsiktiga förtroenden hos våra kunder. Ett strukturerat och noggrant arbetssätt är av stor vikt i kombination med ett starkt självledarskap och en förmåga att engagera sin omgivning. I den här rollen får du möjlighet att utmana dig själv och vi värdesätter att du inspireras och motiveras av att bidra till förbättringar och att arbeta mot tydliga mål och vi stöttar varandra för att uppnå målen tillsammans. Vi ser gärna att du, precis vi, brinner för IT-säkerhet och de uppgifter som hör till rollen, samt att du är analytiskt lagd och har god social förmåga.
   

  

**Din erfarenhet** 
 :
   

  

 Vi söker dig med några års erfarenhet från att administrera IT-system och tror att du följande kunskaper och erfarenheter:
   

  

* Erfarenhet och intresse för IT och service
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och i skrift
* Erfarenhet av teknikförvaltning i tidigare uppdrag
* Erfarenhet av projektledning och koordinering av team och intressenter
* Kompetens inom Mobila tjänster
* Gymnasial utbildning inom IT/Teknik är meriterande


**Mer än bara ett jobb!**
 Oavsett vilket jobb du söker hos oss, ger vi dig verktygen och stödet du behöver för att styra din personliga utveckling. Vi vill hjälpa dig att utvecklas både på ett personligt plan och i din yrkesroll. Hos oss blir du en del av ett kreativt, motiverande och välkomnade företag där alla kan vara sig själva, med likvärdiga möjligheter att utvecklas. Vi respekterar människor och värdesätter mångfald. Förutom en attraktiv och inkluderande arbetsmiljö erbjuder vi flexibilitet och ett brett utbud av olika förmåner.
   

  

**Intresserad?**
 Tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan om du vill bli en del utav vårt team! Om du vill veta mer om rollen, är du välkommen att kontakta mig, Ola Perman på Ola.Perman@teliacompany.com.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan. För att kunna hantera dina personuppgifter på ett säkert sätt, ber vi dig att ansöka via vårt rekryteringssystem. Vi har inte möjlighet att ta emot ansökningar via e-post eller andra kanaler. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Sista ansökningsdatum är
 **22 oktober.**

 , som i förekommande fall, kan medföra krav på visst medborgarskap

title: Cybersecurity Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Architect to help shape and secure SSAB's digital future. In this strategic role, you will define and evolve our cybersecurity architecture, standards, and security requirements working closely with technology teams, suppliers, and supporting our key transformation initiatives and projects.
   

  

 Your mission is to ensure cybersecurity is built into solutions from the start, enabling secure cloud adoption, business transformation, OT modernization, and responsible use of emerging technologies.
   

  

 This role combines long-term architectural leadership with hands-on design reviews, threat modelling, and security guidance. You will help teams across all our divisions make better security decisions, reduce technical security debt, and establish a scalable security architecture that supports SSAB's business objectives.
   

  

 This role reports to our Group CISO, Markus Lalla and can be based in Stockholm or Helsinki.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Define and maintain SSAB's cybersecurity architecture strategy and target-state
* Establish security standards, reference architectures, and ensure Secure-by-Design principles are embedded into all business transformation programs and technology initiatives
* Review and provide guidance on cloud, application, identity, network, infrastructure, and OT architectures
* Drive cyersecurity architecture assessments, threat modelling, and design reviews
* Identify architectural cybersecurity gaps and advice teams in remediating technical debt and vulnerabilities
* Develop cybersecurity requirements for secure software development and DevSecOps practices
* Support Zero Trust, identity governance, cloud security, and emerging technology initiatives
* Collaborate with suppliers, architects, and engineering teams to ensure effective implementation of security controls across the organization


**About You**
* You have extensive experience (typically 10+ years) in cybersecurity architecture, cloud security, infrastructure architecture, or software/security engineering
* You have proven experience designing enterprise security architecture in complex organizations and hands-on implementation skills integrating cybersecurity systems such as vulnerability scanning tools or a SOAR platform, as an example
* You have strong expertise in Azure and hybrid-cloud security architecture where Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent cloud architecture certification is seen as an advantage
* You have wide experience with application security, identity and access management, network security, and infrastructure security
* You have good understanding of AI and ML tools and their applications in security solutions
* You are experienced in performing architecture reviews, threat modelling, and security risk assessments
* You hold certifications such as CISSP, GICSP or those within SABSA and TOGAF. The knowledge base of the IEC62443 umbrella is highly appreciated in order to efficiently operate in industrial manufacturing and supplier ecosystems.
* You can translate technical security requirements into clear and actionable guidance for architects, developers, and project teams, while building strong stakeholder relationships that drive adoption of cybersecurity practices
* You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. Proficiency in one or more Nordic languages is considered an advantage


**Recruitment Process**
* Apply
* Digital Interview
* Meet the Hiring Manager
* Case Assignment
* Meet the Team and a few key stakeholders
* Pre-Offer Checks (including health check for Finland based candidates)
* Sign!


**Got Questions? Please Contact:**
 Julia Källmar, Group Talent Acquisition Partner, julia.kallmar@ssab.com
   

  

 We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.
   

  

 Please submit your application in English. We look forward to speaking to you!
   

  

**About Us**
 Becoming part of the SSAB family means joining a journey. A journey that we believe is essential for the sustainability of this planet. Steel has been one of the most important materials for developing our society and it will continue to be so. In the roofs over our heads, in the bridges connecting our cities and in the cars of tomorrow. At SSAB we are proud of our history and leadership in high-strength steel. But we are also aware that the production of steel is one of the largest emitters of greenhouse gases in the world. That has to change. That is why we have developed the world’s ﬁrst fossil-free steel production and have committed to becoming largely fossil-free. As part of SSAB you will be instrumental in realizing this goal and pushing for the green transformation of the whole steel industry.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Job ID: 3525**
 We are looking for an AI Platform Engineer to drive the development and adoption of AI-powered solutions that strengthen our ability to detect and investigate financial crime. The role is permanent and can be based in Helsinki, Tallinn, Poland or Stockholm.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 Meet the Data and Platform Team. Our role is to improve how we detect and investigate financial crime with the help of AI and machine learning to keep our customers, Nordea and society safe. Our team is about 25 people working out of Stockholm, Helsinki and Copenhagen as a part of the Group Financial Crime Prevention (GFCP) unit that provides financial crime prevention services to all of the bank.
   

  

 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.
   

  

**Main responsibilities in this role:**
* Design and implement proof-of-concept solutions for the AI Platform spanning predictive, generative and agentic workflows.
* Secure that applications are compliant in accordance with rules and regulations.
* Define production readiness and operational governance.
* Lead technical working groups and cross-team synchronization.
* Translate strategic direction into tactical technical guidance for the teams.
* Application risk management – manage risks and QRAs.
* Application access management – access rules and requirements.
* Application cost management – ensure cost efficient applications.
* Application incident management – secure proper communication and reporting.


**Who You Are**
**This is the right role for you if you are:**
* Ambitious and enjoy bringing ideas, exploring their potential, and presenting the results. You're passionate about ensuring production excellence in machine learning operations, ensuring both the bank’s and society's safety.
* Collaborative and thrive in cross-functional environments, comfortable working at the intersection of business and technology. You communicate clearly and confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences, and you’re comfortable driving work forward independently.


**Your background and skills include:**
* BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a relevant technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience as a Cloud native expert in designing and building production grade applications and services on AWS and other cloud providers (Azure or GCP).
* Practical experience with Python development and managing complex environments with Terraform.
* Experience working with AI/ML platforms such as Amazon SageMaker, Bedrock, AgentCore and Data platforms such as S3, AWS Glue, Lake Formation.
* Proven ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships across multiple domains, including expectations management.


**It would be ideal if you also:**
* Experience with agile methodologies and product development lifecycle.
* Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, architecture, and data science teams.
* Have professional experience from working in regulated industries, i.e. Banking, Government, etc.


**What We Offer**
**People** 
 come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.
   

  

**A culture** 
 that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.
   

  

**Hybrid working model –** 
 we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.
   

  

**Diversity and inclusion** 
 are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.
   

  

 If this sounds like you, get in touch!
   

  

**Next steps**
 Submit your application as soon as possible as we start with interviews on ongoing basis. For more information, you’re welcome to contact Tiago Vieira, tiago.vieira@nordea.com.
   

  

 A Background Check will be performed for the person selected for this position, including internal applicants.
   

  

**We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.**
**We build relationships** 
 . We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.
   

  

**We learn and develop.** 
 We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.
   

  

**We lead change** 
 . We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.
   

  

**We are Nordea** 
 . We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.
   

  

**Only for candidates in Finland:** 
 A security clearance will be performed for the person selected for this position.
   

  

**Only for candidates in Sweden:** 
 For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.
   

  

**Only for candidates in Poland:** 
 Please include permit for processing personal data in CV as following:
   

  

 In accordance with art. 6 (1) a and b. Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (General Data Protection Regulation) hereinafter ‘GDPR’. I agree to have: my personal data, education and employment history proceeded for the purposes of current and future recruitment processes in Nordea Bank Abp.
   

  

 The administrator of your personal data is: Nordea Bank Abp operating in Poland through its Branch, address: Aleja Edwarda Rydza Śmiglego 20, 93-281 Łodź. Your personal data will be processed for the recruitment processes in Nordea Bank Abp. You have a right to access your personal data, right to rectify and right to delete. Disclosing the personal data in the scope specified by the provisions of Polish Labour Code from 26 June 1974 and executive acts are mandatory. Providing personal data is necessary to conduct the recruitment processes. The request for the deletion of your personal data means resignation from further participation in recruitment processes and causes the immediate removal of your application. Detailed information concerning processing of your personal data can be found at: https://www.nordea.com/en/doc/nordea-privacy-policy-for-applicants.pdf

title: Senior IT-arkitekt till samhällsviktig verksamhet
description:
*Vill du ta ditt konsultande till nästa nivå hos Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare? Vi vet vad du tänker. Du har hört det förut. Men tro oss, det har du inte. Vårt körsbär på konsulttårtan är något annat. Sök jobbet och smaka själv!*
**Vill du arbeta med IT-arkitektur i en verksamhet som gör skillnad på riktigt?** 
 Vi söker nu en senior IT-arkitekt till ett spännande uppdrag inom offentlig sektor, i en organisation som arbetar med internationellt och med samhällsutveckling.
   

  

 Här får du en central roll i att forma och vidareutveckla organisationens IT-arkitektur, med möjlighet att påverka både strategiska vägval och konkreta tekniska lösningar.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 Som senior IT-arkitekt kommer du att arbeta brett med att utveckla en hållbar, säker och verksamhetsanpassad IT-arkitektur. Du har en viktig funktion i att säkerställa att tekniska lösningar stödjer verksamhetens behov, långsiktiga mål och digitala utveckling.
   

  

 Rollen kombinerar strategiskt arkitekturarbete med mer operativa insatser, där du arbetar nära verksamheten, andra arkitekter, IT-specialister och externa leverantörer.
   

  

 Du blir en del av en mindre arkitekturfunktion med nära samarbete med IT-ledning och övriga delar av organisationen. Här finns goda möjligheter att bidra med din erfarenhet, påverka tekniska vägval och vara med och utveckla arkitekturarbetet framåt.
   

  

 Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter
   

  

* Utforma och vidareutveckla målarkitekturer, lösningsarkitekturer och tekniska vägval.
* Analysera verksamhetens behov och omsätta dem till hållbara och effektiva IT-lösningar.
* Driva utvecklingen av nya digitala lösningar i samarbete med verksamheten och externa IT-leverantörer.
* Säkerställa att IT-lösningar följer etablerade arkitekturprinciper, säkerhetskrav och relevanta regelverk.
* Vidareutveckla arkitekturstyrning, standarder, riktlinjer och gemensamma arbetssätt.
* Agera rådgivande i strategiska IT-frågor gentemot projekt, förvaltning och ledning.
* Arbeta med systemintegrationer och bidra till utvecklingen av organisationens integrationsarkitektur.
* Samverka med verksamhetsarkitekter, informationsarkitekter och säkerhetsspecialister för att skapa en sammanhängande IT-miljö.


 Vem söker vi?
   

  

 Vi söker dig som är en erfaren IT-arkitekt med förmågan att kombinera ett strategiskt helhetsperspektiv med god teknisk förståelse. Du är van att arbeta i komplexa IT-miljöer och har erfarenhet av att omsätta verksamhetskrav till genomförbara tekniska lösningar.
   

  

 Vi ser gärna att du har:
   

  

* Flerårig erfarenhet som IT-arkitekt, lösningsarkitekt eller i en liknande senior arkitekturroll.
* Bred förståelse för applikationsarkitektur, integrationer, infrastruktur och informationshantering.
* Erfarenhet av att ta fram målarkitekturer, lösningsförslag och tekniska beslutsunderlag.
* Förståelse för IT-säkerhet, arkitekturstyrning och etablerade arkitekturprinciper.
* Erfarenhet av att samarbeta med såväl verksamhetsrepresentanter som tekniska specialister och externa leverantörer.
* God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att förklara komplexa tekniska frågor för olika målgrupper.


 Erfarenhet från offentlig sektor, myndighetsverksamhet eller andra organisationer med höga krav på säkerhet, styrning och regelefterlevnad är meriterande.
   

  

 Som person
   

  

 Du är analytisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad med förmågan att se både helheten och de tekniska detaljerna. Du trivs i en rådgivande roll där du får samarbeta med olika delar av organisationen och bidra till långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.
   

  

 Du är trygg i din kompetens, tar egna initiativ och har lätt för att skapa förtroende hos både tekniska och verksamhetsnära intressenter.
   

  

**Bara det bästa åt de bästa – vår personalfilosofi**
 Castra är en konsultgrupp inom IT och Management. Eller ja, en elite squad kan man säga. Vi samlar de vassaste och mest erfarna konsulterna, helt enkelt för att det är hos oss de får ut max i både kapacitet och livskvalitet. Vi är verksamma inom Systemutveckling, IT-infrastruktur, IT-styrning & Ledarskap samt IT-säkerhet.
   

  

 Vi är utsedda till Sveriges- och Europas bästa arbetsplats, på riktigt! Det låter lite skrytsamt, men det är faktiskt inte vi som sagt det. Castra har sedan 2017 blivit certifierad av
 **Great Place to Work,** 
 en utmärkelse som är helt baserat på medarbetarundersökningar. Vi har de senaste tre åren blivit utnämnda till
 **Sveriges Bästa Arbetsplats** 
 för stora bolag och nu senast kammade vi även hem förstaplatsen bland
 **Europas Bästa Arbetsplatser** 
 . Som grädde på moset är vi även ett Gasell- och Karriärföretag!
   

  

 På Castra tror vi på frihet, utveckling och gemenskap. Du som konsult styr själv vilka uppdrag du tar, när du jobbar, om du vill levla upp någon kompetens och hur och mycket lön och semester du tar ut. Att du får bygga din egen logga är bara en bonus! Trodde du det var allt? Då trodde du fel. Stöd av bra chefer, aktiviteter, kompetent och snabbfotad säljstyrka, möjlighet till delägarskap, stora möjligheter att påverka bolagets framtid och härliga kollegor – listan på vad som gör Castra till en fantastisk arbetsplats kan göras lååång. Möjligheterna bra nära oändliga. Win för alla parter, säger vi.
   

  

*Castra har kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm, Malmö, Linköping, Norrköping, Örebro, Jönköping och Sundsvall.*
 Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss på castra.se/konsulterbjudande/
   

  

**Har vi lyckats väcka din nyfikenhet?**
 Sök direkt via länken eller hör av dig till xx xx på xx.xx@castra.se eller 070-xx xx xx.

title: VP, Platform Engineering
description:
Sinch’s vision is to connect every business with every customer, everywhere in the world. More than 200,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.


Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.


At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!


**DESCRIPTION**

Sinch's APIs move billions of messages, calls, and emails for developers around the world. We're looking for a VP of Engineering to own the platform they all live in and to make Sinch the easiest place for the next wave of AI agents to integrate with. This is a critical leadership role reporting directly to our Chief Product Officer (CPO).


You will lead a ~30-person organization responsible for the Sinch Build Platform, the horizontal foundation for our Voice, Messaging, Email, and Applications products. This is a unique opportunity to solve complex technical challenges, unify the developer and agentic experience across our entire portfolio, and provide the senior technical leadership needed to mentor the team. Your success will be pivotal in driving our AI-first transformation and shaping the future of global customer communication.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead AI-First Innovation: Champion AI-first engineering practices and workflows, actively exploring the adoption of AI-assisted development tools to accelerate team productivity.
* Define & Own the Technical Strategy: Establish the technical vision and roadmap for the entire portfolio. Agentic and developer experience, Sinch Build Platform, covering identity, customer/account models, developer tooling, documentation, and API connectivity.
* Cultivate Engineering Excellence: Lead, grow, and nurture a distributed engineering organization of ~30 people with 3 direct reports (Engineering Managers), building a high-performing culture with strong technical guidance.
* Deliver Coherent Experiences: Create one coherent, world-class experience for developers and AI agents across all Sinch products, simplifying a complex, inherited, and fragmented platform landscape.
* Establish Effective Governance: Define the operating model for how your Platform team partners with key stakeholders across our various global Product Areas, driving adoption and platform reuse through trust and collaboration.
Partner for Product Impact: Work closely with Product leadership to translate platform investment into measurable business outcomes like faster onboarding and reduced integration friction.  
* 

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Proven Engineering Leadership: A senior engineering executive who has successfully built and led multi-team engineering organizations (with managers reporting to you), managing budgets, hiring, and strategic resourcing.
* Developer Platform Expertise: Deep experience working with developer-facing products like APIs, SDKs, and developer portals. You measure success by outcome, active adoption, and developer satisfaction rather than just delivery milestones.
* Hands-on Tech & AI Credibility: Solid understanding of modern platform technologies, IAM systems, and API connectivity. Experience with or a strong strategic interest in agentic AI (such as MCP servers, tool-calling design, and agentic integrations) is highly valued.
* Collaborative Change Agent: A humble, highly collaborative leader capable of navigating a complex stakeholder environment and driving technical transformation through influence and credibility.
* Location & Presence: This role is based in Stockholm, Sweden on a hybrid model. Candidates must be local or willing to relocate to Stockholm to collaborate closely with the core team.
* Language Proficiency: Our corporate language is English; please submit your application in English.

**OUR HIRING PROCESS**

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.


We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/ . No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!


Salary: The monthly gross salary for this position is between SEK 125,000 to SEK 170,000 monthly. This position is also eligible for an annual performance-based bonus. Factors which may affect pay within this range may include skills, education, experience, and other qualifications. The overall budget remains flexible for an exceptional, SVP-level candidate.
