title: Camera Assembly Assistant
description:
**About Spiideo**


Spiideo is a fast growing sports technology company headquartered in Malmö. We provide software services to the world of sports in the areas of performance analysis and automated video production of games and practice in stadiums, arenas and training facilities.


Our camera systems combine hardware, AI and cloud technology to automate sports video production and analysis. Over the last few years Spiideo has grown quickly and we are now shipping thousands of cameras all over the world!

**About the role**


A key piece of our product line is our portfolio of network-connected camera systems to do the video capture. We run an in-house Camera System Production & Distribution Unit in Malmö, where we assemble and ship the camera systems that power Spiideo's platform for customers all over the world. As a Camera Assembly Assistant, you'll play a key role in ensuring our camera systems are assembled, tested and shipped with the quality our customers expect.


You will be working in a modern, office-like environment with light mechanical assembly in our production team. The job tasks will also include receiving and packing material deliveries.

**Qualifications**

* Valid Swedish Driver's License
* Production/Assembly Experience: prior work in a production or manufacturing setting with high quality standards.
* Mechanical hands-on ability: basic skills with light mechanical assembly or similar "handy" tasks.
* Physical capability: to receive and lift heavy deliveries in our warehouse
* Experienced and comfortable working in a digital and computer-based environment.
* Efficient and quick learner: ability to take directions, rapidly absorb instructions, and work effectively in environments with repetitive tasks.
* Attention to Detail: critical for ensuring quality during assembly and accurate handling of deliveries.
* Organized with a positive attitude: ability to plan and coordinate tasks effectively within the team.
* English communication skills: strong verbal and written English communication skills as we are an international organization.
* Fork lift licence is a merit but not mandatory.

**Position details**


This position is a full-time position, placed at our recently established Camera System Production & Distribution Unit in Limhamn, Malmö. Normal working hours are Monday-Friday 08:30 - 16:30.


This position requires that you already hold a permanent right to work in Sweden (e.g. EU/EEA citizenship, permanent residence, or a permanent work permit). We are unfortunately not able to sponsor work permits for this role

**What we offer**

* A role in a fast-growing sports tech company with a global footprint
* Build and ship products used by some of the world's leading sports organizations, leagues and teams
* See the impact of your work: every camera you assemble helps coaches, players, broadcasters and officials around the world to capture, analyze and share sports
* A comprehensive pension and insurance package
* An annual wellness allowance and the opportunity to spend two working hours per week on physical activity


As we're looking to fill this role on short notice, applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and the position might be filled before the application deadline. So don't wait to submit yours!

title: Chief Technology & AI Officer
description:
We are looking for an entrepreneurial Chief Technology & AI Officer to lead our technology, Data & AI, engineering, and digital transformation strategy while helping drive commercial growth. The ideal candidate combines technology depth, enterprise consulting experience, commercial thinking, and hands-on execution. Key Responsibilities \* Define and execute the company’s Technology, Data & AI strategy. \* Build enterprise capabilities around Generative AI, Agentic AI, Data Platforms, Cloud and Automation.
  
  

* Lead global teams across AI, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, SAP and Cloud. \* Work directly with CIOs, CTOs and business leaders to shape and deliver transformation programs. \* Build new technology offerings, accelerators and products from idea to commercial scale. \* Support strategic sales, partnerships and expansion across Europe.
* Establish strong engineering, architecture and AI governance standards. Candidate Profile \* Senior technology leader, technology entrepreneur or consulting executive. \* Minimum 4 years of prior technology/management consulting experience in the Nordic market, with strong understanding of Nordic enterprise customers and business culture. Overall 20+ years of experience required.
* Strong background across Data & AI, enterprise architecture, cloud, SAP and modern software engineering. \* Demonstrated experience building and scaling technology teams and capabilities. \* Strong commercial mindset with experience supporting enterprise sales and customer relationships. \* Comfortable moving between boardroom strategy, customer engagements and hands-on technology decisions.


We are looking for a Technologist + Entrepreneur + Consultant + Commercial Leader who can use technology and AI to create measurable business growth.

title: Creative Marketing Specialist
description:
**Creative Marketing Specialist till United Spaces**

**Är du en kreativ doer som vill vara med och utveckla hur United Spaces syns, känns och kommunicerar? Har du ett starkt öga för färg, form och text, är digitalt kunnig och gillar att få saker gjorda? Då är det dig vi söker till rollen som Creative Marketing Specialist.**


Välkommen till United Spaces, pionjärer och branschledare inom coworking i Sverige. Varje dag skapar vi bättre arbetsdagar för våra 7000+ medlemmar på 18 anläggningar i Stockholm, Uppsala, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi vågar gå först. Därför är vi ett av branschens snabbast växande bolag – och vi har bara börjat. Tillsammans testar vi nya idéer, bidrar och utvecklas på både väntade och oväntade sätt. Vill du vara med?

**Om uppdraget som Creative Marketing Specialist**  

Som Creative Marketing Specialist blir du en del av vårt marknadsteam och arbetar brett med kreativ produktion – från idé och koncept till färdigt material och publicering.


Ena dagen skapar du ett koncept för en kampanj eller innehåll till sociala medier, nästa bygger du mallar i Figma, uppdaterar webben i WordPress, fotograferar på en av våra anläggningar eller tar fram en skylt som ska gå direkt till produktion.


Kort sagt söker vi dig som kan kombinera kreativ höjd med hands-on produktion.

**Vad du kommer att göra**

* Utveckla kreativa idéer och koncept för kampanjer, lanseringar, event och andra marknadsaktiviteter.
* Skapa och producera grafiskt material för både digitala och fysiska kanaler – från annonser och sociala medier till skyltar, presentationer och trycksaker.
* Ta fram smarta och användarvänliga mallar i Figma eller andra designverktyg som resten av organisationen enkelt kan använda.
* Skapa engagerande innehåll för sociala medier – från idé, copy och grafisk form till färdig produktion och publicering.
* Skriva och anpassa texter för webb, kampanjer, nyhetsbrev och annan marknadskommunikation.
* Uppdatera och utveckla innehåll på vår webbplats i WordPress.
* Fotografera och gärna producera enklare rörligt innehåll från våra anläggningar, event och aktiviteter.
* Säkerställa att United Spaces visuella identitet och tone of voice genomsyrar all kommunikation.
* Vara en kreativ resurs för organisationen och stötta marknad, sälj, event och våra anläggningar med idéer och produktion.
**Vem är du?**  

Vi tror att du är kreativ, självgående och prestigelös och tycker lika mycket om att komma på idéer som att faktiskt genomföra dem. Du har känsla för både helheten och detaljerna och förstår hur bild, form och ord tillsammans skapar stark kommunikation.


Du behöver inte alltid en färdig brief för att komma vidare. Du ser möjligheter, kommer med idéer och kan själv ta ett uppdrag från första tanke till färdig leverans.

**Vi tror att du har utbildning och erfarenhet av:**

* Relevant utbildning inom exempelvis grafisk design, kommunikation, marknadsföring eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
* Kreativ produktion och innehållsskapande, från organisation, byrå eller som frilansare.
* Grafisk design och produktion för både digitala och fysiska kanaler.
* Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud eller motsvarande designverktyg.
* WordPress eller liknande CMS.
* Contentproduktion, copywriting och sociala medier.

Det är också meriterande om du har erfarenhet av foto, bildredigering och enklare video eller rörligt innehåll.


Du behöver inte vara specialist på allt. Det viktigaste är att du är kreativt bred, digitalt trygg och riktigt bra på att få saker gjorda.

**Låter det som du?**  

I så fall erbjuder vi inte bara sånt där vanligt som kollektivavtal och friskvårdsbidrag, utan också en spännande arbetsplats, fantastiska kollegor och möjlighet att växa tillsammans med oss. Hör av dig snart, så berättar vi mer!

title: Partner Manager
description:
**Ongoing is continuing its journey of profitable growth and is now searching for a Partner Manager.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Ongoing is entering a new phase in how we work with sales, customers and partners. Partners already bring us a meaningful share of our new customers, mostly through informal recommendations. We now want to turn our ecosystem into a structured, measurable growth channel across the Nordics. As **Partner Manager**, you will build and run that channel: you make sure our partners know where Ongoing is heading, recommend us when their customers need a WMS, and work with us on joint opportunities from first introduction to signed customer.

*Great partnerships are built on trust, shared goals, and close cooperation. Collaboration across Ongoing helps us support partners and unlock new opportunities for growth*

**About Ongoing**
-----------------


Headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, Ongoing is a leading cloud-native WMS for logistics-intensive companies, including both third-party logistics providers and businesses operating their own warehouses. The platform helps companies manage inventory, fulfilment, customer communication and warehouse operations with precision, flexibility and scalability.


Since July 2026, Ongoing has been a portfolio company of Cinven. This marks a new phase of international expansion, product investment and growth, while maintaining the company culture and customer focus that have made Ongoing successful.

*Our office is located directly next to the Chalmers University campus in Johanneberg.*

**About the position**
----------------------


With more than 200 listed integrations and hundreds of companies working within the Ongoing ecosystem, from ERP and e-commerce platforms to carriers, consultants and system integrators, there are many relationships to prioritize and develop. As Partner Manager, you own our partner program and the pipeline it generates. You decide which partnerships matter most, build them into a steady source of qualified leads, and bring partners into sales processes where they help us win. The goal is a win-win-win: for Ongoing, for our partners, and for end customers who get solutions that deliver real value to their business.


You are part of the Marketing team, reporting to the Head of Marketing, and work closely with Sales, Customer Success and our integrations team.

### ***In this role, you will***

* **Build partner-sourced pipeline:** Turn our most important partners into a steady, measurable source of qualified leads, and own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline in our CRM.
* **Run and develop the partner program:** Take ownership of our partner tiers, partner obligations and referral terms, and keep the program commercially attractive for partners.
* **Involve partners in active sales processes:** Work closely with Sales to bring in relevant partners where they strengthen our case, with clear rules of engagement for partner-owned accounts.
* **Onboard new partners:** Introduce Ongoing as a company and present our product offering to new partners, so they can recommend and position Ongoing with confidence.
* **Support integration partners:** Help external integration partners get started with building new integrations with Ongoing WMS, together with our integrations team.

**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------


We believe you are a natural relationship builder who thrives in high-tech, dynamic environments and enjoys bringing different stakeholders together to create business value for all parties.


You likely have experience in partner management, account management, business development, or technical sales within B2B SaaS or logistics, or other software ecosystems. Strategically minded and commercially driven, you understand how partnerships build pipeline and help win complex deals, and you are comfortable being measured on the business your partners generate. You operate with high autonomy and sound judgment, making it easy for you to manage and prioritize relationships across a large and active ecosystem. Finally, you are fluent in both Swedish and English with excellent written and spoken communication skills, while proficiency in another Nordic language or German is a valuable plus.

*As Partner Manager, you'll work closely with Tobias Forsberg, Head of Marketing, to build strategic relationships, develop joint initiatives, and expand Ongoing's partner ecosystem.*

* At least 3 years of experience in partner management, channel sales, business development, account management or technical sales within B2B software.
* A track record of generating pipeline or revenue through partners or other indirect channels.
* A solid understanding of software ecosystems and integrations, and the ability to explain how systems such as ERP, e-commerce platforms and WMS work together.
* Professional proficiency in both English and Swedish.

#### ***Strong merits***

* Experience from logistics, warehousing, supply chain, e-commerce or 3PL.
* Experience building or running a partner program, including tiers, incentives or referral agreements.
* Experience tracking partner-sourced pipeline in HubSpot or another CRM.
* Professional proficiency in another Nordic language or German.

**Why join Ongoing?**
---------------------


Partners are already one of the most important sources of new customers for Ongoing, built largely on informal relationships. As our first dedicated Partner Manager, you will turn that into a structured growth channel, with real ownership and direct impact on how we grow across the Nordics.


You will join a profitable and growing tech company with a strong product, close customer relationships and deep logistics expertise.

*Our top-floor ping-pong table is appreciated for breaking off between hard work. Many, but not all, colleagues also like using the health benefits for running, gym, padel, squash, tennis, golf, or other activities.*

**Terms**
---------


The position is based at Ongoing's office in Gothenburg and is primarily office-based. Travel to partners and industry events within the Nordics is part of the role. Compensation consists of a fixed base salary and a variable component linked to partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, and we offer competitive terms and benefits, including wellness-related benefits that support an active and healthy lifestyle.

* Start: January 2027 or by agreement
* Location: Gothenburg
* Salary: Fixed base salary + variable component

title: Data Center Technician III
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Experience with performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment.
* Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems, computer hardware and server hardware.
* Experience with networking protocols.
* Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.
* Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in maintenance and monitoring of server systems.
* Experience with performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on IT equipment or in a similar role (e.g., Systems Administration, Network Deployment Engineer, Help Desk Technician, etc.).
* Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.
* Experience with Linux operating systems.
* Experience in project management and leadership, and collaborating and partnering with teams.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.



As a Data Center Technician, you will perform core data center operations and deployment tasks on a single function (e.g., maintenance, machines, programs, networking, media security), under direct guidance. You will conduct basic troubleshooting and problem identification to address day-to-day issues by following existing protocols and well-defined documented activities and escalate non-standard challenges when required. You will also to develop knowledge of data security systems, operations, processes, and procedures, as well as the ability to monitor potential data security issues.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

Sweden: kr680000 - kr695000 (SEK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across teams.
* Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose somewhat complex issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and applying the resources needed to resolve identified issues.
* Maintain the security and integrity of data, track various forms of media to check for non-standard data security issues (e.g., data was not properly erased) handled in accordance with Google security standards.
* Disassemble specific equipment that has reached its end-of-life via part replacement or maintenance, within one or more teams.
* Repair, fix, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, or infrastructure based on identified issues with multiple solutions, independently.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Data Ingestion Platform)
description:
**Who We Are**
 4C Strategies builds organisational readiness and military training management software for clients in over 70 countries. Our flagship product, Exonaut®, is used by NATO and allied forces to plan, run and evaluate exercises in real time. Our consultants and engineers work alongside armed forces across the UK, Europe, North America and beyond to deliver training and exercise management solutions.
   

  

**What We're Building**
 We're building the data ingestion platform behind large-scale training exercises: a service that takes traffic from simulation federations, unmanned-system sensor networks and real-world sensor feeds, and turns it into one coherent stream that subscribing systems can act on. The bet is that these streams should be interpreted and mapped to an internal Ontology rather than re-interpreted by every product that needs it. So the hard part is as much modelling as engineering — deciding what those bytes actually mean, and then holding that meaning stable as the number of sources and consumers grows. The platform is greenfield, and you'll have real influence over its shape.
   

  

**How We Build**
 Modern Java. The principles are conservative on purpose: boring technology, simplicity over cleverness, in-process over distributed, shared-nothing over shared state, domain wrapped by ports and adapters. Redundancy is an architectural property, not an operational afterthought. Designs are argued from the problem, not from what a framework happens to make easy. Proposals go through RFCs; decisions are recorded in ADRs.
   

  

 Two constraints shape most of what we do. Everything the platform produces must be traceable back to the raw feed and the exact configuration that produced it — a customer has to be able to replay an exercise and defend the result. And it has to run where exercises actually run: constrained hardware, intermittent connectivity, air-gapped sites, limited patch windows, secure by design and observability good enough for an operator in the field with no one to call.
   

  

**You**
 Substantial engineering experience, opinionated about design, and comfortable arguing a position in writing. Sound judgement on reliability, security, performance, operations and cost is mandatory. Familiarity with simulation or sensor standards, IoT, geospatial mathematics or high-throughput ingestion is a real advantage — the domain is learnable, the principles less so. We'd also rather hear about how you simplified a distributed system rather than the one you built using multiple services.
   

  

 The engineering team is small, but what we are building sits at the centre of the portfolio and draws the people who know this domain best — some of the strongest simulation and modelling expertise anywhere in the field is in this building, and closely engaged in what we're building. The bar is high. Your designs will be challenged, and you'll be expected to challenge back — including on scope, since most of the pressure on a platform like this comes as reasonable-sounding requests for one more special case.
   

  

 Research shows some people only apply when they meet every requirement. If you don't tick every box but recognise yourself in much of the above, please apply anyway. We'd genuinely like to hear from you.
   

  

**Security and citizenship**
 This role supports defence work, so the successful candidate must hold Swedish citizenship and pass Swedish security vetting (säkerhetsprövning). We will explain what the check involves early in the process rather than late — a requirement like this should never be a surprise at offer stage.
   

  

 This requirement comes only from the security rules that govern defence work, not from personal preference.
   

  

**Why it matters**
 Deterrence works only when a capability is real, and a capability is only real once it has been trained and tested under conditions close to the ones it would face. This is about making sure the organisations that would hold the line are ready.
   

  

**How We Hire**
 Every interview has a written script and a scored rubric, applied the same way to every candidate.
   

  

* Hiring Manager Screen — a conversation about your experience, how you work and what


 you want next.
   

  

* System Design — a design discussion drawn from problems like the ones above.
* Programming — a hands-on session in a language of your choice (Java, C#, TypeScript, Python or Go).
* Culture Interview — how you collaborate, disagree and make decisions with others.
* Candidate Q&A — your time to interrogate us. We expect you to use it.


 We then debrief as a panel and decide. We review applications on a rolling basis.
   

  

**What You Can Expect From 4C Strategies**
* Based in our Stockholm office: we expect you on site four days a week.
* Competitive salary, reviewed annually.
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension).
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag).
* Healthcare insurance, including insurance for treatment.
* Parental pay.
* Vaccinations.
* A supportive, collaborative team building meaningful products for mission-critical work.


**Why Join 4C Strategies**
 If you're happiest when the path isn't drawn yet, this is a rare chance to own hard, open problems on a large, multi-year programme — real scale, real production systems, and the freedom to shape how they're built — with a collaborative team to figure the hard parts out alongside you. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and military specialists, with the individual-contributor track valued as highly as management, so you can grow without leaving the code behind.
   

  

 The work matters: what you build helps armed forces, public safety and resilience organisations train, prepare, and respond. If you want senior-level ownership on systems that are used in earnest — not a backlog ticket factory — this is that role.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 To apply, click the Apply today button and submit your CV. A short cover note on your experience and motivation is welcome but not required. We review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply as soon as you can.
   

  

 4C Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Staff Product Manager, OpenTelemetry | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

 This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Sweden.
   

  

**About Product Management**
 As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.
   

  

 Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As the Staff Product Manager for OpenTelemetry Experience, you’ll own the end-to-end journey for helping people and agents instrument workloads and successfully send useful OpenTelemetry data to Grafana Cloud.
   

  

 Your mission is to make Grafana Cloud the easiest and most trusted destination for OpenTelemetry workloads. You’ll reduce the uncertainty, complexity, and failure points users encounter between deciding to adopt OpenTelemetry and receiving healthy, correctly attributed, and actionable telemetry in Grafana Cloud.
   

  

 Teams can instrument workloads, directly or with the help of coding agents, through OpenTelemetry SDKs, automatic instrumentation technologies such as Beyla and SDK injection, or client-side OpenTelemetry Collectors. Each path presents different decisions, deployment requirements, configuration steps, and potential failure modes. You’ll define a coherent experience that helps users choose the right approach, complete setup successfully, troubleshoot problems, and understand whether their telemetry is healthy and useful. You’ll design a future in which a growing share of instrumentation work is performed by coding agents acting on behalf of developers. This means treating agents are first-class participants in the experience and ensuring that instrumentation options, configuration requirements, errors, and validation signals are structured, discoverable, and actionable by both humans and machines.
   

  

**Your Scope Will Include**
* OpenTelemetry SDK onboarding and configuration
* Automatic instrumentation experiences, including OBI/Beyla and SDK injection
* Client-side OpenTelemetry Collector deployment and onboarding
* Collector configuration, authentication, and initial connectivity
* Guidance and machine-readable context that help people and agents choose the right instrumentation approach
* Workflows that allow coding-agents to implement, configure and verify instrumentation safely
* Troubleshooting missing, incomplete, malformed, or unhealthy telemetry
* Validation signals that allow both people and agents to confirm that telemetry is healthy, correctly attributed, and usable in Grafana Cloud
* The transition from receiving telemetry to activating the appropriate Grafana Cloud observability solution


 Success does not stop when Grafana Cloud receives the first data point. Telemetry must arrive with the quality, context, and structure required to support meaningful observability outcomes. You’ll partner closely with teams responsible for experiences such as Application Observability, Kubernetes Monitoring, Infrastructure Observability, and Drilldown Apps to ensure OpenTelemetry workloads receive a first-class experience from initial setup through first value.
   

  

 This is a horizontal Staff-level product leadership role spanning multiple products and engineering teams. You may not directly own every SDK, collector, instrumentation technology, or downstream application involved in the journey. You will, however, be accountable for the coherence of the overall customer experience, its success measures, and the cross-product strategy required to improve it.
   

  

 AI will also be part of how you work, not only what you build. You’ll be expected to use AI tools regularly to accelerate customer-research synthesis, analyze product signals, explore technical workflows, prototype experiences, develop positioning content, and test agent-led instrumentation journeys. You’ll model thoughtful, hands-on adoption of AI while applying strong judgement to its outputs.
   

  

 The role is not focused on developing OpenTelemetry as an open source project in isolation. You’ll engage with and contribute to the OpenTelemetry ecosystem where appropriate, while measuring success through customer activation and outcomes in Grafana Cloud.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Define the vision, strategy, and cross-product roadmap for the journey from an uninstrumented workload to healthy, useful telemetry in Grafana Cloud solutions
* Create coherent, opinionated experiences that help users choose and implement the right approach across SDK instrumentation, automatic instrumentation, and Collector-based deployment while preserving the flexibility advanced users require
* Identify and eliminate the leading causes of setup failure, abandonment, misconfiguration, and low-quality telemetry
* Establish shared experience principles, priorities, and success criteria across the product and engineering teams contributing to the OpenTelemetry journey
* Use customer research, product data, and market insight to prioritize investments and measure outcomes such as onboarding completion, time to useful telemetry, telemetry health, and workload expansion
* Partner with downstream Grafana Cloud solution teams to create a coherent transition from telemetry ingestion to meaningful product activation
* Extend beyond product delivery to how the OpenTelemetry experience is positioned and brought to market. In partnership with Product Marketing and go-to-market teams, you’ll help define the product narrative, sharpen out differentiation, and develop launches, technical content, adoption programs, and campaigns that create demand and accelerate customer activation.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Documentation, Developer Relations, Product Marketing, and go-to-market teams to deliver and communicate a differentiated OpenTelemetry experience
* Represent Grafana Labs and its customers in relevant OpenTelemetry ecosystem discussions


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* 5+ years of Product Management experience, with a strong track record in developer tools, observability, infrastructure, data platforms, or another technically complex B2B product domain
* Experience leading strategy and execution across multiple engineering teams or product areas without relying on direct organizational authority
* Strong working knowledge of OpenTelemetry, including SDK instrumentation, OTLP, Collector pipelines, telemetry context, and semantic conventions
* Experience using or building instrumentation systems, agents, telemetry collectors, configuration products, or related infrastructure
* An understanding of the challenges involved in deploying and operating software across Kubernetes, virtual machines, and public cloud environments
* Experience turning complex onboarding, configuration, and troubleshooting workflows into clear and approachable product experiences
* A history of using customer research and product data to make decisions, align stakeholders, and deliver measurable outcomes
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and nontechnical stakeholders in a remote, globally distributed organization


**Bonus Points**
* Experience contributing to or building products around the OpenTelemetry or broader open source observability ecosystem
* Experience with automatic instrumentation, eBPF, or runtime-based instrumentation
* Firsthand experience as an SRE, platform engineer, developer, or observability practitioner
* Experience building product-led onboarding, configuration-validation, or telemetry-health experiences at scale


**In Sweden, the base compensation range for this role is SEK 996,819 - SEK 1,196,182. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.**
* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*
*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*
*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.*

title: SOURCING MANAGER IT
description:
**Description**
 Are you someone who enjoys driving procurement processes end-to-end and getting deals across the line? Do you thrive in a hands-on role where you work closely with stakeholders and suppliers? The the Sourcing Manager IT role could be a great fit for you!
   

  

 Join the IT Procurement team within SAS Procurement, reporting to the Head of IT Procurement. You will be part of a team working across different IT categories, where you will play a key role in running sourcing initiatives and supporting Category Managers across the different categories. As a Sourcing Manager IT, you will focus on executing RFPs, managing supplier dialogues, and leading negotiations across multiple categories, ensuring efficient processes and strong commercial outcomes. You will also contribute to improving ways of working by developing and refining templates, tools and sourcing processes.
   

  

 This role is operational and execution focused. You will lead sourcing activities from start to finish, ensuring well-run tenders, competitive agreements, and smooth procurement processes, while staying closely connected to stakeholders and business needs.
   

  

**Challenges You Will Work On**
 In this exciting and dynamic role, you will be navigating a dynamic environment where multiple sourcing initiatives and RFPs run in parallel, often with tight timelines and shifting priorities. Working across different IT categories means quickly adapting to varying supplier landscapes and levels of complexity. A key part of the role is bringing stakeholders together, aligning different needs to keep processes moving forward. You will also lead negotiations in a competitive market, driving strong commercial outcomes while building effective supplier relationships, while maintaining structured and high quality procurement processes.
   

  

 The Team
   

  

 You will be part of a high-performing team composed of talented professionals from various backgrounds. Our team values collaboration, innovation, and a commitment to excellence. We support each other and thrive on creating a positive and inclusive work environment where everyone can succeed.
   

  

 To be successful we believe you have
   

  

 The ability to work in a structured, organized and proactive way, even in a fast moving environment
   

  

* Have 4+ years’ experience running sourcing processes, RFPs and supplier negotiations specifically Strategic Procurement within IT
* Are structured and able to manage multiple priorities in parallel
* Feel comfortable working across different IT categories and quickly adapting to new areas
* Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with a range of stakeholders
* Are hands-on and enjoy driving processes from start to finish
* Have a commercial mindset and a strong interest in achieving solid business outcomes
* Build and maintain strong relationships with both stakeholders and suppliers


 A positive and growth oriented mindset, with a commitment to learning, continuous improvement, feedback and collaborative ways of working
   

  

 A Master’s degree in IT, business, finance — or equivalent relevant professional experience
   

  

 Why SAS?
   

  

**Benefits**
 At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:
   

  

* Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
* Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
* Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
* Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
* Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


 Our Culture at SAS
   

  

 At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you’ll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!
   

  

 Additional information
   

  

**Please be advised that, due to the summer holiday period, communication throughout the recruitment process may be less frequent than usual. The review and selection of candidates will begin following the closing date for applications.**
* Deadline for application: 09/08/2026. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Note that we are not able to handle any applications that are sent by email, due to GDPR regulations.
* Position: Fulltime (100%) starting with a 6-month probation period
* This position is based in Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm), and you will be expected to work onsite. Remote work may also be an option, depending on the agreement made with your manager.
* A background check will be conducted at the final stage of this recruitment process, as this role is security classified. If you are aware of any specific matters that may come up during this background check, we kindly ask you to be transparent about them during the recruitment process.

title: Strategic Account Director
description:
**About Keyfactor** 





 Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!
 




**Title:**

 Strategic Account Director
 




**Location:**

 Stockholm, Sweden or Netherlands (Remote) 
 





**Experience:** 
 Senior Level
 





**Function:** 
 Sales
 





**Industry:** 
 Computer and Network Security
 




**Job Summary**

  
 




 The Strategic Account Director is responsible for driving revenue growth through expansion deals within the existing customer base. This role focuses on identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities, deepening customer relationships, and collaborating with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions that meet client needs. Success in this position is measured by the ability to expand accounts and increase customer lifetime value. 
 



**Job Responsibilities**

  
 



* Proactively identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities by deeply understanding customer needs and aligning them with additional products or services.
* Maintain strong, ongoing relationships with key stakeholders within existing accounts to foster trust and ensure long-term retention.
* Create strategic account plans to drive revenue growth within assigned accounts, outlining goals for expansion and renewal opportunities.
* Work closely with product, marketing, and customer success teams to develop customized solutions and ensure seamless execution of expansion deals.
* Monitor account performance and expansion pipeline, providing regular reports on sales forecasts, revenue targets, and account health metrics.
* Lead contract negotiations for upsell and cross-sell deals, ensuring favorable terms while meeting both customer needs and company objectives.
* Act as a point of escalation for any issues, ensuring swift resolution to maintain client satisfaction and minimize potential churn risks.
* Keep abreast of industry trends, competitor activities, and market changes to offer informed recommendations and maintain a competitive edge within accounts.



**Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills**

  
 



* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Technology, or equivalent experience.
* Comprehensive understanding of the IT Security landscape and emerging trends.
* Expertise in risk management and security compliance frameworks.
* Knowledge of advanced technologies and their implications for the IT Security sector.
* Exceptional ability to develop and execute high-level strategic plans that drive growth.
* Expertise in the IT Security industry with an emphasis on market trends and dynamics.
* Strong indirect leadership skills to inspire and guide teams. • Ability to act as an ambassador for the company, demonstrating behaviors consistent with core values.
* Ability to lead and mentor teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration.
* Strong problem-solving skills to address complex challenges effectively.



**Travel Requirements**

  
 



* Up to 40% travel required.



**Compensation** 




 Salary will be commensurate with experience.  
 



**Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits** 




 We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas.  
 



 Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:   
 


* Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
* Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
* Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
* Competitive time off globally.
* Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees.
* DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology.
* The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts.
* Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays.
* Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
* Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.
* Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings.



**Our Core Values** 




 Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:
 



**Trust** 
**is paramount.** 
  
 



*We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.* 




**Customers** 
**are core.** 
  
 



*We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.* 




**Innovation** 
**never stops, it only accelerates.** 
  
 



*The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.* 




**We deliver with** 
**agility** 
**.** 
  
 



*We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.* 
  
 



**United by** 
**respect** 
**.** 
  
 



*Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.* 




**Teams** 
**make “it” happen.** 
  
 



*Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.* 




**Keyfactor is a proud equal opportunity employer including but not limited to veterans and individuals with disabilities.** 
  
 



**REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION:** 
 Applicants with disabilities may contact a member of Keyfactor’s People team via people@keyfactor.com and/or telephone at 1.216.785.2990 to request and arrange for accommodations at any time.

title: Senior Investigator
description:
At Accenture, you can bring your innovative vision to the heart of change to transform entire market sectors. Shape the future of business and technology by developing cutting-edge solutions that create new value.
   

  

 Your role and opportunities
   

  

 Join our international network of talents in the Incident Response field. You will work with innovative technologies on exciting projects, developing solutions to manage data securely. Specifically, you will be able to:
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

  

  

- Perform incident response to cybersecurity incidents, including but not limited to APT & Nation State attacks, Ransomware infections and Malware outbreaks, Insider Threats, BEC, DDOS, Security and Data breach, etc.

- Conduct in-depth investigations of cybersecurity incidents, identifying the root cause, the extent of the impact, and recommended actions for containment, eradication, and recovery, and providing a final report that contains recommendations on how to prevent the same attack in the future by strengthening security posture.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather information, coordinate incident response efforts, and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders, including management and legal teams.

- Perform digital forensics examinations on various digital devices (workstations, servers, mobile devices, etc.) to collect, analyze, and preserve evidence related to security incidents or policy violations.

- Develop/Update incident response plan, playbooks, process, and process documentation to ensure standardized incident response procedures.

- Participate in threat hunting activities, proactively seeking out and identifying potential security threats and weaknesses.

- Assist in implementing and fine-tuning security tools and technologies to enhance threat detection and incident response capabilities.

- Conduct training sessions and workshops to educate employees on cybersecurity best practices and incident response procedures.

- Work closely with the Nordic clients to ensure quality relationships.

 If you share our passion for cybersecurity and have the following characteristics, we are looking forward to meeting you:
   

  

  

- Knowledge of file and memory forensics techniques and commonly used tools such as EnCase, Axiom, Autopsy, Kape, Plaso, Volatility, and FTK Suite.

- Good command of incident management and response processes and procedures.

- In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity operations, security monitoring, EDR and SIEM tools, including Crowdstrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, TrendMicro VisionOne, and Splunk.

- Experience in conducting static or dynamic malware analysis, using solutions such as IDA Pro, OllyDbg, REMnux distro, and other disassemblers/debuggers.

- Detailed knowledge of Windows and Unix-based operating systems and administrative tools.

- Proficiency in English & Swedish.

- Ability to pass Security Clearances in Sweden

- Familiarity with disk and memory forensic analysis (Windows, Unix, or Linux environments).

- Knowledge of security controls such as authentication and identity management, network architectures enhanced for security, and application-based controls (including Windows, Unix, and network equipment).

- Proficiency in network traffic analysis and protocols using tools such as Wireshark.

- Interest to work closely with the clients, building relationships.

 Please expect slower feedback on your application due to summer vacation period, until August 11.

title: Test Manager
description:
**About Cognizant**
 At Cognizant (Nasdaq: CTSH), we're in the business of making the future work — for our clients, our communities, and the people who build it alongside us. As a leading AI Builder and technology services company, we bring together a global team of 300,000+ associates across 50+ countries to help the world's biggest organizations modernize, innovate, and grow. We don't just talk about transformation; we engineer it, one complex challenge at a time. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to do your best work, explore more at cognizant.ai.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a pivotal leadership opportunity at the intersection of data engineering, quality assurance, and enterprise-scale transformation. As a
 **Test Manager** 
 , you will own the end-to-end testing strategy for ETL processes and Data Warehouse migration projects — most notably migrations from legacy on-premises environments to modern cloud platforms such as Snowflake. Operating within the banking domain, you will be the driving force ensuring data integrity, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout every phase of migration. This is not a back-office quality role — it is a strategic position where your decisions directly shape the reliability of mission-critical financial data.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 You will define and lead the overall test strategy, scope, and objectives across multiple concurrent migration projects, keeping everything aligned with Agile sprint cycles and release readiness gates. You set the quality bar — establishing KPIs, defect benchmarks, and test coverage targets — and then you hold the line on them.
   

  

 On a day-to-day basis, you serve as the connective tissue between QA engineers, developers, product owners, and business stakeholders across finance, compliance, and IT. You translate regulatory and business requirements into actionable test plans, then track progress with metrics that tell a real story: defect trends, test coverage gaps, and release readiness signals.
   

  

 You will lead ETL testing across banking data domains — customer data, transactions, and risk analytics — applying the right validation technique for each pipeline and data tier. You champion shift-left practices and continuous testing, proactively identifying automation opportunities that reduce regression cycles and integration testing overhead. Alongside this, you will manage synthetic test data generation and oversee test data environments in Snowflake, including UAT, to ensure secure and scalable testing conditions.
   

  

 Managing the human side of quality is equally important. You allocate resources, manage timelines, conduct risk assessments, and implement mitigation strategies when challenges arise. You facilitate planning sessions and stakeholder reporting, and you invest time in mentoring junior testers — building a team culture grounded in accountability, curiosity, and a genuine commitment to quality.
   

  

 What We're Looking For
   

  

 You bring deep, hands-on experience in ETL testing — ideally with
 **IDMC (Informatica)** 
 — and you have navigated all phases of the project lifecycle: System Testing, UAT, Integration Testing, parallel runs, cutover, and BI reports testing. You know how to adapt your testing approach as a project evolves, and you understand what "done" truly looks like in a regulated banking environment.
   

  

 You have led or been a central contributor to at least one
 **end-to-end Data Warehouse migration project** 
 , preferably a Teradata-to-Snowflake migration, and you are familiar with the architectural nuances that make Snowflake different — including its separation of storage and compute. You are comfortable navigating audit readiness requirements and data governance policies, and you understand the compliance landscape well enough to keep testing aligned with banking regulations.
   

  

 Beyond the technical, you are a natural communicator and collaborator. You thrive in cross-functional environments, you manage change with clarity, and you know how to bring stakeholders along on the journey — from initial planning through to post-migration validation.
   

  

 Technical Skills
   

  

**ETL & Data Tools:** 
 Informatica PowerCenter, IDMC, Snowflake (Time Travel, Cloning, Micro-partitions, Streams & Tasks)
   

  

**Cloud Platforms:** 
 Microsoft Azure (primary), with working knowledge of AWS and GCP; Snowflake integration experience across all three
   

  

**Data Warehousing:** 
 End-to-end DWH migration experience; strong understanding of on-premises to cloud migration patterns (Teradata to Snowflake preferred)
   

  

**SQL:** 
 Advanced proficiency — this is non-negotiable
   

  

**Scripting:** 
 Python, Shell, or PowerShell for automation of repeatable tasks and ETL validation workflows
   

  

**Testing Scope:** 
 Full lifecycle — System, UAT, Integration, parallel run & cutover, and BI/reporting layer testing
   

  

**Infrastructure:** 
 Experience with hybrid environments spanning on-premises, cloud, and big data platforms
   

  

*We're excited to meet people who share our passion for quality and can make a real impact in a high-stakes data environment. If you meet most but not all, of the requirements above, don't hesitate to apply. Your unique perspective and transferable experience may be exactly what we're looking for.*

title: Senior Linux System Administrator
description:
**Vill du arbeta med avancerade Linuxmiljöer där stabil drift möter modern teknik och automation?** 




  





 På Axians får du möjlighet att arbeta med verksamhetskritiska Linuxplattformar hos några av Sveriges mest krävande kunder. Vi söker nu en erfaren
 **Senior Linux System Administrator** 
 som vill ta ansvar för den dagliga driften, förvaltningen och vidareutvecklingen av Linuxmiljöer inom våra OS Management-tjänster.
 



  





 Här får du kombinera tekniskt djup med ett stort operativt ansvar. Du arbetar nära kunder, kollegor och tredjepartsleverantörer i komplexa driftmiljöer där säkerhet, kvalitet och tillgänglighet står i fokus. Samtidigt får du möjlighet att bidra till förbättringar, standardisering och smartare arbetssätt genom automation.
 



  





 Som en del av Axians och VINCI Energies blir du en del av ett globalt nätverk med över 200 000 medarbetare där innovation, entreprenörskap och kunskapsutveckling är en naturlig del av vardagen.
 



  





**Din roll** 




 I rollen som
 **Senior Linux System Administrator** 
 arbetar du operativt med drift, administration, underhåll och vidareutveckling av Linuxbaserade servermiljöer. En stor del av vardagen består av att hantera
 **kundärenden, felsöka problem och arbeta med incidenter** 
 för att säkerställa stabila och säkra produktionsmiljöer.
 



  





 Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med patchning och systemuppdateringar, inklusive automatiserad patchning, changehantering, övervakning och löpande underhåll av Linuxservrar. Du deltar även i säkerhetsarbete, exempelvis hardening enligt
 **CIS Benchmarks** 
 , och använder scripting och automation som stöd för att effektivisera och standardisera det dagliga arbetet.
 



 Rollen innebär mycket samverkan med både kunder och tredjepartsleverantörer. Du behöver därför vara trygg i att kommunicera tekniska frågor, driva ärenden framåt och samarbeta med olika parter för att hitta lösningar.
 



 Du förväntas kunna ta ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och bidra med din erfarenhet till teamet. Automation är en viktig del av arbetssättet, men rollen är framför allt en
 **operativ Linuxroll** 
 där den dagliga driften och kundleveransen står i centrum.
 



  





 Beredskap ingår i tjänsten och genomförs enligt gällande beredskapsschema.
 



  





**Kompetensprofil** 




 Du har
 **gedigen erfarenhet av Linuxdrift i produktionsmiljö** 
 och trivs med ett operativt arbete där felsökning, incidenthantering och löpande drift är centrala delar. Du är van att ta ansvar för Linuxservrar genom hela deras livscykel och har ett strukturerat arbetssätt även när problemen är komplexa.
 



  





**Du har erfarenhet av:** 



* Linuxadministration och drift i större produktionsmiljöer
* Debian, Red Hat Enterprise Linux och/eller Rocky Linux
* Drift, administration, underhåll och felsökning av Linuxservrar
* Patchning och systemuppdateringar, gärna även automatiserad patchning
* Incident-, change- och ärendehantering
* Security hardening enligt CIS Benchmarks
* Bash och Python
* Automation och Ansible
* Nätverk, DNS och övervakning
* Kund- och tredjepartssamverkan
* God kommunikativ förmåga i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska



  





**Extra intressant om du även har erfarenhet av** 



* Kubernetes. Detta är ett område som vi vill utveckla framåt, men det är inte en central del av rollen från start.
* Managed Services eller outsourcingverksamhet
* Red Hat Satellite
* Puppet
* RHCSA, RHCE eller motsvarande certifieringar



  





**Är du redo för nästa steg?** 




 Vi söker dig som har ett starkt Linuxkunnande, gillar att lösa komplexa problem och trivs med ett operativt arbete nära både kunder och teknik.
 


* Om du vill arbeta med verksamhetskritiska Linuxmiljöer, bidra till en stabil och säker leverans och samtidigt vara med och förbättra våra arbetssätt, ser vi fram emot din ansökan.


- 


**Axians erbjuder** 




 Hos oss får du arbeta med teknik som gör skillnad och utvecklas tillsammans med några av branschens mest erfarna specialister.
 



 Vi erbjuder bland annat:
 


* Hybridarbete med stor flexibilitet
* Friskvårdsbidrag
* Fri träning i våra lokaler i Solna
* Kompetensutveckling och certifieringar
* Karriärmöjligheter inom Axians och VINCI Energies
* Moderna och trivsamma lokaler
* Ett engagerat team med hög teknisk kompetens
* VINCI Energies aktiesparprogram Castor
* Tryggheten och möjligheterna i en global koncern



  





**Ansök idag och bli en av oss!** 
 Vid frågor, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Alper Aksoy, alper.aksoy@axians.com. Urval sker löpande.
 



  





**Välkommen till Axians!**

title: Teknisk Innovationsspecialist
description:
Vill du utforska morgondagens teknik och bidra till att forma Handelsbankens förmåga att ta den till sig? Som Teknisk Innovationsspecialist får du arbeta i gränslandet mellan ny teknik, affär och förändring.
   

  

**Ditt team**
 Du blir en del av Handelsbankens innovationsgrupp som arbetar med att utforska, utvärdera och skapa förutsättningar för att ny teknik ska kunna omsättas till värde för banken. Vi följer tekniska trender, analyserar nya möjligheter och driver initiativ som hjälper banken att förstå hur framtidens teknik kan påverka affären, verksamheten och den tekniska infrastrukturen.
   

  

 Teamet består idag av fem personer med olika bakgrunder inom teknik, omvärldsbevakning, förändringsledning och verksamhetsutveckling. Tillsammans fungerar vi som en brygga mellan ny teknologi och bankens förmåga att ta den till sig. I den här rollen kommer du att bidra med den tekniska höjd som krävs för att utforska nya områden, testa hypoteser och omsätta insikter till konkreta rekommendationer och initiativ.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Teknisk innovation handlar sällan om att ha alla svaren från början. Tvärtom handlar det ofta om att utforska områden där få vet exakt vad som väntar runt hörnet.
   

  

 I den här rollen kommer du att arbeta med ett brett spektrum av tekniska frågeställningar och framtidsteknologier. Ena dagen kan du fördjupa dig i distribuerade system, kryptografi eller framtida infrastrukturlösningar. Nästa dag kan fokus ligga på en helt annan teknik eller på att hjälpa verksamheten förstå vilka möjligheter och utmaningar en ny utveckling innebär.
   

  

 Vi söker därför inte en specialist inom ett enskilt område. Vi söker dig som har en stark teknisk grund, är nyfiken av naturen och trivs med att lära dig nya saker. Du har en pragmatiskt förhållningssätt till programmeringsspråk, ramverk samt teknikval och det viktiga är att förstå vilket problem som ska lösas och vilken lösning som passar bäst i sammanhanget.
   

  

 En viktig del av arbetet är att utforska nya teknologier genom ett hypotesdrivet arbetssätt. Du kommer att formulera frågeställningar, testa antaganden, genomföra analyser och dra slutsatser som kan ligga till grund för framtida beslut och investeringar. Målet är inte alltid att hitta ett färdigt svar, utan att skapa förståelse för möjligheter, risker och förutsättningar.
   

  

 För att lyckas behöver du också vara intresserad av bankens verksamhet. Ny teknik skapar sällan värde på egen hand. Det verkliga arbetet handlar ofta om att förstå organisationen, navigera i processer, bygga relationer och skapa förutsättningar för förändring. Därför kommer du att samarbeta med många olika delar av banken och behöva anpassa ditt budskap efter mottagare och situation.
   

  

**Din profil**
 Vi tror att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av programmering och moderna utvecklingsmiljöer.
* Erfarenhet av DevOps, automatisering eller mjukvaruleverans.
* Förmåga att angripa problem på ett strukturerat och hypotesdrivet sätt.
* En bred teknisk förståelse och ett genuint intresse för ny teknik.
* Stark förmåga att kommunicera komplexa tekniska resonemang till olika målgrupper.
* Erfarenhet av att leda eller samordna arbete där flera personer är involverade.
* Intresse för hur teknik, verksamhet och organisation samverkar.


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av exempelvis:
   

  

* IT-infrastruktur och tekniska plattformar, såsom molnplattformar, Linux, Windows och Mainframemiljöer.
* Machine Learning
* Mjukvaruutveckling
* Nätverk och integration
* Kryptografi och blockkedjeteknik


 Som person är du nyfiken, pragmatisk och prestigelös. Du är bekväm med att ge dig in i områden där du inte är expert från början och ser lärandet som en naturlig del av arbetet. Du drivs av att förstå hur saker fungerar, men också av att omsätta den förståelsen till praktisk nytta.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Som ett steg i Handelsbankens rekryteringsprocess krävs en godkänd bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat, utförd av en extern part, innan anställning kan ske.
   

  

 Handelsbanken är en del av Sveriges totalförsvar och som bank fyller vi en samhällsviktig funktion tillsammans med den finansiella sektorn. Rollen kan därför komma att omfattas av krigsplacering inom Handelsbanken.
   

  

**Kontaktuppgifter**
**Rekryterande chef:** 
 Leonard Saers, leonard.saers@handelsbanken.se
   

  

**Talent Acquisition Partner:** 
 Henrik Alm, henrik.alm2@handelsbanken.se
   

  

**Facklig representant Finansförbundet:** 
 Per Almshult, per.almshult@handelsbanken.se
   

  

**Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen:** 
 Mikael Almvret, mikael.almvret@handelsbanken.se

title: It-infrastrukturtekniker med inriktning på nätverk
description:
*Folkhälsomyndigheten är en nationell kunskapsmyndighet som arbetar för bättre folkhälsa. Det gör myndigheten genom att utveckla och stödja samhällets arbete med att främja hälsa, förebygga ohälsa och skydda mot hälsohot. Vår vision är en folkhälsa som stärker samhällets utveckling.*
 Vi söker dig som har teknisk kompetens inom nätverksinfrastruktur, med erfarenhet av design, drift och underhåll av nätverk, samt kunskap om automatisering och säkerhetslösningar. Du är analytisk, lösningsorienterad och har förmågan att se problem som utmaningar och ta initiativ. Dessutom är du strukturerad, proaktiv och trivs i ett samarbete med kollegor som delar sin expertis.
   

  

 Läs mer och ansök redan idag!
   

  

 Vad ska du jobba med?
   

  

 Som it-infrastrukturtekniker med inriktning på nätverk kommer du att bli en del av ett team där du får stora möjligheter att påverka och forma myndighetens nätverksinfrastruktur. I rollen har du ett operativt och strategiskt ansvar för att säkerställa att våra nätverk är säkra, ändamålsenliga och framtidssäkrade, både ur ett designperspektiv och i det dagliga operativa arbetet.
   

  

 Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter innefattar att arbeta med livscykeln av nätverkslösningar, från implementering till drift och avveckling. Du kommer att arbeta med automatisering och förbättringar för att effektivisera våra miljöer och minska manuella processer, samt identifiera, genomföra och övervaka tester för att säkerställa nätverkens prestanda och tillgänglighet. I arbetet ingår även felsökning, reparation och utbyte av hårdvara i våra huvudsakligen on-prem-baserade miljöer.
   

  

 Du kommer att delta i olika projekt och uppdrag inom IT, både internt och tillsammans med övriga verksamheten, samt vara en del av enhetens beredskapstjänstgöring och planerade servicefönster. Genom ditt arbete kommer du att ha en direkt inverkan på enhetens utveckling och bidra till att vi når längre i våra samhällsviktiga uppdrag.
   

  

 Folkhälsomyndigheten är en samhällsviktig myndighet med ett viktigt uppdrag. Hos oss får du arbeta med meningsfulla och utmanande uppgifter, stöttande kollegor och möjligheter att utvecklas i en dynamisk miljö med fokus på modernisering och effektivisering.
   

  

 Vem söker vi?
   

  

**Krav För Anställningen**
* Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom nätverk och/eller av arbetsgivaren motsvarande bedömd arbetslivserfarenhet.
* Flerårig praktisk erfarenhet av nätverk, såsom routing, switching, IPS, wifi och lastbalansering.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av brandväggskonfiguration i komplexa it-miljöer.


**Mycket Stor Vikt Läggs Vid**
 Utöver det ser vi dessa kompetenser, förmågor och erfarenheter som viktiga för att du ska trivas hos oss:
   

  

* Personliga egenskaper som god samarbetsförmåga, ansvarstagande, initiativtagande och resultatinriktad. Du har ett helhetsperspektiv och ett gott bemötande.
* Erfarenhet av att driva förändring mot moderna arbetssätt, såsom automatisering.
* Aktuell erfarenhet av Fortinet-brandväggar och regelverk.
* Aktuell erfarenhet av Aruba-nätverk (switch och wifi).
* Erfarenhet av VMware (nät).
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.


**Stor Vikt Läggs Vid**
* Erfarenhet av Cisco UCS (nätverk) och Nexus.
* Erfarenhet av DNS och DHCP.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift.


**Vikt Läggs Vid**
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta inom ramverket ITIL och dess processer, framför allt incident, problem, change samt release.
* Kunskap om agila metoder, såsom DevSecOps.


 Vad gör enheten?
   

  

 Enheten för IT ansvarar för att myndigheten har en säker och tillgänglig it-driftmiljö samt för en effektiv support, förvaltning och modern utveckling av it-system. Enheten ansvarar även för en samordnad och kostnadseffektiv process för inköp av it-relaterad utrustning, licenser och konsulttjänster.
   

  

 Enheten ansvarar för digitalisering inom it-området, vilket inkluderar utvecklings- och förvaltningsstyrning, it-projektkontor, informationssäkerhet samt telefoni och konferenssystem.
   

  

 Hur är det att jobba på Folkhälsomyndigheten?
   

  

 Vi erbjuder utvecklande arbetsuppgifter där du kan påverka och göra skillnad. Oavsett vad du jobbar med är du med och bidrar till samhällsnytta. Det gör du tillsammans med engagerade och kompetenta kollegor i stimulerande samarbeten. Folkhälsomyndigheten är en arbetsplats som strävar efter att ge lika möjligheter till alla och att vara fri från diskriminering. Myndigheten har sin verksamhet i Solna och Östersund.
   

  

 Medarbetarskap och kultur på Folkhälsomyndigheten
   

  

 Om anställningen
   

  

 Du kommer att anställas som handläggare med placering på vårt kontor i Solna. Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid som inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde sker 2026-12-01 snarast enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

 Som anställd vid Folkhälsomyndigheten kan du komma att bli krigsplacerad. Vissa tjänster är placerade i säkerhetsklass där svenskt medborgarskap kan vara ett krav. Säkerhetsprövning kommer då genomföras i enlighet med Säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585).
   

  

 På myndigheten kan det finnas möjlighet att teckna överenskommelse om distansarbete upp till 40 procent av din arbetstid.
   

  

 Är du intresserad?
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om anställningen är du välkommen att kontakta enhetschef Sofia Palmér, telefon 010- 205 22 53.
   

  

 Fackliga företrädare är för SACO Susanne Fridh, telefon 010-205 23 17, och för OFR/S Mathilde Rehnlund, telefon 010-205 25 51.
   

  

 Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan till befattningen som nätverkstekniker hos oss!
   

  

 Vi har valt att ta bort det personliga brevet ur rekryteringsprocessen. I stället ansöker du med ditt CV och genom att besvara urvalsfrågor. Målet är att skapa en mer inkluderande rekryteringsprocess. Arbetspsykologiska tester och arbetsprov kan komma att användas som en del i rekryteringsprocessen.
   

  

 Vänligen ladda upp relevanta examensbevis i samband med din ansökan.
   

  

 Läs i ansökningsformuläret hur du går tillväga om du har skyddade personuppgifter.
   

  

 Ansök senast 2026-10-29 via myndighetens webbplats.
